What should be checked during installation regarding the armature's axial play?
Check axial play of armature, correcting with shims if necessary.
What components need to be removed after taking off the circlip, shims, and seal?
Remove the solenoid switch (see section 12 41 041), then unscrew the cap.
What voltage range should be produced when cranking the engine at 200 to 300 rpm during pulse transmitter testing?
Voltage of 1.0 to 2.0 V should be produced when cranking the engine with starter at 200 to 300 rpm.
What should be done with the ignition lead after pulling off the shielded plug?
Cut off ignition lead and cut off sender on ignition lead.
What should be checked during Test 17/18 for the exhaust system and catalytic converter?
Check exhaust system and catalytic converter for damage, tight fit and leaks.
What is the procedure number for removing and installing/replacing the voltage regulator?
The procedure number is 12 32 000 REMOVING AND INSTALLING/REPLACING VOLTAGE REGULATOR.
What should you check for on the ignition coil housing?
Check for hairline cracks and signs of burning.
For M 20 engines, where should the plug be disconnected?
Disconnect plug underneath the diagnosis socket.
What is relay no. 2 used for in the DME system?
Relay no. 2 is the master relay for fuel injection in the DME system.
What test unit should be connected when checking the ignition coil?
Connect BMW service test unit.
What type of damage should you look for on the distributor cap and rotor besides physical damage?
Look for signs of burning on the distributor cap and rotor in addition to damage and hairline cracks.
What is the BMW service code number for the carbon brushes replacement procedure?
The BMW service code number for the carbon brushes replacement procedure is 12 41 551.
What should be checked if slip ring wear is found during inspection?
Check slip rings for wear, fine grinding if necessary.
In diagram M 21 12 039, what do the numbered callouts 1, 2, 3, and 4 represent?
The callouts show: 1 and 2 are motor and gearbox components being separated, 3 is the groove, and 4 is the rubber part that must be aligned.
How much ignition lead insulation should be stripped when replacing a screwed connection?
Strip the ignition lead insulation by about 12 mm (1/2 inch) with stripping pliers after cutting off the connection.
What should be done with insulating sleeves and washers if they are damaged?
Replace them if necessary.
What are the numbered leads shown in the sender testing diagram?
The diagram shows leads numbered 1, 2, and 3 on the connector.
What does terminal S connect to in the TCI+S control unit?
Terminal S connects to starter term. 50.
What chapter number covers Engine Electrical Equipment in this BMW E30 manual?
Chapter 12 covers Engine Electrical Equipment.
What is the first step when performing Test 2 for voltage supply to the TCI control unit?
Pull off plug on control unit and turn on ignition.
What temperature range defines a cold engine that will not start?
A cold engine that will not start is defined as having an oil temperature of 20°C or 68°F or below.
If an engine has knock when accelerating, what test positions should be examined?
For knock when accelerating (symptom 10), check test positions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, and 16.
What type of Motronic system is referenced in the increment wheel identification?
Single-sender Motronic system is referenced for the increment wheel identification.
What should be checked on the intake air temperature switch?
Check resistance on intake air temperature switch. The switches should be connected during the check with control simulator.
What installation checks should be performed on the alternator?
Check slip rings for wear, fine grinding and polishing if necessary. Connect BMW service test unit. Start engine and compare test values with nominal values.
What is terminal 1 connected to on the Bosch TCii Control Unit?
Terminal 1 is connected to the ignition coil.
What is required regarding the distributor number before testing?
The distributor number must be the same as specified on the nominal value microfiche.
What component is labeled 'D' in the photographs?
Component 'D' appears to be related to the sensor assembly or wiring connection in the engine compartment.
What components should be checked during installation?
Check condition of insulating sleeves and washers, replacing if necessary.
What components should be checked for wear when servicing the carbon brushes?
Check carbon brushes and commutator for wear, repairing if necessary.
What components are labeled B and D in the sensor diagrams?
B is the Reference mark sensor and D is the Speed sensor.
What causes a starter to turn too slow?
A) Bearings worn or very dirty, or B) Electrical defect in solenoid, armature or coils.
What should you do with the retainers and cover during removal?
Take off retainers and pull off cover.
Where can I find nominal values and wiring diagram information referenced in this troubleshooting guide?
See Nominal Value Microfilm for specifications and See Wiring Diagram for electrical connections.
What terminals are used for the pulse transmitter on the Bosch TCii Control Unit?
Terminals A+/B- are used for the pulse transmitter.
What should be done with the housing sections before disassembly?
Unscrew bolts (1) and mark position of housing sections to each other.
What does terminal 15 supply on both control units?
Terminal 15 supplies power supply.
What are the first steps to remove the ignition coil?
Pull off protective cap and ignition lead (terminal 4). Unscrew connections (terminal 1 and 15). Unscrew holder and take off ignition coil.
How do you remove the solenoid switch from the starter?
Remove solenoid switch with spring, then disconnect and remove armature.
What resistance measurements are required for spark plug testing?
Measure resistance of shields and spark plug connectors.
What can be recognized on the increment wheel for single-sender Motronic?
The component marked as (1) can be recognized on the increment wheel for single-sender Motronic.
Where can additional specifications be found for these procedures?
See Specifications (referenced at the bottom of the page).
What is shown in the middle installation diagram?
The installation process showing how to apply Curil K 2 compound to the back of the control unit before installation.
What wire colors are associated with the control unit coding plug?
The red plug for control unit coding has wire colors: brown/violet.
What should be done first when replacing the ignition coil?
Pull off protective cap and ignition lead (term. 4).
What should be checked if necessary near the DME control unit?
If necessary, check ground point and plug connection (near DME control unit) - see figure.
What type of replacement parts should be used for TCI and DME systems?
Only install specified original BMW parts.
What is the maximum current rating mentioned in the footnotes?
The maximum current rating mentioned is Imax (0.2 A) according to footnote (1).
How do you remove the ignition lead plugs?
Pull off ignition lead plugs. Make sure plugs fit tight on ignition leads and in distributor cap, then check firing order.
What section should be referenced for removing the intake manifold and air cleaner?
What additional test should be performed if the vacuum hose is connected on the intake air manifold?
Perform test step '06 Engine' if vacuum hose is connected on the intake air manifold.
What component is labeled as number 15 in the diagram?
Component number 15 is located on what appears to be the distributor housing assembly in the upper portion of the diagram.
What testing equipment is referenced for TCI troubleshooting procedures?
BMW SERVICE TEST, including engine test/test step 05 (P 05), multimeter 02 (M 02), multimeter M 22/23, and oscilloscope.
What measurement method is used to check resistance of spark plug connectors and ignition leads?
Check resistance using measurement method M 06 of spark plug connectors and ignition leads.
What parts need to be removed according to the numbered callouts in the first diagram?
Remove solenoid, unscrew cap, take off retainer (3), shims (4) and seal (5).
What alternative tool set is available for this procedure?
The required special tools 12 1 091/092/098 are also available as a complete set 12 1 090.
What precaution should be taken when soldering in new carbon brushes?
Make sure that copper leads are not hardened with flowing solder.
What section reference is provided for ignition coil code number verification?
Section 12 13 009 is referenced for checking the code number of the ignition coil.
What test should be performed after releasing the jaws and removing the ignition lead?
Perform a tear-out test by hand with a tearing-out force of ≥ 200 N / 44 lbs.
What installation checks should be performed after reassembly?
Check slip rings for wear, fine grinding and polishing if necessary. Connect BMW service test unit, start engine and compare test values with nominal values.
What minimum resistance shielding is required for the secondary side of the ignition system?
The secondary side (high voltage side) of the ignition system must be shielded with at least 4 k-ohms, whereby the original distributor rotor with 1 k-ohm shielded resistor must be installed.
What safety precaution must be taken before working on the ignition system?
Always turn off ignition before working on dangerous high power ignition systems. Refer to page 12-1 for working on transistor coil ignition system.
What do the resistance value abbreviations TW and TA represent?
TW = Water temperature, TA = Intake air temperature
Where can specifications for ignition coil resistance and inductivity measurements be found?
The specifications for resistance (M 06) and inductivity (M 07) measurements of primary and secondary coils can be found in section 12 13 009.
What should you do if the plug doesn't fit properly?
Check plug (S) for tight fit - if pressed out, replace ignition coil.
What is the first step in disassembling the alternator housing?
Unscrew shielded capacitor.
Which ignition voltage test should be repeated if necessary?
Check ignition voltage (P 09), repeating tests 3, 5 and 6 if necessary.
What is the correct resistance specification for the inductive pulse sender?
The inductive pulse sender (pins 47/48) should have a resistance of 540 ohms ± 10%.
What are the first two steps when removing and installing the starter?
Disconnect battery ground lead, then remove air cleaner with air flow sensor.
What critical alignment requirement must be met during installation?
Openings and bores must be aligned.
What is Test 7 in the ignition system diagnostic procedure?
Test 7 is IGNITION TIMING / IGNITION TIMING CONTROL.
What is the first step when replacing the TDC position transmitter?
Lift position transmitter out of clamp.
What installation check should be performed regarding the washer position?
Check the location of the washer - the collar faces the bearing.
When should the voltage regulator be replaced according to the troubleshooting procedure?

The voltage regulator should be replaced if the battery charge indicator lamp goes out while engine is running and the regulating voltage is not reached, with harmonic wave ratio and oscillograph showing as indicated. See section 12 32 000.
What happens to the ignition timing when using the simulator?
The ignition timing value displayed now will be 'retarded' approx. 20° on crankshaft by the simulator.
Where is the ground wire routed from the TCI control unit?
The ground wire is routed to the ground point on air collector (4th cylinder).
What section provides information about bleeding the cooling system?
What is the resistance specification for the pulse sender multimeter test between pins 1 and 2?
The resistance should be 520 ohms ± 5%.
Under what condition should the TCI control unit test only be performed?
Only if the engine does not start, as noted in the footnote.
If the starter works after bridging connections 30 and 50, but doesn't work normally, what should I check?
A) Defective wires and connections on starter switch, or B) Starter switch defective.
What are the main inspection items for ignition coil testing according to Test 2?
Check wires for tight fit, check connection plate and ignition lead contacts for traces of burning, cracks and oxidation, and check the code number of ignition coil (see 12 13 009).
What should you do if the pulse sensor voltage check is not okay during cranking?
Check pulse sensor resistance on disconnected control unit plug M 06 - see 12 11 150.
If the starter slips, what should I check first?
Check gear ring teeth on flywheel to determine if teeth are damaged or okay.
What diagnostic step should I perform if the starter does not work at all?
Bridge connection 30 with connection 50 on solenoid.
What is the specified depth range for machining insulation between commutator plates?
Machine insulation between plates approximately 0.5 to 0.7 mm (0.020 to 0.027") deep.
What wire color is connected to jack number 6 across all three relay types?
Jack number 6 is connected to terminal 30, which uses red wire in Master Relay, red wire in Fuel Pump Relay, and green/white wire in Oxygen Sensor Relay.
Where is the battery located in this vehicle?
The battery is located in the trunk.
What should you do first when starting Test 7?
Start the engine and check ignition timing, adjusting if necessary according to section 12 11 005.
What is the part number for the vacuum advance control simulator?
The vacuum advance control simulator part number is 12 1 460.
What oscilloscope display should conform to the illustration during testing?
The primary display on oscilloscope should conform with the illustration shown - if necessary, replace the control unit.
What is the section number and title for this distributor removal and installation procedure?
Section 12 11 060 - Removing and Installing Distributor.
Where can I find on-board diagnosis information in this manual?
On-board diagnosis information can be found on page 12-200.
What is the same corrective measure for both fuel injector final stage tests?
Replace DME control unit, if tests up to this point are okay.
What diagnostic step should I take if the charge indicator lamp is on with ignition off?
Remove alternator and replace diode plate - see section 12 31 891.
What should you use for the circlip during drive pinion installation?
Use a new circlip (2).
What compound should be applied to the back of the control unit during installation?
Coat back of control unit with Curil K 2 before installation of the control unit.
Which page should I reference for carbon brush replacement?
Page 12-53 contains information for carbon brush replacement.
What safety precaution is mentioned regarding battery and alternator disconnection?
Only disconnect leads on battery, alternator and starter when engine is stopped. Also disconnect positive and negative leads when charging battery with a charger.
What should you check during installation after removing the starter housing bolts?
Check bearing sleeve, lubricating with oil before installing, and align openings for housing bolts and insulator to each other.
What should always be disconnected when working on the electrical system of the TCI and DME?
Always disconnect battery or interrupt power supply to ignition control unit and ignition coil when working on the electrical system.
What tool is specified for knocking down the dowel pin when removing the pulse transmitter gear?
Knock down dowel pin with an impact mandrel and take off pulse transmitter gear (rotor).
What types of damage should be looked for in the exhaust system inspection?
Check for damage, tight fit and leaks in the exhaust system and catalytic converter.
What section reference is given for removing the starter motor?
See section 12 41 020.
What safety precaution must be taken with the battery before working on TCI and DME electrical systems?

Always disconnect battery or interrupt power supply to ignition control unit and ignition coil when working on the electrical system to prevent dangerous primary and secondary voltage as well as danger of destroying the ignition system.
What resistance checks are mentioned for the temperature switches?
Check resistance on coolant temperature switch and check resistance on intake air temperature switch.
Which component is faulty when Code 4 is displayed?
Code 4 indicates a faulty idle speed switch.
What component is shown in the circular detail view at the bottom left?
The circular detail view shows the Inductive pulse sender.
What connections need to be unscrewed during ignition coil replacement?
Unscrew connections (term. 1 and 15). Unscrew holder and take off ignition coil.
Which terminal number corresponds to jack number 4 in the Fuel Pump Relay?
Jack number 4 corresponds to terminal number 85 in the Fuel Pump Relay.
What engine designation is specified for the fuel injector tests?
The M 20 engine designation is specified for both fuel injector final stage tests.
What part number is shown for the sender component in the installation image?
What are the terminal numbers for the Fuel Pump Relay?
The Fuel Pump Relay uses terminals 2, 4, 6, and 8 with terminal numbers 87, 85, 30, and 86 respectively.
What three components are identified in the retainer removal diagram?
1 - Retainer, 2 - Metal washer, 3 - Plastic washer.
What are the numbered callouts 1, 2, 5, and 6 indicating in the distributor plug diagram?
The numbered callouts 1, 2, 5, and 6 indicate the terminal positions on the distributor plug connector for testing purposes.
Where in the manual would I look for solenoid switch replacement procedures?
Solenoid switch replacement procedures can be found on page 12-51.
What repair procedure is referenced for replacing the voltage regulator?
What components are removed in step 30 12 016?
Remove distributor rotor (1), dust cap (2), and pull off vacuum hose (3).
On which page can I find instructions for removing and installing the starter?
Page 12-51 contains instructions for removing and installing the starter.
What happens if ignition coil term. 1 wire is connected to ground or B+?
The ignition coil term. 1 wire must not be used to prevent engine starting when service installing a burglar alarm system.
Where can specifications for these ignition system components be found?
Specifications are referenced at the bottom of the page with an asterisk notation.
What special tool is used for replacing one spark plug connector on 1988 models?
Special Tool 12 1 096 is used to place the ignition lead in and slide it into the spark plug connector until connection is heard to engage.
What is the proper installation procedure for the 20-pin engine wire harness plug?
The installation procedure is to screw-on cap engages in final position.
What should you check for when inspecting the distributor cap and rotor?
Check distributor cap and rotor for correct fit, damage and hairline cracks as well as signs of burning.
What reference page should be consulted for working on the ignition system?
Refer to page 12-0 for instructions for working on ignition system.
What should be inspected during Test 20 for the cooling system?
Check coolant level and concentration. If necessary, fill and bleed cooling system according to Group 17.
What should you do with the engine when checking resistance and oscillograph measurements?
Turn engine with the starter when checking resistance (M 06) and oscillograph (M 22/23) on disconnected pulse sensor plug.
What should be checked when installing a new ignition coil?
Check new ignition coil for correct code number and color label.
What diagram number shows the washer installation check?
Diagram 30 12 039 shows the installation check for the washer position.
What is the terminal designation for oil pressure on models since 1986?
Ol (terminal 5)
What components are shown in the connector diagram?
The diagram shows connector pins labeled KI.31, KI.50, FT, D+, KI.1, KI.30, and KI.15 in a circular arrangement.
What is the proper procedure for inserting the ignition lead into the connector?
Unscrew screw (1), slide in ignition lead against stop, follow with pliers and slide in ignition lead further until connector is heard to engage.

Reference number 630 11 025 corresponds to the oscillograph pattern showing a normal or baseline alternator output waveform.
What should I check if the ground resistance is too high on pins 2, 14, 19, 24?
Check / repair connections and leads on ground point.
What are the three wire colors for the transmitter lead connections?
1 = Black wire, 2 = Shielding, 3 = Yellow wire.
What wire colors are used for the self-diagnosis transmitting lead?
White/yellow wire colors are used for RXD (Self-diagnosis transmitting lead).
What could cause ignition timing not to be reached when vacuum is supplied to the advance control box?
Solenoid defective, vacuum hose leaks, or distributor defective.
What is the minimum tear-out force required for the ignition lead connection?
The tear-out force must be greater than or equal to 200 N / 44 lbs.
What component should be removed with the air flow sensor?
Take off air cleaner with air flow sensor.
What is the wire size for the brown wire in the Master Relay?
The brown wire (terminal 85) in the Master Relay has a size of 0.5 mm².
What component is shown in the top diagram with arrows pointing to it?
The TCI Control Unit (Bosch) with arrows indicating the cap removal and plug disconnection points.
What special tools are available as a complete set for this procedure?
The required special tools 12 1 091/092/098 are also available as a complete set 12 1 090.
What is the correct installation procedure for the ground lead bolt?
Install longer bolt for the ground lead correctly during installation.
What type of waveform pattern should appear on the oscilloscope when testing the pulse sender?
A square wave pattern with alternating high and low pulses should appear, as shown in the illustrated signal diagram.
What BMW test equipment is mentioned for connecting to the ignition control unit?
Connect multimeter (M 02) and oscilloscope (M 22) of BMW service test unit on disconnected ignition control unit plug terminals 5 and 6.
What is terminal 50 connected to on the Siemens/Telefunken control unit?
Terminal 50 is connected to starter terminal 50.
What is shown in the bottom right image with reference number 30 12 135?
The bottom right image shows the Ground point for engine electrics.
How do I diagnose a charge indicator lamp that glows or is on with engine running?
Connect BMW service test unit and perform engine test (P 102). Check regulating voltage and charging current. Then check oscillograph and harmonic wave ratio - see section 12 31 009.
What components need to be removed to access the pole housing?
Unscrew engaging lever bolt and remove rubber seal to remove the pole housing.
What is the terminal number for oil level dynamic on both pre-1986 and post-1986 models?
Terminal 15 (dyn) on pre-1986 models and terminal 10 (dyn) on post-1986 models

For poor acceleration/final output (symptom 13), check test positions 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 18, and 19.
What is the nominal resistance value for checking rotor coil ground contact?
The nominal value should be infinity (∞ = 999 k-ohm display) when testing between slip ring and rotor shaft.
What is the difference between terminals 6 and 10 on pre-1986 models regarding power supply?
Terminal 6 (15s) provides power supply with ignition turned on - fuse protection, while terminal 10 (15u) provides power supply with ignition turned on - wire without fuse protection.
What safety precaution is mentioned when unscrewing the solenoid?
Don't turn wire connector while tightening - danger of short circuit.

Installation:

Always turn off ignition before working on ignition systems.
What installation tool recommendation is given for easier installation?
Use wrench socket or pipe again to make installation easier.
If the pulse sensor resistance check is not okay, what is the recommended action?
Replace pulse sensor - see 12 11 151.
What components are numbered 1 through 6 in the exploded diagram?
The numbered components show the distributor assembly parts including protective caps (1 and 2), various internal components (3, 4, 5), and seal (6).
What should be checked regarding the coil and insulation resistance?
Check resistance* of coil and insulation, with reference to see Specifications for specific values.
What should be checked on carbon brushes and where is the reference section?
Check carbon brushes and commutator for wear, repairing if necessary - see section 12 41 551.
What lubrication is required for the drive pinion bearing surface?
Lubricate bearing surface for drive pinion with grease.
What position should switch 1 be set to on the simulator?
Set switch 1 on simulator to position A.
What is the purpose of the shielding requirements for the ignition system's secondary side?
The shielding is required to prevent interference with radio and communication equipment.
What does terminal 15 provide power for?
Terminal 15 provides power with ignition turned on.
What should be replaced if it is damaged by the special tool while pulling off the bearing?
Replace the cover for the bearing if it is damaged by the special tool while pulling off the bearing.

Replace distributor cap and/or rotor.
What reference number is provided for battery gas discharging tank procedures?
See 61 21 015 for battery gas discharging tank procedures.
What should be checked on the slip rings and what action should be taken if necessary?
Check slip rings for wear, fine grinding and polishing if necessary - see 12 31 201.
What is the wire color combination for the TXD data lead?
The TXD data lead uses white/violet wire colors.

What should be removed according to procedure code 32 12 159?
The starter should be removed according to this procedure code.
What should I do if I'm not getting proper voltage on pin 18 to ground?
Check battery and lead via relay 2 (master relay) to control unit.

The diagram shows part numbers 630 12 907 and 630 12 associated with the distributor components.
Where can I find the procedure for alternator troubleshooting?
Alternator troubleshooting procedures are located on page 12-140.
What should you look for when checking connections and caps?
Check for tight fit and leaks.
Where should the tester needle be positioned when checking belt tension?
The tester needle must be in the scale above green or yellow section.
What should be referenced for more detailed wiring information about the car electric system?
See car or engine electric system wiring diagram.
What should you do if the bearing cover was damaged during the application of the special tool?
Replace the cover for the bearing if it had been damaged through application of the special tool.
What does component number 2 represent in the layout?
Component number 2 is the Engine electric/electronic ground point.
If the voltage test on terminals 15 and 31 is not okay, what routing should be checked first?
Check the routing of terminal 15w wire, starting with the ignition lock and plug connection on wire harness for car electric system.
What does terminal L represent in the diagnosis plug connections?
Terminal L represents the Engine M 10 B 18 integrator output for CO adjustments and Engine M 30 B 34 oxygen sensor signal.
What critical orientation detail must be checked during washer installation?
The collar must face the bearing when installing the washer.
What are the two plugs labeled B and D in the engine compartment?
Plug B is for the reference mark sensor and plug D is for the speed sensor, both are gray plugs.
What type of TCI control unit is shown in the bottom diagram?
TCI-S Control Unit (Siemens/Telefunken)
What insulation test value should be performed on the pulse sender?
Perform insulation test with a value greater than 100 k-ohms.
What should you measure when testing spark plug connectors on M3/M5/M6 models?
You should measure shielded resistance when testing the spark plug connectors.
What lubrication is specified for the drive bearing bracket during installation?
Lubricate guide for engaging fork with grease and check bearing sleeve in drive bearing bracket, lubricating with oil before installing.
What should you never do after removing the distributor cap or disconnecting wires on the ignition coil?
Never start the engine after removal of distributor cap and/or disconnection of wire on ignition coil term. 4, and pull off plug on ignition control unit.
What does number 2 represent in the coolant system diagram?
Coolant temperature sensor for DME.
What does terminal 31 represent in the TCI control unit (Bosch) connector?
Terminal 31 is Ground.
What should the primary current value be when operating the engine at 1000 ±50 rpm?
The value should be 1.2 to 1.7 A - if not necessary, replace the control unit.
What BMW service test unit step should be carried out when checking the ignition coil?
Carry out engine test step 09 when checking the ignition coil.
What preliminary step must be completed before assembling starter components?
Clean all components thoroughly prior to assembling.
How do I diagnose a starter that doesn't work using the lights test?
Turn on lights. If lights go out while starting, there's a short in starter. If lights remain on while starting, check for solenoid faulty or carbon brushes worn.
What should be inspected on the pinion during installation?
Check pinion for wear (on teeth, bearings, one-way clutch), replacing if necessary.
What should you do with the negative terminal on the battery before starting this procedure?
Unscrew negative terminal on battery (in trunk).
What are the three possible causes listed for hose venting?
1 To advance control box on distributor, 2 To intake air manifold or throttle housing, 3 Electric activation of simulator
What tool specification is mentioned for testing starter components?
Use a standard tester when checking exciter coil, carbon brush holder, armature coil for ground contact, and armature for shorted turns.
What does it mean when lamp 'MV' comes on in the simulator?
When lamp 'MV' on the simulator comes on, the solenoid is activated.
What should be done with burrs found on the shaft?
Remove burrs with a file.
What should be done after mounting the entire unit on the gearbox case?
Mount entire unit on the gearbox case and then tighten the wire connector.
What lubricant should be applied to the sensor seals?
Coat seals with Molykote paste.
What special tool is required to install the connector on the ignition lead?
Special Tool 12 1 091 is required to place the connector on the ignition lead and insert it properly.
What two components are identified in the top right image labeled 30 12 307?
The top right image shows: 1) Coolant temperature sensor and 2) Temperature gage.
Where can I find additional troubleshooting information for fuel injection?
Refer to 'Troubleshooting Fuel Injection' in Group 13 for other test positions.
What special tool is required to pull off the bearing on a Bosch alternator?
Special Tool 00 7 500 is required to pull off the bearing on Bosch alternators.
What tests should be performed when the charge indicator lamp glows or is on with engine running?
Connect BMW service test unit and perform engine test (P 02). Check regulating voltage and check charging current.
What type of parts should only be installed on the ignition system?
Only install specified original BMW parts.
What should remain connected during the power supply check?
Car wire harness plugs remain connected during the power supply check.
What should I do if charging current with equipment on is too low?
Replace or disassemble alternator and inspect components - see section 12 31 020.
What section should be referenced if the alternator was replaced and gas tank discharge is necessary?
If alternator was replaced, check and, if necessary, discharge gas tank - see Group 61, Pos. 61 21 015.
Which pin carries the speed signal and what wire color is used?
Pin 9 carries the speed signal using a black wire.
What is the maximum voltage rating shown in the footnotes?
