What type of tester can be used for the shorted turn test on the stator coil?
The shorted turn test can be performed with a standard tester.
What should you check for when inspecting the ignition coil visually?
Check for hairline cracks and signs of burning. Check plug (S) for tight fit - if pressed out, replace ignition coil.
On which page can I find information about DME troubleshooting test procedures?
DME troubleshooting test procedures can be found on page 12-111.
How should the resistance of the sensor coil be measured?
Measure resistance of sensor coil (M 06) on + and - of plug using universal test leads.
Which terminals are used in the Motronic holding circuit since 12.86?
Terminals 27 and 36 are used.
Where can you find instructions for working on TCI and DME systems?
See page 12-0 for instructions for working on TCI and DME.
What is shown in the diagram labeled '30 12 041'?
The diagram shows the internal view of the alternator with diode plate and stator windings visible.
What is the difference between pin 6 and pin 7 functions?
Pin 6 (15 S) provides voltage with ignition on with fuse protection, while pin 7 (15 U) is the same as pin 6 but with load without fuse.
What reference source is noted for the Curil K 2 compound?
HWB Product Range (Division of BMW)
What part number reference is shown for the protective caps removal procedure?
Part number reference 630 12 134 is shown for the protective caps removal procedure.
What does DME stand for in this wiring diagram?
DME is not explicitly defined in the explanations section on this page, but it appears in pin 18 as 'DME relay (relay 2)'.
What components should be checked for wear on the pinion assembly?
Check pinion for wear (on teeth, bearings, one-way clutch), replacing if necessary.
How should you disconnect the pull rod from below?
Disconnect pull rod from below. Check that pivoting plate moves easily after connecting the pull rod.
What is the title of Test 1 described in this troubleshooting section?
Test 1 - SPEED AND REFERENCE MARK SENSORS
What should be done to the ignition lead before working on a non-disconnectable 30 kV system?
Cut off the ignition lead as shown in the diagram.
What does it mean when the 'tp' lamp is not flashing during vacuum advance control system troubleshooting?
No tp signal, no power supply for simulator, L-Jetronic control unit connections or wire harness defective, or engine not running correctly or at all.
What should be sprayed on the guiding sleeve of Special Tool 12 1 092?
Spray a thin coat of lubricant 12 1 098 on the guiding sleeve of Special Tool 12 1 092.
When should the insulating sleeves and washers be replaced?
If they are found to be in poor condition during the inspection process.
What should you do if the specified charging current is not reached during testing?
Repeat the test. If the specified charging current is still not reached, remove and disassemble alternator, and inspect components according to section 12 31 020/513.
Which components are specifically mentioned for tight fit inspection in Test 19?
Hoses for crankcase vent and oil dipstick should be checked for tight fit.
On what page can I find information about inspecting starter components?
Information about inspecting starter components can be found on page 12-53.
What critical warning is given when unsoldering the stator coil?
Excessive heat from soldering iron would destroy the diodes.
What maintenance should be performed on the air cleaner filter?
Replace a dirty air cleaner filter element.
What procedure should be followed to remove the spark plug connector?
Pull off the rubber cap toward the rear and unscrew the spark plug connector.
What symptoms indicate faults in the TCI system?
Engine not starting running incorrectly, misfiring in different operating conditions, and poor engine output.
What procedure should be followed to replace/check speed and reference mark sensors?
Unscrew screws of speed and reference mark sensors (D and B) and pull out sensors. For installation, mark new reference mark sensor (B) with a piece of tape.
How should you check the bearing according to the service procedure?
Check bearing, driving it out with a suitable mandrel if necessary.
What should you do with the battery during this procedure?
Remove battery. Check gas discharging tank for battery, discharging if necessary - see 61 21 015.
What timing intervals are shown in the flashing code output diagram?
The diagram shows 3 second intervals at the beginning and end, with 1 second intervals between the individual code pulses.
What is the largest wire size specification shown for the Fuel Pump Relay?
The largest wire size for the Fuel Pump Relay is 1.5/1 mm² for the green/violet wire on terminal 87.
What should you check on the armature during solenoid switch installation?
Check armature for wear (scoring, deep spots, etc.) and replace if necessary.
What should be done with rubber mounts if necessary during reassembly?
Press rubber mounts out of housing if necessary.
What are the D+ and B+ terminals shown in the alternator diagram?
D+ is the positive terminal for the indicator lamp circuit, and B+ is the main positive output terminal that connects to the battery and electrical system.
What do the callout numbers 1, 4, and 15 indicate in the ignition coil diagrams?
These are terminal numbers on the ignition coil: terminal 1 and 15 are connection terminals that need to be unscrewed, and terminal 4 is where the ignition lead connects.
What diagram numbers are shown for the voltage regulator removal steps?
What measurements should be taken on the distributor rotor?
Measure resistance in the distributor rotor, and check the distributor cap and rotor for cracks and traces of burning.
What are the three control units listed for 1986 models?
For 1986 models: 1 - Control unit for DME (see Gr. 13), 2 - Control unit for idle speed (see Gr. 13), 3 - Plug for car electric system, fuel pump relay.
Which terminal is designated for lead shielding?
Terminal S (terminal 9) is designated for lead shielding.
What type of waveform pattern should appear on the oscilloscope screen during testing?
The oscillograph should show a square wave pattern as illustrated in the diagram at the bottom left of the page.
How do you check the rotor coil for breaks and shorted turns?
Connect test leads for resistance test on slip rings using a BMW service tester.
Where should you check the code number and manufacturing date of the DME control unit?
Check code number and manufacturing date of DME control unit - see Group 13.
What voltage is used to check the power consumption of the activating and holding coils?
12V is used to check the power consumption of the activating and holding coils in the solenoid.
Where is the ground point for the engine electric system located?
It's shown in the center-right image and connects to the engine electrical system.
What tool size is needed to turn the crankshaft to TDC mark for ignition in cylinder no. 1?
A 30 mm wrench socket is needed to turn the crankshaft to TDC mark for ignition in cylinder no. 1.
How far should the gap be located from the TDC mark on the increment wheel?
Gap must be located 9 teeth away from the TDC mark in engine's direction of rotation.
How many carbon brushes need to be cut off from the leads?
Two carbon brushes must be cut off of the leads.
Which terminal carries the speed signal?
Terminal 1 (terminal 13) carries the speed signal.
What should good diodes display for polarity during negative diode testing?
"---" polarity.
Since what system introduction has BMW Diagnosis Test been used for engine electric troubleshooting?
BMW Diagnosis Test has been used since introduction of M 1.1 system.
How should I test the speed signal from the inductive pulse sender?
Check speed signal (one signal for each revolution) with an oscilloscope on the inductive pulse sender pins 47/48.
What must be aligned with the rubber part when separating the motor and gearbox?
Groove (3) must be aligned with rubber part (4).
At what RPM should the engine be cranked with the starter during the TCI control unit test?
Crank the engine with starter at approximately 250 rpm.
Where is the underneath trim panel mentioned in relation to the engine electric layout?
The underneath trim panel is mentioned in the glove box location for the Engine Electric Layout Model M 3 / S 14.
What is the status of terminals 27 and 36 in Motronic systems before 12.86?
Terminals 27 and 36 are not used in Motronic systems before 12.86.
What should be done to the commutator during carbon brush replacement?
Fine grind and polish commutator. File or machine insulation between commutator plates to depth of 0.5 to 0.7 mm (0.020 to 0.027").
How tight should screw (1) be tightened during the installation process?
Tighten screw (1) enough that the pliers can be pulled back.
If pin 37 shows low voltage with ignition on, what corrective action should I take?
Check / repair relay 2 (master relay) and electronics ground point.
What component number corresponds to the middle diagram showing the bearing installation?
The middle diagram showing the bearing installation corresponds to component number 630 12 172.
What causes the 'MV' lamp not to turn on during vacuum advance control testing?
No power supply for simulator, wire harness to simulator defective, or vacuum advance control relay defective.
What is the procedure number for replacing the ball bearing?
12 31 581 REPLACING BALL BEARING - Alternator Removed and Disassembled.
What should be checked after installing a TCI control unit?
Check ignition timing after installation, correcting if necessary.
What test equipment can be connected for performing engine test step 06?
Connect BMW service test unit or BMW digital tester.
What does the + symbol indicate for ignition timing adjustment?
The + symbol indicates advanced ignition timing.
On which page can I find troubleshooting information for the alternator?
Alternator troubleshooting information can be found on page 12-40.
What should be done if the reference mark sensor oscillograph deviates from the expected pattern?
If oscillograph deviates, remove sensor and check for dirt (grease, burrs, rust), cleaning if necessary. Check reference mark, replacing pin for flywheel if necessary.
What diagram number illustrates the diode plate with bolts to be unscrewed?
Diagram 630 12 173 illustrates the diode plate with bolts to be unscrewed.
What component is connected to terminal 17 on pre-1986 models?
Service indicator reset (SI)
What wire colors are used for the injection signal?
White/black wire colors are used for the TI (Injection signal).
What should be done if spark plug connectors fail resistance testing?
Replace shielded and/or spark plug connectors as specified in section 12 12 072.
What should you inspect spark plug connectors and shielded connectors for?
Check spark plug connectors and shielded connectors for damage, tightness and good contact.
Where can the nominal resistance value for the sender be found?
See Specifications (marked with an asterisk).
What page contains information about starter component electric testing?
Starter component electric testing information is found on page 12-152.
What diagnostic method is consistently used for checking signals in all three test procedures?
An oscilloscope is consistently used to check signals in all three test procedures.
How should ignition leads be handled during inspection to check for cracks?
Bend ignition leads in a tight radius and check for cracks.
If the charge lamp comes on after grounding the D+/61 connection, what's the next step?
Take off voltage regulator. Check carbon brushes, replacing if necessary - see 12 32 000. Check slip rings for dirt or oxidation coat.
What is the approximate distance 'V' for new condition carbon brushes?
The distance 'V' for new condition is approximately 12 mm (0.472 inches).
What reference number corresponds to the alternator disassembly diagram?
The alternator disassembly diagram is referenced as 30 12 035.
What should you check first when performing the fuel supply test?
You should first check fuel feed to electric fuel pump.
Which terminal handles the pulse transmitter function on the Siemens/Telefunken unit?
Terminal +/- handles the pulse transmitter function on the Siemens/Telefunken unit.
What should you check regarding the distributor rotor position before installation?
Check the position of distributor rotor - it should point to notch on distributor. Correct by turning crankshaft, if necessary.
What components need to be removed as washers (1 and 2), fan (3) and woodruff key (4)?
Take off washers (1 and 2), fan (3) and woodruff key (4) from the alternator rotor assembly.
What is the procedure number for replacing carbon brushes?
The procedure number is 12 31 200 REPLACING CARBON BRUSHES.
How does the fault lamp behave during the flashing code sequence?
The fault lamp will be switched off and on in accordance with the fault number, with different timing patterns for each code as shown in the diagram.
What inspection should be performed during installation?
Check condition of insulating sleeves and washers, replacing if necessary.
What inspection should be performed on the commutator?
Check commutator for wear, fine grinding if necessary. The diameter must be at least 33.5 mm and machine insulation between plates should be approximately 0.5 to 0.7 mm deep.
What page range covers TDC position transmitter replacement and checking procedures?
TDC position transmitter replacement and checking procedures are covered on page 12-130.
Which group contains information about the oxygen sensor/emission control and EGR?
The oxygen sensor/emission control and EGR information is found in Group 11.
What is the function of pin 7 in the 55 pin plug connections?
Pin 7 is for Signal LMM (Air flow sensor signal).
What should not be forgotten during alternator installation?
Don't forget the ground wire (see arrow).
What page number contains this troubleshooting information?
This troubleshooting information is on page 12-108.
What is the procedure code for disassembling and assembling the starter layshaft?
The procedure code is 12 41 513.
What is the wire color for the oil pressure signal?
Brown/green wire is used for the OELD (Oil pressure) signal.
What resistance measurement should I perform on the ground supply pins?
Measure resistance against battery negative or ground < 1 ohm on pins 2, 14, 19, 24 / body ground for ground supply for control unit.
What voltage should be checked on the TCI control unit terminal 1 when testing the ignition coil and power supply lead?
Check for voltage greater than 10 V on TCI control unit terminal 1 (M 01).
When is it necessary to check primary current according to the procedure?
Check primary current (M 03) - this is only necessary when the primary oscillograph deviates.
What is the component number for the bottom diagram illustration?
The bottom diagram illustration shows component number 30 12 039.
What is component number 1 in the top left image?
Component number 1 is the Control unit - L-Jetronic (see Gr. 13).
What reference numbers are associated with the DME control unit and fuel version plug?
Both the DME control unit and fuel version plug reference Group 13 (see Gr. 13).
What numbered components are being unscrewed in the solenoid replacement procedure?
Unscrew solenoid (1) and (2).
What dual inspection criteria are mentioned for both the exhaust system and crankcase vent tests?
Both tests require checking for tight fit and leaks.
What tool is required for unscrewing the nuts during starter removal?
Unscrew nuts with a starter wrench.
What is the requirement before performing Test 4 - TCI Control Unit?
Tests 1 through 3 must be completed and show no malfunction.
What simulator is used for testing the advance control relay and plug?
Advance control simulator 12 1 460
On the Siemens/Telefunken TCii-S Control Unit, what is terminal 1/16 connected to?
Terminal 1/16 is connected to the ignition coil.
What symptom indicates the starter does not turn but only clicks in solenoid?
Only click in solenoid heard when attempting to start.
What are the letter designations for the sensors that need to be disconnected on 1986 and later models?
Reference mark sensor B (gray) and speed sensor D.
What should you do if the indicator lamp stays on continuously?
Remove voltage regulator and check carbon brushes, replacing if necessary according to section 12 31 200. The distance 'V' for new condition is approximately 12 mm (0.472").
What is the reference number shown in the diagram?
The reference number shown in the diagram is 32 12 169.
How many main inspection points are listed for the intake system test?
There are three main inspection points: check intake manifold and air cleaner, check connections and caps, and replace dirty air cleaner filter element.
What correction is needed if regulating voltage is not as specified during insufficient charging diagnosis?
Replace voltage regulator - see section 12 32 000.
What type of distributor rotor should not be used for radio interference shielding?
Do not use a 5 k-ohm distributor rotor for the shielding of radio and/or communication equipment.
If the starter slips, what should I check on the flywheel?

Check gear ring teeth on flywheel. If teeth are damaged, remove transmission and replace flywheel. If teeth are okay, repair starter by checking drive pinion (one-way clutch), engaging mechanism, or planet gears faulty.
What is shown in diagram 23 12 031?
Diagram 23 12 031 shows the connector being placed on the ignition lead and inserted into Special Tool 12 1 091.
How does the wiring differ between Motronic with holding circuit and without holding circuit?

In the version with holding circuit, terminals 27 and 36 are used and connected. In the version without holding circuit before 12.86, terminals 27 and 36 are not used and show a ground connection at terminal 30.
What type of test equipment is needed for the multimeter test procedure?
A multimeter capable of measuring resistance is needed for test M 06 to measure primary and secondary coil resistance.
What should be done to prevent carbon brushes from popping out during installation?
Prevent the carbon brushes from popping out by inserting a 22 mm wrench socket or a pipe with an outside diameter of approx. 30 mm (1.181").
What does the flashing pattern show for Code 3?
Code 3 indicates a faulty engine temperature sensor.
What is the proper distance to maintain between the coil and insulation?
Maintain distance of 0.2 to 2.0 mm (0.008 to 0.080") to vibration damper.
What electrical connections are specifically mentioned in the disassembly procedure?
B+ and D+ studs.
How should the bearing race be removed from the shaft?
Push back bearing race (1) with a piece of suitable pipe, then pry circlip (2) apart and pull it off of the shaft.
What are the three numbered components visible in the ignition timing test diagram?
The diagram shows components labeled 1, 2, and 3, with component 1 appearing to be a timing light or measuring device.
What happens in step 1 when using the special tool to install the connector?
Unscrew screw (1), slide in ignition lead against stop, follow with pliers and slide in ignition lead further until connector is heard to engage.
What fasteners need to be removed for the solenoid switch replacement?
Unscrew bolt (1) and unscrew nut (2).
If the pulse sender on pins 47/48 is okay, but there's still no speed signal, what component should I replace?
If pulse sender (pins 47/48) is okay, replace DME control unit.
What should be applied to the rubber cap during installation to make it easier?
Give the rubber cap a thin coat of lubricant to make installation easier.
What reference is given for engine test/test step procedures?
Testing instructions refer to the BMW SERVICE TEST, e.g. engine test/test step 05 (P 05) or a multimeter function (M).
What should be checked during installation according to step 30 12 019?
Check seal (1), replacing if necessary during installation.
What components are shown in the Engine Electric Layout for Model M 3 / S 14?
The Engine Electric Layout shows: 1) DME control unit (see Gr. 13), 2) Car wire harness plug, 3) Air conditioner plug, and 4) Fuel version plug (see Gr. 13).
Which pins are used for the starter/engine plug connection?
Pin 15 is used for the starter/engine plug connection with black/green wire colors.
What numbered components are visible in the drive pinion assembly diagram?
The diagram shows components numbered 1, 2, and 3, where 1 is the bearing race, 2 appears to be a circlip, and 3 is the drive pinion.
Where must the pulling hook be positioned when using the belt tension tool?
This requires pulling hook (2) to be in center of teeth.
What polarity should display when testing positive diodes in perfect condition?
Display with perfect condition diodes shows polarity "+".
What does the 'S' designation mean in the TCI+S control unit marking?
The 'S' means ignition timing retard while starting.
Where should the TDC mark be positioned when checking the increment wheel?
TDC mark must be in middle of a tooth.
What voltage should I measure on pin 18 to ground for the battery positive supply to the control unit?
You should measure voltage ≈ 12 V on pin 18 to ground (19) for the battery positive supply for control unit.
What does the +/- designation refer to in the pulse transmitter connections?
The +/- designation refers to the positive and negative connections for the pulse transmitter signal.
What should you do to the holder and pole housing when replacing carbon brushes?
Take off holder and pole housing. Unsolder or cut off all carbon brushes.
What engine test step should be carried out when checking the ignition coil?
Carry out engine test step 09.
How do you access the distributor cap for removal?
Unscrew screws for distributor cap.
What section reference is provided for replacement parts and procedures?
Section 12 12 072 is referenced for ignition leads, connections, and spark plug connectors.
On 1986 and later models, what function does terminal 16 serve?
Diagnosis lead for airbag (terminal A)
Which pin number corresponds to the oil stat function?
Pin number 2 corresponds to the STAT (Oil stat) function.
What lubricant should be applied and to which tool components?
Spray a thin coat of lubricant 12 1 098 on the guiding sleeve of Special Tool 12 1 092.
What is the terminal designation for the alternator charge indicator in pre-1986 E30 models?
D+ (terminal 1)
What action should I take if regulating voltage is not okay during testing?
Replace voltage regulator - see section 12 32 000.
What safety caution is given before working on the ignition system?
Always turn off ignition before working on the ignition system - dangerous high voltage! Refer to page 12-0 for instructions for working on ignition system.
What reference is provided for ignition timing specifications?
See nominal value microfiche for ignition timing specifications.
What tool is required to check the fuel injector final stage signals?
An oscilloscope is required to check signal with.
Which terminal designation is used for the electric fuel pump on models since 1986?
EP (terminal 13)
What should you do if the increment wheel positioning is incorrect?
If not, replace vibration damper.
How should the sensors be prepared during installation?
Pull off protective sleeve (1), lift out clip (2), coat seals with Molykote paste, and keep grease and dirt off of face surface on sensors.
What precaution should be taken regarding the sensor face surfaces?
Keep grease and dirt off of face surface on sensors.
What is the main focus of Test 4?
Test 4 focuses on testing the high voltage distributor.
What should be done with the new carbon brushes after cutting them from the leads?
Solder in new carbon brushes.
What testing procedure is specified for replacing shielded connector and ignition lead contact on M3/M5/M6 models?
Pull off the shielded connector and unscrew the ignition lead, then measure shielded resistance for testing.
What wire color is used for Terminal 30 in the diagnosis socket connections?
Red wire is used for Terminal 30.
Which terminal carries the oxygen sensor signal?
Terminal L (terminal 5) carries the oxygen sensor signal.
What happens to the Motronic master relay when the ignition is switched off?
The Motronic master relay remains activated for another 3 seconds after switching off ignition lock terminal 15 and stopping the engine.
Which terminal provides power while starting on post-1986 models?
Terminal 18 (50)
What should be done during installation regarding the shims?
Take up axial play with shims (4) during installation.
What does PGSF stand for and what wire colors are used for its connection?
PGSF is for DME control unit programming and uses green/blue wire colors.
What are the key inspection points for spark plug testing in Test 3?
Check spark plugs for tight fit and leaks, and check insulator for signs of leakage current.
Where can instructions for working on the ignition system be found?
Refer to page 12-0 for instructions for working on ignition system.
What terminal number is used for the ground connection in the diagnosis plug?
Terminal 31 is used for the ground connection.
What wire color combination is used for the voltage while starting signal?
Black/yellow wire colors are used for the voltage while starting signal on pin 18.
Which page contains the procedure for replacing carbon brushes?
The procedure for replacing carbon brushes is on page 12-46.
What temperature does the temperature switch operate at for idle speed control?
The temperature switch operates at 45°C (113°F) for idle speed control.
What component fault is indicated by Code 2?
Code 2 indicates a faulty oxygen sensor.
How should the carbon brush holder be positioned during installation?
Slide carbon brush holder to center and lift off.
Which relay is numbered as position 1 in the relay survey?
Position 1 is the Master relay.
What are the testing requirements before troubleshooting the starter?
Correct connections on battery and starter, good ground connection between engine and body, and charged battery.
What should you do if the distributor needs to be repaired or replaced?
Repair or replace distributor if necessary according to section 12 11.
What pin on the universal adaptor is used to test the ignition final stage?
Pin 1 (term. 1) / ground is used to test the ignition final stage.
What diagnostic tool is mentioned for accomplishing engine electric troubleshooting?
BMW Diagnosis Test is mentioned for accomplishing engine electric troubleshooting since introduction of M 1.1.
What visual inspections should be performed on spark plugs?
Check for cracks and traces of burning, check spark plugs for electrode erosion and electrode gap, and check insulator for traces of burning.
What components are visible in the bottom alternator image with D+ and B+ markings?
The alternator electrical connections showing the D+ and B+ terminals where the leads connect.
How many terminals are numbered in the bottom connector diagram?
Six terminals are numbered (1 through 6) in the bottom connector diagram.
What should you do first when checking vacuum advance control?
Take off protective cap, then remove advance control relay and pull off plug.
What torque specification is given for tightening the alternator drive belt?
Unscrew nut and turn tensioning wheel with a torque of approx. 7 Nm (5 ft. lbs.).
What are the three relays shown in the bottom left image used for?
The three relays are: 1 - Relay for fuel injection, fuel pump, oxygen sensor heating; 2 - Relay for idle speed stabilization (see Group 13); 3 - Relay for ignition switchover.
What type of ignition system is shown for the non-disconnectable spark plug connector version?
The non-disconnectable version is for a 30 kV System, and the ignition lead should be cut off as shown.
What type of gasoline should be specified in the tank according to the testing requirements?
Specified gasoline in tank (octane number, leaded/unleaded, not contaminated).
What sensors are connected to the plugs labeled B and D in the bottom right image?
Plug B connects to the reference mark sensor and plug D connects to the speed sensor.
What does LLR stand for in the abbreviations list?
LLR stands for Idle speed control according to the explanations section.
What is prohibited regarding battery and alternator/starter connections while the engine is running?
Never disconnect the battery or leads on the alternator and starter while engine is running.
Which components need to be removed before accessing the alternator?
Remove air cleaner and air flow sensor.
What should you check regarding the carrier plate connections?
Check arrangement of carrier plate connections as shown.
What should be done with the bearing surface for pinion during installation?
Clean bearing surface for pinion thoroughly and lubricate with grease.
What maintenance should be performed on the contact surfaces during regulator installation?
Clean contact surfaces and check tension of spring contacts, correcting if necessary.
What is the section number and title for this voltage regulator procedure?
Section 12 32 000 - Removing and Installing or Replacing Voltage Regulator.
What measurement specification is given for the carbon brush distance in new condition?
The distance 'V' for new condition carbon brushes is approximately 12 mm (0.472 inches).
What does Code 1 indicate in the flashing code output?
Code 1 indicates a faulty air flow sensor.
What should you check during installation of the diode plate?
Check condition of insulating sleeves and insulators during installation.
What distance measurement is indicated by dimension 'A' in the pulse transmitter installation?
Dimension 'A' indicates the distance between pulse transmitter and pulse transmitter gear that should be checked and adjusted if necessary.
What condition indicates that the voltage regulator needs to be replaced?

If the battery charge indicator lamp goes out while engine is running and the regulating voltage is not reached, with harmonic wave ratio and oscillograph appearing okay, the voltage regulator has to be replaced.
What oscillograph pattern indicates defective power or exciter diodes?
The oscillograph shows a pattern with irregular square waves that have varying heights, indicating defective power or exciter diode condition.
What is the result if ignition timing check shows 'no' in Test 6a?
If the ignition timing check shows 'no', replace the DME control unit.
What reference part number is shown for one of the components?
Part number 320 12 047 is shown for one of the components.
What should you connect when troubleshooting the vacuum advance control system?
Connect vacuum advance control simulator 12 1 460 and run engine at idle speed.
What type of test lead is specified for connecting to the DME control unit?
A universal adapter with (35-pin) test lead is specified for connecting to the DME control unit.
What three functions does terminal TD serve on the Siemens/Telefunken unit?
Terminal TD connects to fuel pump relay, to L-Jetronic control unit, and to tachometer.
What are the testing requirements before checking the alternator and voltage regulator?
The testing requirements are: correct connections on charged battery, correct connections on alternator and starter, good ground connection between engine and body, and tight drive belt.
What component is labeled 'B' in the upper photograph?
Component 'B' is the reference mark sensor, which is marked with a ring.
What safety precaution is emphasized when handling the voltage regulator?
The voltage regulator should be taken off carefully and installed with careful positioning to avoid damage.
How should you remove the diagnosis socket from its holder?
Open lid on diagnosis socket, lift clips (1 and 2) and press diagnosis socket out of holder.
If flywheel teeth are okay but starter still slips, what are the repair options?
Repair starter: A) Drive pinion (one-way clutch) or B) Engaging mechanism.
What is the minimum diameter specification for the commutator?
The diameter must be at least 33.5 mm (1.319 inches).
What component connects to pin 8 and what are its wire colors?
The DME control unit/idle speed control connects to pin 8 with white/green wire colors.
What is the wire color for the temperature gage ground?
Brown/yellow wire is used for FTM (Temperature gage ground).
What should you check when bending ignition leads in a tight radius?
Check for cracks and traces of burning, and also check connection and tightness of plugs and connections.
What special tool is required to hold the pulley when removing the alternator on the 80 A unit?
Special Tool 12 31 000 is required to hold the pulley when removing the alternator.
What is the difference between pins 6 and 7 regarding ignition voltage?
Pin 6 provides voltage with ignition on with fuse protection (green/white), while pin 7 is the same as pin 6 but without fuse protection (green).
What is the proper installation sequence for the voltage regulator?
Mount regulator at first with one bolt screwed on finger tight, then press alternator to final installed position carefully, install and tighten all bolts.
What coolant system maintenance is required during starter removal?
Drain coolant. Disconnect heater hoses. Unscrew starter mounting nuts. Bottom nut could also be unscrewed from below for better accessibility.
How much should the end of the ignition lead be stripped and what wire size is required?
Strip the end of the ignition lead by 6 mm with stripping pliers for 1.5 mm wire cross section size.
How should you handle the copper leads when soldering in new carbon brushes?
When soldering in new carbon brushes, make sure that copper leads are not hardened with flowing solder.
What should you do to test the ignition final stage signal?
Crank engine with starting motor and check signal with an oscilloscope.
What should be done after adjusting the belt tension?
Recheck tightness with the tester, correcting if necessary.
What should you check first when troubleshooting speed and reference mark sensors?
Check wires for tight fit and damage, then check connections and arrangement of plug connections.
Where is the diagnosis socket located according to the layout?
The diagnosis socket is component number 3 in the layout.
What callout numbers are shown in the carbon brush replacement diagram?
The diagram shows callout numbers 1 through 5, indicating mounting bolts (1), dust cap (2), lock washer (3), shims (4), and seal (5).
Which BMW models are covered in this Engine Electrical Equipment section?
Models 325, 325 e, 325 es, 325 i, and M 3 are covered in this section.
What potential damage should be monitored when using the special bearing puller tool?
Monitor for damage to the bearing cover caused by the special tool while pulling off the bearing.
Where can additional service information be found according to the bottom of the page?
See Service Information of Gr. 00
What temperature should the coolant temperature switch be checked at?
The coolant temperature switch should be checked at a temperature below 45°C (113°F).
How is the reference mark sensor (B) identified?
Reference mark sensor (B) is marked with a ring - see 12 14 510 / 515.
What resistance measurements should be checked with the BMW service tester?
Check resistance (M 06) and oscillograph (M 22/23) on disconnected pulse sensor plug with BMW service tester, see 12 14 510.
What type of engine management system is shown in these wiring diagrams?
M 1.1 Motronic engine management system is shown in these wiring diagrams.
Which pin number is designated for the crankshaft position sensor?
Pin 10 is designated for the crankshaft position sensor (Crankshaft position sensor).
What are the four numbered components shown in the gearbox unit diagram?
1 - Planet gearbox, 2 - Release, 3 - Pinion, 4 - Gearbox case.
What testing equipment is specified for checking ignition timing?
Connect BMW service tester or BMW digital tester to operating instructions.
Which terminals on the plug should the BMW service test unit be connected to for checking the pulse transmitter?
Connect BMW service test unit (M 06) or ohmmeter on plug pins terminals 5 and 6 of the plug.
What should be checked during installation regarding insulating sleeves and washers?
Check condition of insulating sleeves and washers, replacing if necessary.
Where can resistance values for coolant temperature and intake air temperature transmitters be found?
The resistance values for the coolant temperature and intake air temperature transmitters can be taken at the jacks and are referenced in the Specifications section.
How are critical emission control faults displayed to the driver?
Critical emission control relevant faults are displayed in the instrument cluster by the 'Check Engine' control lamp coming on and staying on continuously.
What are the three components listed in the Relay Survey?
The Relay Survey lists: 1 = ECU, 2 = Electric fuel pumps, 3 = Oxygen sensor.
When was the holding circuit introduced in the Motronic system?
The holding circuit was introduced since 12.86 (December 1986).
What should you do after unsoldering the stator coil?
Unscrew screws and take out diode plate.
What components are shown in the rubber mount layout diagram?
The layout shows: 1 Circlip, 2 Washer, 3 Rubber mount, 4 Washer, 5 Bushing.
What is the reference number for the procedure to check the pulse transmitter in distributor?
The reference number is 150 for checking the pulse transmitter in distributor.
What caution is given about opening the pliers during installation?
Opening the pliers too much could cause the plug receptacle to break. The plug receptacle is shown cut open for better demonstration.
What lubricant should be applied before installing the solenoid switch?
Lubricate with grease before installing.
Which direction should you turn when unscrewing the fan?
Unscrew fan — left-hand threads!
What type of current leakage should be checked on spark plug insulators?
Check the insulator for signs of leakage current, which could indicate spark plug deterioration or contamination.
What component needs to be removed along with the air flow sensor on M3 models?
Take off air cleaner with air flow sensor. Remove intake manifold and air cleaner - see 11 61 050.
What does the middle diagram 630 12 173 illustrate?
The diode plate with arrows pointing to the screws that need to be unscrewed for removal.
If the engine doesn't run during the ignition timing test, what should you check first?

Check the position of the distributor - move piston in cylinder no. 1 to ignition position; mark on distributor housing must be aligned with contact on distributor rotor according to section 12 11 060.
What wire colors are associated with the air conditioner plug?
The air conditioner plug (item 5) uses wire colors: blue/white.
What terminals need to have their nuts unscrewed when removing the diode plate?
Unscrew nuts on B + and D + terminals when removing the diode plate.
What is the resistance range specification for the rotor coil on an 80 A alternator?
For an 80 A alternator, the rotor coil resistance should be 2.8 to 3.0 ohms.
What should be checked if the nominal coil resistance value is not achieved?
If nominal value is not reached, check plug connection on distributor or, if necessary, replace pulse transmitter coil.
What section of the manual covers troubleshooting engine electric and DME?
Section 12-108 covers troubleshooting engine electric and DME.
What component is visible in the bottom diagram labeled '30 12 042'?
The diagram shows the internal housing with multiple circular openings, likely for windings or electrical connections.
What final step is required after completing the installation?
Complete installation and adjust ignition timing according to section 12 11 005.
What should I do if the charge indicator lamp is not on with ignition turned on?

Pull off connection plug D+/61 and connect with ground (term. 31). If charge lamp comes on, check connections and wires for charge indicator lamp or replace light bulb. If charge lamp doesn't come on, take off voltage regulator, check carbon brushes and replace if necessary, then check slip rings for dirt or oxidation coat.
What components are numbered 1 through 5 in the bottom image labeled 30 12 306?
The components are: 1) Diagnosis socket, 2) Engine wire harness plug, 3) Position sender plug, 4) Reference mark plug (gray), and 5) Speed sender plug.
What is the first step before accessing the sensors?
Unscrew shield.
How do you remove the distributor rotor?
Unscrew distributor rotor. During installation, apply tightening torque as specified in specifications.
What should be done if coolant level or concentration needs attention?
If necessary, fill and bleed cooling system according to the procedures in Group 17.
What is the reference number for the image showing the DME control unit location?
The reference number is 30 12 923.
Which terminal number corresponds to the power supply connection in the TCI+S control unit?
Terminal 15 corresponds to the power supply connection.
What procedure is referenced for alternator component inspection?
What components are checked for erratic idling during warm-up phase?

For erratic idling during warm-up phase (symptom 6), check the speed sensor/reference mark sensor, ignition coil, spark plugs, high voltage distributor, ignition lead connectors and leads, and DME control unit/ignition timing.
Can you disconnect the battery or alternator leads while the engine is running?
No, never disconnect the battery or leads on the alternator and starter while engine is running.
Where can specifications for the resistance measurements be found?
See Specifications section for detailed resistance measurement values.
What lubrication procedure is specified for bearing sleeve installation?
Lubricate sleeve with oil after pressing in.
Which pin connections should be checked for voltage during the power supply test?
Check voltage of pins, e.g. on connections 17 (-) and 35 (+).
What are the three main components in the arrangement for the pulse transmitter assembly?
The arrangement consists of: 12 Insulator, 13 Pulse transmitter, and 14 Carrier plate.
What wire color and size is used for terminal 87 in the Master Relay?
Terminal 87 uses red/white wire with size 0.75/4 mm².
How do you access the pulse sender for removal?
Disconnect plug M 20. Note: Remove guard rail on face.
What are the key failure indicators to look for during both distributor and spark plug inspections?
The key failure indicators are cracks and traces of burning, which should be checked on all ignition system components.
What are the three numbered components that need to be removed according to image 30 12 015?
The three numbered components are: (1) the plug, (2) clamp, and (3) another clamp that need to be lifted off to remove the distributor cap.
What activation check is performed for relay 2?
Turn on ignition to check activation for relay 2, and verify that terminals 85 (-) and 86 (+) should have voltage (approx. 12 V).
What must be done to check belt tightness after installation?
Recheck tightness with tester, correcting if necessary.
What should be done if the bearing sleeve needs to be removed?
Check bearing sleeve, removing with a suitable puller if necessary.
What voltage should be present on connection terminals 15 and 31 when testing the TCI control unit voltage supply?
Approximately 12 V should be present on connection terminals 15 and 31.
What are the final two steps for M 20 engine sender replacement?
Take off leads and plug on new sender.
What connections need to be unscrewed from the alternator?
Unscrew connections B + and D +, and disconnect ground wire.
Where can additional information about installing the shielded connector be found?
See 12 12 072 in Group 12.
What cross-reference is given for tightening the drive belt?
Tighten drive belt - 12 31 299.
How many terminals are shown as unused (marked with dashes) on the pre-1986 engine wire harness plug?
7 terminals are unused (terminals 11, 12, 13, 14, 18, 19)
What components should be checked in addition to the ignition final stage?
Power supply for ignition coil, ignition coil, distributor and leads, and spark plugs should be checked.
What should you do after finishing the installation of the pulse transmitter?
Adjust ignition timing according to section 12 11 005 after finishing installation.
What should be done with the clamping jaws during the installation process?
Move clamping jaws together by turning screw against stop during the installation process.
What should you check on the slip rings if the rotor coil ground contact test fails?
Check slip rings, fine grinding if necessary - see 12 31 200.
What does the abbreviation ASC stand for in the pin connections table?
ASC stands for Autom. Stability Control according to the explanations section.
Which pin number corresponds to the D+ alternator charge indicator in the diagnosis socket?
Pin 12 corresponds to the D+ alternator charge indicator.
What signs of damage should be looked for on ignition lead contacts?
Look for traces of burning, cracks, and oxidation on the connection plate and ignition lead contacts.
What components should be removed from the cap according to M 21 12 040?
Take off cap, take off retainer (1) and shims (2).
Why must ignition coil terminal 1 wire not be connected to ground or B+?
The ignition coil term. 1 wire must not be used to prevent engine starting when service installing a burglar alarm system.
What alternative method is mentioned for accessing the bottom starter mounting nut?
Bottom nut could also be unscrewed from below for better accessibility.
What steps should be taken to check the DME control unit wires?
Take off trim panel, pull off plug on control unit and connect on universal adapter with (35-pin) test lead - see illustration. Check power flow and insulation (M 06) in wires on specified pins.
What are the testing requirements before troubleshooting the Transistor Coil Ignition system?
Battery charged (voltage > 12 V), specified fuel in tank (octane rating lead content), and ambient temperature approximately 20°C (68°F) - considerable deviation would change the measured values.
What happens to the TCI control unit if it malfunctions?
The TCI control unit is no longer ready for operation in case of malfunction.
What symptoms are associated with CO/HC not being correct?

CO/HC not correct (symptom 15) can be associated with various engine problems and requires checking multiple test positions including oxygen sensor/emission control, active carbon filter/purge valve, fuel supply, intake system, catalytic converter, and crankcase vent/air hoses.
Which studs need to be unscrewed after removing the shielded capacitor?
Unscrew nuts on B+ and D+ studs.
What does a shorted turn of stator coil look like on an oscillograph?
A shorted turn of stator coil appears as a pattern with uneven square wave peaks, where some peaks are significantly lower than others.
What cross-reference is mentioned for slip ring grinding and polishing?
The slip ring grinding and polishing is referenced as part of Pos. 12 31 201.
What temperature should the engine oil be at when checking ignition timing?
The engine should be at operating temperature with oil temperature at 80°C (140°F).
What can be used to check for shorted turns in the stator coil?
A standard tester can be used for checking for shorted turns.
What final test should be performed after installing the connector?
After squeezing, release jaws and take out the ignition lead, then perform a tear-out test by hand with a tearing-out force of greater than or equal to 200 N / 44 lbs.
What is the title of Test 16?
Test 16 is titled INTAKE SYSTEM.
What should you check the pulse sender for during inspection?
Check pulse sender for tight fit and damage.
What is shown in the bottom connector diagram with terminals numbered 1-6?
The bottom diagram shows another connector configuration with 6 terminals arranged in a circular pattern.
What ignition timing difference should you note when comparing vacuum hose connection states?
Note difference in ignition timing between disconnected and connected vacuum hose - 13 to 17° before TDC on crankshaft.
Which terminal provides battery positive voltage?
Terminal 30 (terminal 14) provides battery positive voltage.
How do you read out the fault codes from the system?
Fault codes can be read out with the help of a flashing code prior to starting the engine with the ignition key in 'ignition on' position.
What are the first steps for replacing carbon brushes with the starter removed?
Unscrew mounting bolts (1), remove dust cap (2), remove lock washer (3), shims (4) and seal (5).
What component should be removed along with the stator coil?
Take off diode plate with stator coil.
What should I do if the battery is charged insufficiently with charge indicator lamp off while engine running?
Connect BMW service test unit and perform engine test (P 102). Check battery and replace if necessary, then check power drain with equipment switched off.
How do you separate the alternator housing sections?
Mark the housing sections to each other, then unscrew bolts and pull housing sections apart.
What should you do if the ignition coil resistance check is not okay?
Replace the ignition coil. If casting compound has run out or is missing, also replace the TCI control unit.
What should you inspect on the pinion for signs of wear?
Check bearing sleeve and teeth of pinion for wear.
What should be done with screw (1) to ensure the pliers can be pulled back?
Tighten screw (1) enough that the pliers can be pulled back.
What should never be connected to terminal 1 of the ignition coil?
Never connect a shielded capacitor or test lamp on term. 1 of the ignition coil.
What test step should be performed for engine checking?
Connect BMW service test unit according to operating instructions and perform test step '08 Engine'.
What resistance values should be identical when checking stator coil for breaks?
The resistance values of wires 1/2, 1/3 and 2/3 should be identical when tested with an ohmmeter.
What is the reference number for the first image showing the relay survey?
The reference number is 30 12 914.
How many pins does the connecting lead have for the universal adaptor connection?
55-pin connecting leads.
What needs to be done to remove the pole housing?
Unscrew engaging lever bolt and remove rubber seal.
What reference should you consult for nominal values during testing?
You should see the nominal value microfiche for the specific test values to compare against when using the BMW service test unit.
What length should the wire be bent to when making a new connection?
Bend the wire at a length of about 6 mm (1/4 inch).
Which terminal number is used for the starting pulse for starter?
Terminal 50 is used for the starting pulse for starter.
What is the first step in alternator removal according to this page?
Remove the voltage regulator first, then hold the pulley with Special Tool 12 31 000 and unscrew the nut.
What causes lights to remain on while starting when the starter doesn't turn?
A) Carbon brushes worn or B) Solenoid defective.
Which components should be checked for symptom 1 (cold engine will not start)?

For cold engine will not start, check the speed sensor/reference mark sensor, ignition coil, spark plugs, high voltage distributor, ignition lead connectors and leads, and DME control unit/ignition timing.
What are the main components to check for leaks in Test 19?
Hoses for crankcase vent and oil dipstick should be checked for leaks.
How is the component marked on the increment wheel?
The component is marked with number (1) on the increment wheel.
What should be done if a diode is found to be faulty?
Replace entire diode plate in case of a faulty diode - see 12 31 691.
What is the wire color for the coolant temperature gauge connection?
The coolant temperature gauge uses brown/violet wire colors on pin 4.
How do you check negative diodes using a diode test?
Connect test leads for diode test with negative lead on cooler and positive lead on one of the negative diode connections. Display with perfect condition diodes shows polarity "-".
What important note is given about soldering when replacing carbon brushes?
Only use a small amount of solder for soldering to prevent hardening of leads.
What is the first step in Test 1 for the pulse sensor in distributor?
Crank engine with starter and check pulse sensor voltage using multimeter M 02.
What is the procedure number for checking the ignition coil?
The procedure number for checking the ignition coil is 12 13 009.
Where can I find instructions for working on transistor coil ignition systems?
Refer to page 12-0 for instructions for working on transistor coil ignition systems.
What component is identified by the blue temperature gauge reference?
The coolant temperature sensor (DME) blue temperature gauge is shown in the upper right image.
What is the proper installation procedure for the sensor plugs?
Pull off plugs on speed sensor (D) and reference mark sensor (B), then press plug of sensor first out of holder. For installation, plug marked with tape belongs to gray plug.
What type of alternator is being serviced in this procedure?
Bosch Alternators.
What is the proper way to engage the carbon brush holder during installation?
Engage hooks of carbon brush holder completely.
Where can operating instructions for connections be found?
See operating instructions for connections, and refer to engine wiring diagram and HWB (= Division of BMW) specifications.
How should the shielded capacitor be removed?
Unscrew the shielded capacitor to remove it.
What components should be checked during the electric test of starter components?
Check exciter coil, carbon brush holder and armature coil for ground contact, and check armature for shorted turns using a standard tester.
What diagram number shows the ball bearing replacement procedure?
Diagram 630 12 171 shows the ball bearing replacement procedure.
Which page contains the holding circuit diagram?
The holding circuit diagram can be found on page 12-107/4.
What chapter number covers Engine Electrical Equipment in this manual?
Chapter 12 covers Engine Electrical Equipment.
What lubricant should be used and what is its source of supply?
The lubricant specified has HWB as the source of supply, as noted in the specifications reference.
How should you check for shorted turns in the exciter coil?
Check armature for shorted turns with a standard tester.
What does it mean if I only hear a click in the solenoid when trying to start?
Turn on lights. If lights go out while starting, there's a short in starter. If lights remain on while starting, check for carbon brushes worn or solenoid faulty.
When is a fault automatically cancelled from the system memory?
A fault is cancelled in the memory after repairing automatically after the engine has been started five or at the most ten times.
What are the two main tests described for ignition system troubleshooting?
Test 5 covers distributor cap/rotor and ignition leads, while Test 6 covers spark plugs and connectors.
What type of alternator is specifically mentioned in the bearing replacement procedure?
Bosch Alternators are specifically mentioned in the bearing replacement procedure.
What is the procedure code for replacing the ball bearing with the alternator removed and disassembled?
The procedure code is 12 31 581.
What is the first step in removing the distributor cap?
Take off cap (1) as shown in step 30 11 001.
What should be inspected if the distributor cap only needs to be removed and not replaced?
Check points and slip ring carbon brushes. Inspect inside for hairline cracks.
What does the oscillograph pattern show for a defective alternator with defective power or exciter diode?
The oscillograph shows an irregular waveform pattern with uneven peaks and valleys, indicating defective power or exciter diode operation.
What components are shown in the top diagram labeled 630 12 178?
The complete alternator assembly with the stator coil that needs to be unsoldered from the diode plate.
What terminals are shown in the M 1.1 Motronic component diagram?
Terminals 27, 32, and 36 are shown in the M 1.1 Motronic component diagram.
What page covers starter disassembly and assembly procedures?
Page 12-52 covers starter disassembly and assembly procedures.
What wire colors are specified for the transmission versions plug?
The transmission versions plug (item 4) uses wire colors: green/yellow and blue/brown, and is not used for automatics (lean mixture) but connected for manuals.
What should be done to the connecting rod during installation of the pulse transmitter?
Lubricate connecting rod with grease at opening during installation.
How many relays are visible in the relay survey diagram?
There are 3 relays visible in the relay survey diagram.
What is the safety concern when working on the electrical system during charging or welding?
There is dangerous primary and secondary voltage as well as danger of destroying the ignition system.
What is shown in diagram 630 12 179?
Diagram 630 12 179 shows the installation check for the condition of insulating sleeves and insulators.
What page contains information about starter troubleshooting?
Page 12-50 contains information about starter troubleshooting.
How do you correct ignition timing if adjustment is necessary?
Correct by loosening the bolt and turning the distributor accordingly.
What reference is provided for specific coil resistance values?
See Specifications for the specific coil resistance values, as indicated by the asterisk and note at the bottom of the page.
What should you do when checking compression on TCI or DME systems?
When checking the compression, pull off plug on control unit for TCI or master relay for fuel injection (relay no. 2) for DME.
How do you perform the stator coil break test?
Compare resistance values of leads 1/2, 1/3 and 2/3 with an ohmmeter - they should be the same.
What reference section should be consulted after finishing the distributor installation?
Adjust ignition timing (see 12 11 005) after finishing installation.
What is shown in the bottom left image with callouts D and B?
The image shows the location of speed sensor D and reference mark sensor B that need to be disconnected on 1986 and later models.
What callout numbers are visible in the alternator component inspection diagram?
The alternator inspection diagram shows callout numbers 1 and 2 pointing to different components of the alternator assembly.
What components are connected to terminal TD in the TCI+S control unit?
Terminal TD connects to fuel pump relay, to L-Jetr. control unit, and to tachometer.
What is the source of supply for the starter wrench mentioned in the procedure?
Source of Supply: HWB.
What is the acceptable range for machine insulation between plates on the commutator?
Machine insulation between plates should be approximately 0.5 to 0.7 mm (0.020 to 0.028 inches) deep.
Which two terminals are used for TDC position transmitter signals?
Terminals P+ (terminal 8) and P- (terminal 10) are used for TDC position transmitter signals.
Where can additional information about coolant concentration be found?
See Service Information of Group 00.
What is the function of terminal A in the diagnosis plug?
Terminal A (terminal 6) is the diagnosis lead for airbag.
What cross-reference is provided for voltage regulator replacement procedures?
The cross-reference is section 12 32 000 for voltage regulator replacement procedures.
How many installation diagrams are shown for the ball bearing replacement procedure?
Three installation diagrams are shown for the ball bearing replacement procedure.
What is the main subject being covered in this section?
The main subject is replacing ball bearings with the alternator removed and disassembled.
What should you do if the coolant temperature switch is checked below 45°C?
Pull off plug on idle control unit (in glove box above L-Jetronic control unit).
What are the terminal numbers for checking voltage on relay 2?
Terminals 85 (-) and 86 (+) should have voltage (approximately 12 V).
What components should be checked for ground contact in the starter electrical test?
Check exciter coil, carbon brush holder and armature coil for ground contact.
What is the procedure reference number for tightening the drive belt during installation?
Tighten drive belt 12 31 299.
What is the alternative to using BMW Diagnosis Tester according to the footnote?
Alternatively with BMW Diagnosis Tester.
What should be checked regarding the intermediate bearing sleeve?
Check sleeve in intermediate bearing, replacing if necessary.
What part number reference corresponds to the distributor rotor checking procedure?
Part number reference 30 12 079 corresponds to the distributor rotor checking procedure.
What engine designation is associated with the DME control unit shown?
The engine designation is M20.
After checking the fuel feed to the electric fuel pump, what component should be inspected?
You should check the filter screen in fuel intake, and also refer to Group 16.
What is connected to pin 13 and what wire colors does it use?
The electric fuel pump connects to pin 13 using green/violet wire colors.
What are the four temperature-related components labeled 1-4 in the engine compartment image?
1 - Temperature switch 45°C (113°F) for idle speed control, 2 - Coolant temperature sensor for DME, 3 - Temperature transmitter, 4 - Temperature time switch.
What should I do if the pulse sender resistance is within specification but there's still a problem?
Repair leads, replacing pulse sender if necessary.
What are the terminal numbers for the primary coil resistance measurement?
Terminal 1/15 for the primary coil.
What components are numbered 4, 5, and 6 in the bearing cover diagram?
4 - Bearing cover, 5 - Washers, 6 - Bearing sleeve.
What cross-reference is given for removing the solenoid?
Remove solenoid - see 12 41 041.
What should be done with pin 3 after removing the solenoid and spring?
Check pin (3) for wear and lubricate with grease.
What ignition timing control components should be checked with centrifugal force and vacuum?
Check ignition timing control with centrifugal force and vacuum according to procedures P 07 / 08.
Where can I find information about the 55-pin plug connections?
Information about 55-pin plug connections can be found on page 12-107/3.
What component is labeled as number 1 in the top right engine bay photo?
Temperature switch with 45° C (113° F) for idle speed control.
What components need to be disconnected in the third step shown in the images?
Unscrew holder and disconnect lines.
What lubrication is specified for the engaging fork during installation?
Lubricate guide for engaging fork with grease.
Can the dwell angle be adjusted on this ignition system?
No, the dwell angle is given by design and can be checked, but not adjusted.
What bracket needs to be unscrewed during starter removal?
Unscrew bracket for air collector.
What component is indicated by callout number 4 in the diagram?
Component number 4 points to a part on the lower distributor assembly, likely related to the ignition system components.
How do you test the stator coil for ground contact?
Connect test leads for resistance test on solder point and stator (coil carrier). The nominal value should be infinity (∞ = 999 k-ohm display).
What is the first step to replace the diode plate on the alternator?
Unscrew bolts and remove diode plate.
Which measurement method should be used to check distributor rotor resistance?
Check resistance using measurement method M 06 of distributor rotor.
What needs to be pressed on the rotor and what should be checked?
Press on rotor (1) and take off washer (3). Check installed position of washer (3).
What terminals should be measured for resistance during the multimeter test (M 06)?
Measure resistance of primary coil (terminal 1/15) and secondary coil (terminal 15/4).
What is the part number for the voltage regulator on the Alternator 80 A?
The voltage regulator part number is 12 32 000.
What is the procedure for final alternator removal?
Unscrew leads, then remove alternator.
What should you inspect on the slip rings during this procedure?
Check slip rings for wear, fine grinding if necessary.
What safety precaution must be taken before working on the distributor cap?
Always turn off ignition before working on dangerous high voltage ignition systems!
What are the possible causes when there is no advance control during testing?
Vacuum advance control relay defective, connections or wire harness for solenoid defective.
What electrical measurements should be performed on the ignition coil?
Check resistance (M 06) and inductivity (M 07) of primary and secondary coils, with specifications found in section 12 13 009.
What is the proper clearance for the TDC position transmitter installation?
The clearance A should be 0.2 to 2.0 mm (0.008 to 0.080").
What should you check if the wire from ignition coil terminal 1 to control unit is not okay?
Check the wire from ignition coil terminal 1 to control unit for breaks and ground out (M 06).
What repairs are needed if the starter gear ring teeth are damaged?
Remove transmission and replace flywheel.
What important caution is given when unsoldering the stator coil on the diode plate?
Excessive heat from soldering iron could destroy the diodes.
What is the first step when replacing the cylinder identifying sender?
Take off cover.
According to the application information, what might be necessary even after checking causes of malfunction?
Under certain circumstances additional tests could be necessary, as the checked causes of malfunction might not always be sufficient to eliminate a defect.
What is Test 5 focused on testing?
Test 5 is focused on testing ignition leads and lead connectors.
Which cars does the exciter coil checking procedure not apply to?
Checking exciter coil is not applicable to cars with permanent magnets (M 3).
What are the diagram reference numbers for the relay socket configurations?
The relay socket configurations are referenced as 32 12 140 for all three relay types shown.
What is the warning about opening the pliers too much?
Opening the pliers too much could cause the plug receptacle to break. The plug receptacle is shown cut open for better illustration.
Which function is only available for US models?
CARB (Fault display only for US models) on pin 12 is only available for US models.
What color wires are used for the service indicator reset connection?
White/green wires are used for the service indicator reset connection.
What is the procedure number for replacing the diode plate?
12 31 691 REPLACING DIODE PLATE - Alternator Removed and Disassembled.
What caution is given regarding the wire between battery and alternator?
Disconnect wire between battery and alternator only when engine is stopped.
Which terminal provides ground connection on the Bosch TCii Control Unit?
Terminal 31 provides the ground connection.
What wire color is used for the generator charge indicator connection?
Blue wire is used for the generator charge indicator connection on pin 1.
Which fuel injector groups are mentioned for pins 16 and 17?
Pin 16 is for Fuel injector group 2 (cylinders 1, 3, 5) and pin 17 is for Fuel injector group 1 (cylinders 2, 4, 6).
What page covers the engine electric layout for M 3 models?
The engine electric layout for M 3 models is covered on page 12-106.
What additional components should be tested for the fuel injector circuits?
Plug connections and leads for fuel injectors, and fuel injectors should be tested.
What should you inspect on the intake manifold during Test 16?
Check intake manifold and air cleaner for tight fit and damage.
Which pin number corresponds to the ignition terminal 1 connection?
Pin number 1 corresponds to the ignition terminal 1 connection.
How many main procedural steps are shown for disassembly?
Three steps: unscrew shielded capacitor, unscrew nuts on B+ and D+ studs, and take off diode plate with stator coil.
What voltage should be applied when checking the power input of engaging and holding coils?
12V should be applied when checking the power input of engaging and holding coils in the solenoid switch.
What procedure section is covered by reference number 12 41 513?
Disassembling and assembling starter with the starter removed.
When should the armature be checked for shorted turns?
Check armature for shorted turns after repairing.
What should be checked during axial play inspection?
Check axial play, correcting if necessary.
What color is specified for the reference mark plug?
The reference mark plug is specified as gray in color.
How should the distributor shaft be positioned during pulse transmitter installation?
Press distributor shaft in direction of pulse transmitter tooth (stator) and check pulse transmitter distance (A), correcting by loosening and centering the carrier plate.
What is the purpose of component number 5 in the top right image?
Component number 5 is the Temperature switch for ignition switchover and idle speed control.
Which terminal designation is used for the temperature gage signal?
Terminal FT is used for the temperature gage signal.
What is the terminal number for the alternator charge indicator?
Terminal 61 is used for the alternator charge indicator.
What is the sequence of actions if ignition timing is okay but the engine still doesn't run?
Start engine, and if it doesn't run, check fuel supply (Groups 13 and 16) and check engine for mechanical defect (Group 11).
Where can the tightening torque specification for the distributor rotor be found?
See Specifications section for the tightening torque value.
What are the testing requirements mentioned for troubleshooting digital motor electronics?

Testing requirements include: engine in perfect running condition (timing, compression, oil, carbon deposits, etc.), starting system in perfect condition (battery voltage, starter, ignition lock, etc.), correct fuel in tank (octane rating, leaded/unleaded, dirt, etc.), and connections and ground points according to wiring diagram.
At what engine speed should you run the engine when checking ignition timing?
Start and run engine at test speed when checking ignition timing.
What indicates that the voltage supply and ground of the idle control unit are okay?
When both voltage tests show at least 9 volts, the voltage supply and ground of idle control unit are okay.
What adjustment range is specified for the throttle valve lower edge?
Adjust the throttle valve lower edge to 0.1 + 0.05 mm (0.004 + 0.002 inch) with dial gage screw (1) approximately 1/10th of a turn.
What system section does this page belong to?
This page belongs to Section 13, the Fuel System section.
What specific type of fuel injection system does this control unit test procedure apply to?
L-Jetronic system, as indicated by the requirement to use L-Jetronic test program rather than DME.
What should be done with the BMW Service Tester during testing?
Connect the BMW Service Tester to operating conditions with the altitude correction box connected, then connect CO tester on test points and switch off exhaust extraction for time of testing.
If the cold start valve is ejecting when it shouldn't be, what's the next step?
Disconnect Jetronic test lead on cold start valve. Cold start valve must not eject.
Which terminals should be connected when testing the air temperature switch with a voltmeter?
Connect the voltmeter (M 01) between terminal 4 and terminal 10.
What components are identified by callouts 1 and 2 in the air flow sensor diagram?
In the diagram 13 62 005, callout 1 identifies the code number and callout 2 identifies the manufacturing date on the air flow sensor.
What does callout number 3 point to in the removal procedure?
Callout number 3 points to the multiple pin plug that needs to be pulled off.
What ohmmeter reading should you get when testing the air temperature switch at cold temperatures?
The ohmmeter should display approximately 0 ohm with an air temperature of < -8° C (+ 18° F).
What is the test position number for fuel injector testing?
Test Position 6.
What indicates that the air temperature sensor is okay?
The air temperature sensor is okay when the voltmeter displays approximately 0 volt with an air temperature of greater than +4°C (39°F).
What is the first step when replacing a fuel injector?
The first step is to unscrew bolts on injection tube.
What is the switching temperature range for this temperature switch?
The switch operates between -8°C (18°F) and 4°C (39°F), showing low resistance below -8°C and high resistance above 4°C.
What is the minimum voltage reading required when testing the automatic transmission selector lever switch?
At least 9 volts
Which page covers the removal and installation of the air flow sensor?
Page 13-760
How should the CO level be corrected when the oxygen sensor plug is connected?
Correct CO level to the value measured with the oxygen sensor plug connected by applying Special Tool 13 1 100 on the adjusting screw in the air flow sensor.
What resistance value should the throttle switch drop to when releasing the throttle valve?
When releasing the throttle valve, the resistance must drop to approximately 0 ohm.
What wire color should I check for breaks when testing cars with automatic transmission if the voltage test fails?
Blue/brown wire
What are the reference numbers for the checking procedure?
The checking procedure is referenced as 20 13 6 33.
What is the minimum engine oil temperature required before performing idle speed and CO level adjustments?
The engine oil temperature must be at least 60° C (140° F) before performing adjustments.
What action should be taken with the throttle switch if the idle signal test fails?
