The Splice Location Views are documented on page 8000-0.
What type of view is shown for the rear window blower connector?
The rear window blower connector shows the mating face view with connector designation B0400002.03.
What connector designations are shown for the Clutch Switch in Figure 5?
In Figure 5, the Clutch Switch area shows connector designations G202, G200, C500, C210, C201, C202, and C200.
What component connects to pin 20?
Motronic Control Unit (TXD)
What connector is labeled as the Accessory Connector in the upper portion of the diagram?
C262 is labeled as the Accessory Connector in the upper portion of the diagram.
What does the charge indicator provide according to the note?
According to the note, the charge indicator provides excitation current to field coil and alternator to charge if bulb burns out.
What component provides vehicle speed input to the cruise control unit?
The speedometer solid state speed output from the instrument cluster printed circuit
What voltage rating is shown for the power windows connection?
2.5 GN/BU voltage rating is shown for the power windows connection.
What is the highest pin number visible on the C103 connector?
The highest pin number visible on the C103 connector is pin 30.
What wire color and size is used for pin 11?
BK/YL (Black/Yellow) 2.5mm wire
What connector numbers are shown for the driver's and RH front window console switches?
The driver's window console switch uses connector C405, and the RH front window console switch uses connector C404.
What is the important operating condition noted at the top of the diagram?
The diagram shows 'HOT IN RUN ONLY FROM UNFUSED RELAY K7' as an important operating condition.
What is the final step if wire checks don't resolve the A/C Select Switch test issue?
Replace the A/C Select Switch.
What are the splice location identifiers shown on the left side of the instrument panel?
The splice location identifiers on the left side are C103, S306, S307, and S221.
What connector designation is shown for the throttle switch potentiometer?
The throttle switch potentiometer uses connector B030015.07.
What wire color designation is used for the main power feed to both window console switches?
The main power feed to both window console switches uses wire designation 1.5 GN/GY (1.5mm Green/Gray).
What color wires connect the light switch to the front side marker lights?
1 GY/YL (gray/yellow) and .75 GY/YL (gray/yellow) wires
What should you do if both voltages are correct in Test C?
If both voltages are correct, replace the Control Switches.
What does the note at the bottom left of the diagram indicate about some vehicles?
The note states 'SOME VEHICLES MAY CONTAIN AN ADDITIONAL SPLICE. (SEE GROUND DISTRIBUTION)' indicating that some vehicles may have additional splice connections in the ground distribution system.
What should the correct result be when connecting an ohmmeter across speaker terminals?
The speaker should 'pops' according to the correct result column.
What cleaning method is specified for the slave cylinder?
Clean the slave cylinder and inside parts with alcohol.
Why is the larger diameter slave cylinder required for the dual-mass flywheel?
The larger diameter slave cylinder is required to avoid contact of the release lever when the clutch pedal is floored.
What does component number 1 represent in the clutch assembly diagram?
Component number 1 represents the Crankshaft in the clutch assembly.
What are the procedure numbers for overhauling the master and slave cylinders?
The master cylinder overhaul is procedure 21 52 502 and the slave cylinder overhaul is procedure 21 52 512.
What is the procedure code for checking the drive plate for lateral runout?
The procedure code for checking the drive plate for lateral runout is 565.
How do you correct air in the clutch hydraulic system?
Bleed clutch 21 00 006.
What should be checked on the clutch before removing it?
Check clutch for wear before removing. Clutch liners are okay if Special Tool 21 2 060 can be pushed into opening of slave cylinder against stop.
What lubricant specification is mentioned for the sensors during installation?
Install sensors with Molykote Longterm 2 lubricant, and the face surface of DME senders must be free of grease and dirt.
What is different about the drive plate on the double mass flywheel version?
The drive plate of the version with a double mass flywheel is rigid and not fitted with a damper. The torsion damper is integrated in the flywheel.
What are the five components included in the master cylinder repair kit?
The repair kit consists of: 1 Piston assembly, 2 Circlip, 3 Protective cap, 4 Sealing plug, and 5 Spring.
What is component number 3 in the clutch assembly?
Component number 3 is the Flywheel in the clutch assembly.
What is the source of supply for certain clutch components?
The source of supply for certain components (marked with double asterisk) is HWB.
What are the possible causes when the clutch slips?

The possible causes for clutch slippage are: insufficient clutch contact pressure, liner seriously worn, liner splattered with oil from transmission or crankshaft seal fault, clutch was overheated, or clutch not an original BMW part.
How should the bleeder screw be positioned during slave cylinder installation?
The bleeder screw faces down during installation.
What diameter slave cylinder should be used for the dual-mass flywheel version?
A slave cylinder with a diameter of 22.2 mm (0.874 inches) instead of 20.64 mm (0.809 inches) must be installed for the version with a double-mass flywheel.
How does the clutch for the double mass flywheel version differ in height?
The clutch for the version with a double mass flywheel is lower in height.
What important step must be done before installing the piston rod during clutch pedal installation?
The over-center spring (8) must be engaged in guide tab (9) on the pedal base prior to installation of the piston rod (3).
What special tool is needed to hold the flywheel on the M20 engine?
Special Tool 11 2 170 is used to hold the flywheel on the M20 engine.
What procedure reference number covers removing and installing the clutch housing?
The procedure reference number for removing and installing the clutch housing is 21 11 000.
On which page can I find information about clutch housing removal and installation?
Information about clutch housing removal and installation can be found on page 21-1.
What components need to be removed during clutch master cylinder removal?
You need to pull out filling pipe (4), unscrew bolts (5 and 6), and remove master cylinder.
What is the dial gage measurement for checking drive plate lateral runout?
Apply dial gage about 3 mm (0.118") from outer edge.
What important warning is given about operating the clutch pedal during slave cylinder removal?
Never operate the clutch pedal as long as the slave cylinder is removed.
If the clutch grabs due to engine and transmission suspension fault, what is the correction?
Replace engine and transmission suspension and install original BMW parts.
What should be done if the slave cylinder bore has scoring or corrosion?
Replace the entire slave cylinder if the cylinder bore has scoring or corrosion.
What callout numbers are shown in the master cylinder diagram?
The master cylinder diagram shows callout numbers 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5, corresponding to the piston assembly, circlip, protective cap, sealing plug, and spring respectively.
What procedure is covered under code 21 21 000?
Code 21 21 000 covers clutch disc removal and installation.
Which components need to be removed before checking the drive plate for lateral runout?
Remove transmission (see 23 00 022), remove spring (1) and release lever (2) with release (3).
What should be removed before disconnecting the piston rod on the clutch pedal?
You should remove the instrument panel trim at bottom left, which is referenced in section 51 45 180.
What should you visually inspect the clutch for when examining it?
Visually inspect clutch for cracks, wear and burnt spots. The pressure contact surface must be level.
What type of wrench should be used to unscrew the Torx bolts on the clutch housing?
Use a Torx wrench to unscrew the Torx bolts.
What should you do if there is still air in the system after repeating the bleeding procedure several times?
If there is still air in the system after repeating the bleeding procedures several times, detach the slave cylinder on the transmission.
Which page contains information about clutch master cylinder overhaul?
Information about clutch master cylinder overhaul can be found on page 21-6.
What is the procedure code for clutch bleeding?
The procedure code for clutch bleeding is 21 00 006.
Why is proper handling of the clutch disc important?

Don't throw or drop clutch disc - improper handling could bend off tangential leaf springs which hold clutch disc in turning direction, causing the pressure ring to not lift sufficiently and the drive plate would not clear.
What lubricant should be used to pack the lubricating groove during installation?
Pack lubricating groove (N) with Molykote Longterm 2.
Where would I look for clutch troubleshooting information?
Clutch troubleshooting information can be found on page 21-7.
What component connects the master cylinder to the slave cylinder?
Pipe (1) connects the master cylinder to the slave cylinder.
What is the procedure for loosening the clutch mounting bolts?
Loosen mounting bolts separately 1 to 1 1/2 turns until clutch is relaxed, then remove mounting bolts, clutch disc and drive plate.
What are the components of the slave cylinder repair kit?
The slave cylinder repair kit consists of: 1 Protective cap, 2 Grooved cup, Retaining ring, and Toothed ring.
How do you correct clutch slippage caused by insufficient contact pressure?
Replace clutch 21 21 000.
How do you fix excessive lateral runout in the drive plate?
Straighten or replace drive plate 21 21 565.
What is the procedure reference number for bleeding the clutch?
The procedure reference number for bleeding the clutch is 21 00 006.
What technique is used to remove residual air from the tank when the slave cylinder is detached?
Press the push rod against the stop in the slave cylinder and release slowly. This will push back any residual air into the tank and guarantee maximum release travel.
What should be coated with lubricant during clutch release mechanism installation?
Coat guides (F) and bearings (L) with Molykote Longterm 2 lightly.
Where can you find reference information for removing the transmission?
Remove transmission - see 23 00 022.
What important installation note is given about the plugs when removing the DME sender?
The plugs must not be mixed up during installation, and the engine cannot be started if plugs are mixed up.
What are the procedures covered under section 21 52 000?
Section 21 52 000 covers removing and installing the clutch master cylinder.
What should you do to the brake fluid tank cap before bleeding the clutch?
You should unscrew the cap on the brake fluid tank and remove the float container before connecting the bleeder.
What procedure should be followed after straightening the drive plate?
Repeat testing procedures.
How should you operate the clutch pedal during the bleeding procedure?
You should operate the clutch pedal several times during this procedure while opening the bleeder screw on the clutch slave cylinder until escaping fluid is without air bubbles.
What components are labeled B and C in the clutch release mechanism diagram?
The diagram shows components B and C for checking height of release, but specific identification is referenced to specifications.
What tool is needed to center the drive plate in the flywheel during installation?
Special Tool 21 2 100 is used to center the drive plate in the flywheel during installation.
How should the drive plate be straightened if lateral runout is excessive?
Straighten drive plate by applying knocks from a plastic hammer on take-up points of tester.
What measurement should be taken after drive plate installation?
Check height of release B* and C*.
What cleaning agent should be used for the master cylinder and inside parts?
Clean the master cylinder and inside parts with alcohol.
What does the release mechanism consist of according to the diagram?
The release mechanism consists of component 6 (Release), component 7 (Release lever), and component 8 (Clutch slave cylinder).
What causes the clutch to not release properly?

Clutch does not release due to: drive plate wrenched excessively or liner broken, drive plate has excessive lateral runout, liner rusted on flywheel, drive plate seized on transmission input shaft, bearing in crankshaft for transmission input shaft fault, air in clutch hydraulic system, or tangential leaf springs of clutch bent off.
What must be installed with the Torx bolts to avoid breaking-loose torque issues?
Torx bolts must be installed with washers to avoid an increase in breaking-loose torque.
What should you check on the clutch rivets during inspection?
Visually inspect clutch rivets for wear and tight fit. Replace a clutch with loose or worn rivets.
What lubricant should be used to coat the cylinder bore and grooves?
Coat the cylinder bore and grooves lightly with ATE brake cylinder paste.
What is the source of supply listed at the bottom of the page?
The source of supply is HWB.
What should be checked on the drive plate during inspection?
Check drive plate for wear (A), cracks and torsion damper for tight fit of spring elements. Also check transmission end mark on drive plate.
What safety precaution is mentioned regarding clutch liners?
Liners contain asbestos - conform with safety precautions (also refer to general information in Group 0).
What should be done if the clutch master cylinder has scoring or corrosion?
Replace the entire master cylinder if the cylinder has scoring or corrosion.
What causes clutch noise?

Clutch noise is caused by: unbalance of clutch and drive plate excessive, torsional damper defective, clutch release faulty, bearing in crankshaft for transmission input shaft fault, or clutch rivets loose.
What part number should be referenced for replacing the bearing in crankshaft for transmission input shaft?
Replace bearing in crankshaft 11 21 571.
What tool holder is specified for mounting the dial gage?
Mount dial gage 00 2 510 and holder 00 2 500.
What are components 4 and 5 in the clutch assembly cross-section?
Component 4 is the Drive plate and component 5 is the Thrust plate.
What correction is needed when the liner is rusted on the flywheel?
Clean flywheel, roughen liner surfaces with emery cloth.
What should I do if the clutch grabs and the liner is not as specified?
Replace drive plate 21 21 000.
What important note applies to both master and slave cylinder repair kits?
Only use repair kit of same make as pertinent master cylinder (for master) or slave cylinder (for slave).
What lubricant should be applied to the transmission input shaft and where?
Give transmission input shaft a light coat of Microlube GL 261 in area of splines and guide pins.
What component needs to be lifted out according to the circlip removal procedure?
Lift out circlip (1).
What is the proper sequence for installing the case front section?

Mount the case front section, align the layshaft through the bore for the oil drain plug that the roller bearing of the layshaft slides into the bearing shell, then bolt the case front section with the specified tightening torque.
What does callout 10 represent in the gear removal procedure?
Callout 10 represents the circlip that must be removed before pressing off 1st gear.
What is the reference number for the synchronization disassemble and assemble procedure?
What component is being installed in the third diagram labeled 23 0 020?
The output flange is being installed.
What should be done with the stop nuts when removing the transmission?
Replace the stop nuts when unscrewing the bolts.
What must be done before installing the collar nut with bolt cement?
The torque must be tightened before installing the collar nut with bolt cement, as indicated by the double asterisk reference.
How should the sliding sleeve be adjusted in 1st gear direction?
Move the sliding sleeve in 1st gear direction and adjust the guide sleeve to be without play. Circlips are available from Parts in different thicknesses.
What measurement needs to be determined before installing the gear wheel set?
The thickness of the drive pinion shim needs to be determined before installing the gear wheel set.
What is the play adjustment specification between the bearing inner race and circlip?
The play between bearing inner race and circlip should be adjusted to 0.1-0.09 mm (0.003").
What lubricant coating is specified for the brass synchromesh ring during installation?
The brass synchromesh ring should be installed with molybdenum coat.
What items are numbered 4 and 5 in the selector fork diagram?
Items 4 and 5 are drive pins that need to be driven out of the selector fork for 3rd/4th gear (counterhold).
What precaution should be taken when using the support for bearing removal?
Use a flat iron bar or similar item between support and sealing surface to avoid damage on sealing surface.
What component connects the input and output of the transmission according to this diagram?
The layshaft (number 8) connects between the input shaft (6) and output shaft (7) to transfer power through the gear sets.
What is the drawing number for the 1st/Reverse Gear Synchromesh Ring?
Drawing No. 011.8.0241.00 engraved.
What distances need to be measured when replacing transmission shaft bearings?
Measure distance (A) from guide sleeve sealing surface to input shaft, distance (B) from guide sleeve sealing surface to circlip bearing surface, and distance (C) from bearing outer race to circlip.
Which component is labeled as number 4 in this shift mechanism?
Number 4 identifies the selector shaft.
What does callout number 2 represent in the installation sequence?
Callout number 2 indicates the spacer that needs to be installed.
What should be applied to the thrust washer and gasket during installation?
Grease should be applied to both the thrust washer with angle facing bore and the gasket during installation.
What transmission case procedure is described on page 23-4?
Transmission case front cover - remove and install/seal is described on page 23-4.
Which pages cover radial oil seal procedures?
Radial oil seal procedures are covered on pages 23-6 (output flange replacement), 23-6 (selector shaft replacement), and 23-7 (input shaft replacement).
What components should be installed together when reassembling the transmission?
Install 3rd/4th gear selector fork and 1st/2nd as well as 5th/reverse gear selector rods with selector forks.
What adjustment procedure is described for removing play in the operating sleeve?
Move operating sleeve in direction of 1st gear, then adjust guide sleeve to remove all play by installing the appropriate thickness circlip.
What gear is represented by callout number 5?
Number 5 is the Fifth gear.
Where should Loctite No. 573 be applied in the reverse gear shaft area?
Coat case front section in area of reverse gear shaft with Loctite No. 573. Surface must be thoroughly clean and dried of oil.
What temperature should the case rear section be heated to before lifting out roller bearing (2)?
Heat case rear section to approximately 80°C (175°F) with a hot air blower before lifting out roller bearing (2).
Why is it important to keep driving on the grooved ball bearing with light hammer knocks?
To ensure proper seating and installation of the bearing while avoiding damage from excessive force.
What should you do with the lubricating groove (N) during installation?
Fill lubricating groove (N) with Molykote Longterm 2.
What special tool is mentioned for the centering pin operation?
Special Tool 23 1 450 is used for the centering pin operation.
What should be applied to the guide tube and bolts during installation?
A surface sealing compound should be applied to the guide tube and bolts during installation.
How many detent balls should be installed and with what lubricant?
Install two detent balls with grease, then push in 3rd/4th gear selector rod against lock.
For the shouldered operating sleeve version, which gear wheel does the shouldered end face?
In the shouldered operating sleeve version, shouldered end faces 2nd gear wheel.
What gears are mentioned as being engaged during this procedure?
Second and reverse gears are engaged during this procedure.
What is the installation requirement for the snap ring?
Always replace snap ring during installation.
What components are shown as items 3 and 4 in the bottom diagram?
Item 3 is the selector arm with long finger facing 3rd/4th gear selector rod, and item 4 is the selector rail.
Which gear is labeled with callout number 4?
Callout number 4 identifies the fourth gear.
What procedure should be followed after installing the new end caps?
After installing the new end caps, they should be locked by punching.
What must be replaced during installation after removing the selector shaft?
The radial oil seal must be replaced and the selector arm must be removed during installation.
What is the important note about the inner race of the grooved ball bearing?
The inner race of grooved ball bearing has protrusion. Install bearing race that protrusion faces the gear set. If necessary, drive in bearing against stop with Special Tool 23 1 470.
What is the purpose of item 49 in this transmission assembly?
Item 49 is the layshaft.
What components are indicated by callout numbers 1 and 2 in the shift arm diagram?
Callout 1 indicates the lift spring and callout 2 indicates the boss on the case.
What special tool is required to remove the selector arm?
Special Tool 23 1 250 must be installed to remove the selector arm.
What's the correction for a loose shift console that's causing gear jumping problems?
Tighten shift console.
What should be placed between the claws and sealing surface when pressing out shafts?
Use a piece of wood, aluminum or similar material between claws and sealing surface to avoid damage on sealing surface.
What components need to be installed with the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
Install 3rd/4th gear selector fork and 1st/2nd as well as 5th/reverse gear selector rods with selector forks.
How many turns should the threaded ring be loosened during removal?
Loosen threaded ring (1) several turns.
What is the function of component number 3 in this assembly?
Component number 3 is the leaf spring.
What are the numbered components shown in diagram 30 23 272 for synchronization disassembly?
The diagram shows component 1 (spring), component 2 (pressure piece), and component 3 (ball) used in the synchronization assembly.
What are the three main components to disassemble from the synchronization unit?
The three main components are the pressure piece (1), spring (2), and ball (3).
What component is shown being removed in the top left diagram with callout number 2?
The reverse gear is being removed, as indicated by callout number 2.
What component needs to be removed first according to the transmission case front section procedure?
The transmission case front section 23 11 013 needs to be removed first, followed by removing the lockplate.
What sealing components are shown in items 31 and 41?
Item 31 contains balls (six), and item 41 is a radial oil seal.
How is the 3rd/4th gear selector rod removed?
Knock out 3rd/4th gear selector rod forward, with lockpin (11) in selector rod.
How many springs need to be inserted for the stop pins?
3 springs need to be inserted for the stop pins.
How many forward gears are shown in this transmission assembly?
Five forward gears are shown, labeled as first gear (1), second gear (2), third gear (3), fourth gear (4), and fifth gear (5).
What procedure section covers removing and installing the input and output shaft assembly?
Section 23 21 503 covers removing and installing input and output shaft assembly with transmission removed.
What is the tightening torque specification for the transmission installation?
The tightening torque is specified with an asterisk reference to see Specifications.
What measurement procedure is shown in the second diagram?
The diagram shows checking layshaft axial play through bore for the oil filler plug using a dial gage.
What components are shown as callouts 7 and 8 in the upper right diagram?
Callout 7 indicates the locking lever and callout 8 indicates the thrust pin, whose installed positions should be checked during installation.
What tool is recommended for heating the ball bearing inner race?
Use a hot air blower to heat the ball bearing inner race.
What Loctite number should be used when installing and capping after coating?
Loctite No. 573 should be used for both installing and capping after coating, as well as for installing the end cover.
What must be done simultaneously when sliding in the selector shaft?
When sliding in the selector shaft, the selector arm (1) must be installed at the same time.
Which direction must the stepped end of the operating sleeve face during assembly?
The stepped end of operating sleeve must face the reverse gear since 5.85.
What characteristic makes the self-locking bolts difficult to work with?
Self-locking bolts - they will be hard to unscrew.
What important instruction is given about the 5th gear installation?
Lift and turn 5th gear until teeth mesh.
What is the procedure number for removing and installing the input and output shaft assembly?
The procedure number is 23 21 503 for removing and installing input and output shaft assembly with transmission removed.
What size pin should be driven into the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
Drive a 6 x 26 mm pin into the 3rd/4th gear selector fork (counterhold).
What is the introduction date for the operating sleeve identification system?
The introduction date is 8.85.
What components are labeled L, F, and N in the bottom diagram?
L indicates bearings, F indicates guides, and N indicates the lubricating groove that should be packed with Molykote Longterm 2.
What preparation is required before installing a new radial oil seal?
Lubricate the sealing lip of the radial oil seal with oil.
What should be done with the closed cage end faces when installing the grooved ball bearing?
Install the grooved ball bearing with the closed cage end faces down.
How do you adjust axial play of the input shaft?
Adjust axial play of input shaft with case front section attached. The input shaft must be on synchromesh ring and measure distance (A) from guide sleeve sealing surface to input shaft.
What Loctite number should be used when installing the end cap?
Loctite No. 573 should be used when replacing and installing the end cap.
What warning is given about the Torx socket requirement?
Unscrew Torx bolts with a Torx socket with two asterisks indicating this is important information.
What tool is mentioned for pressing the bearing onto the output shaft?
Special Tool 23 1 440 is used for pressing on the output shaft, with tool 23 1 440 if necessary.
What special tool is needed to press off the guide sleeve with operating sleeve and reverse gear?
Special Tool 23 2 080 is needed to press off the guide sleeve with operating sleeve and reverse gear.
How do you remove the gear set from the output shaft if replacement is necessary?
If replacement is necessary, press gear set off of output shaft using reference 23 21 554.
What should you check regarding the shift rod joint orientation after installation?
Check installed position of the shift rod joint - the offset end of the shift rod joint must face right as seen looking forward in the car.
Where can specifications for torque values be found?
Torque specifications can be found in the Specifications section, as indicated by the asterisk note at the bottom of the page.
What temperature should the guide flange be heated to for installation?
Heat the guide flange to about 80°C (175°F) with a hot air blower.
How should the sliding sleeve be removed during synchronization disassembly?
Press sliding sleeve off of guide sleeve. Remove spring (1), pressure piece (2) and ball (3).
What additional components are removed along with the needle bearing and sintered steel synchromesh ring?
Remove needle bearing and sintered steel synchromesh ring when pressing bearing sleeve, thrust washer and 2nd gear off of output shaft.
What should I do if I find damaged sliding sleeves causing gear jumping out?
Replace damaged parts 23 23 503 and install sliding sleeves correctly 23 23 503.
Why should only nuts be tightened and never bolts when working on the Guibo coupling?
Only tighten nuts (never bolts) to avoid stress in the Guibo coupling.
What is the installation instruction for the radial oil seal?
Replace radial oil seal during installation.
How do you correct defective transmission shaft bearings?
Replace all bearings 23 21 701.
What caution is given before pulling off the cover?
Make sure 2nd gear is engaged before pulling off cover. Swing selector shaft to the left against stop and slide forward.
What component is being pressed into the case front section along with the input shaft?
The grooved ball bearing is being pressed into the case front section along with the input shaft.
What part number is associated with the complete synchronization disassembly and assembly procedure?
Part number 23 23 505 is associated with the complete synchronization disassembly and assembly procedure.
How should the bearing inner race and case front section be heated during installation?

Heat the bearing inner race and case front section in the area of the grooved ball bearing with a hot air blower, then push on the grooved ball bearing as far as possible with the inner race protrusion facing the gear set.
What diagram reference numbers are shown for the special tools?
The diagram shows reference numbers 23 0 020, 23 1 200, and 23 1 210 for the special tools.
What should be done to the operating sleeve in relation to the reverse gear direction?
Move operating sleeve in direction of reverse gear. Adjust guide sleeve with circlip (11) to take up all play.
Which special tools are needed to hold the output flange and unscrew the collar nut?
Special Tool 23 0 020 is needed to hold the output flange and Special Tool 23 1 200 is needed to apply to unscrew the collar nut.
What must be engaged in the selector arm according to the leaf spring removal instructions?
Roller (3) on leaf spring (6) must engage in selector arm (7).
What bearing sleeve requires heating for the 3rd gear installation?
The bearing sleeve (9) should be heated to approximately 80° C (175° F) and installed on the output shaft for the 3rd gear assembly.
What special tool is required for pressing off the 1st gear?
Special Tool 23 1 490 is required for pressing off 1st gear with guide sleeve and sliding sleeve.
What component is labeled as number 3 in the selector shaft procedure?
Number 3 indicates the radial oil seal that needs to be removed.
What special requirement applies to the version with Offcenter Groove for Selector Fork?
Wide land (6) of operating sleeve must face long collar (4) of the guide sleeve.
What should you do with the synchromesh rings before disassembling the output shaft?
It is recommended to mark synchromesh rings for a pertinent gear wheel when disassembling the output shaft, in order to avoid mixing up synchromesh rings.
What are the example measurements for distance B in the clutch release guide tube procedure?
Example measurements for distance B are 8.1 mm (0.319") and 7.8 mm (0.307"), with a spacer thickness of 0.3 mm (0.012").
Which gear selector rod should be pulled out first?
Pull out 3rd/4th gear selector rod.
What installation note is provided for the operating lever?
The installation note states to install the operating lever so that the notch faces up and in the direction of the selector rail.
How should the output shaft be positioned when second gear is engaged?
Position output shaft upright with second gear engaged.
What special tools are required to drive out the roller bearings from the intermediate case?
Special Tools 23 1 130 and 00 5 500 are required to drive roller bearings for input shaft and layshaft out of intermediate case.
How should the selector rail groove be oriented during installation?
The groove in the selector rail should face up when installing the selector rail.
What component connects the selector rods to the shift mechanism according to this diagram?
The selector arm (number 5) connects the selector rods to the shift mechanism.
How should the layshaft be positioned when inserting the thicker end of Special Tool 23 1 280?
Insert the thicker end of Special Tool 23 1 280 in the bearing shell, and if necessary, remove lock on the side of the drain plug.
What special tool is required to pull out the radial oil seal?
Special Tool 00 5 010 is required to pull out the radial oil seal.
What important caution is given about using the pulling-off tool?
The caution states to prevent the pulling off tool from falling down and causing injury.
What is the first step in the radial oil seal replacement procedure?
The first step is to remove guide sleeve 23 11 623, then remove the radial oil seal.
What is the first step shown for removing the selector components?
The first step is to drive the pin out of the selector arm.
What transmission is shown in this assembly drawing?
This is an assembly drawing of shift parts for the Getrag 260 five speed overdrive manual transmission.
What is the knock back centering pin procedure?
Knock back centering pin, then pull off transmission case rear section with Special Tool 23 1 350 used in conjunction with Special Tool 33 1 301.
What special tool is required to press the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of the case rear section?
Special Tool 23 1 050 is required to press the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of the case rear section.
What tool number is shown being used to lift out the radial oil seal?
Tool number 630 23 216 is shown being used to lift out the radial oil seal.
How many springs need to be removed according to the lower left diagram?
Three springs need to be removed according to the procedure shown.
How is operating sleeve (5) configured and installed?
Operating sleeve (5) has one groove and is installed with shouldered end facing reverse gear or groove facing 5th gear.
What happens to the radial oil seal during the procedure shown in step 8?
The radial oil seal (8) will also be pulled out as noted in the important warning for that step.
What is the correct orientation for the bleeder screw during clutch slave cylinder installation?
The bleeder screw faces down during installation.
What does callout number 3 represent in the top right installation diagram?
Callout number 3 represents the bearing inner race being pressed off of layshaft with a screwdriver.
What is the lockpin component in this assembly?
The lockpin is component number 8 in this transmission assembly.
What should be installed with the collar nut according to the instructions?
Install collar nut with a locking compound.
What is the source reference for the Torx socket information?
Source: HWB (indicated by two asterisks).
What correction is needed when there's air in the clutch hydraulic system?
Bleed clutch 21 00 006. Use 10 W 50 engine oil for cold climates or cold transm.
How should the operating lever be installed according to the installation notes?
Install the operating lever so that the notch faces up and in the direction of selector rail.

Removing and installing or sealing transmission case rear section with transmission removed.

What is noted about thrust washers in versions that have them?
In versions with thrust washer, note thrust washer (2) and ball (3) between 2nd and 3rd gear wheels.

Install front case section and mount with two bolts opposite each other. Center front case section with dowel pins slightly, then unscrew oil filler plug (1).

Push back spring sleeve (1), drive out cylindrical pin (2), pull off selector rod, and pull off selector rod joint.

The circlip must be pressed tight in groove for measuring.

The tip of the dial gage must bear on the tooth of the layshaft.
What reference section should be consulted for removing the exhaust assembly?

What special tools are needed to lift out the lockplate?

The causes are clutch release insufficient, synchromesh rings or sliding sleeve worn, and reverse gear shift break of 3 sec. not made.

What callout numbers are shown in the transmission cross-section diagrams?

What procedure section should you reference to unscrew the propeller shaft?

Grooves of operating sleeve must be on the wide collar end (1).
What special coating should be applied to the transmission input shaft?
Give transmission input shaft a light coat of Microfuige GL 261 in area of splines and guide pins.
What special tool is used to apply locking compound when installing the collar nut?
Special Tool 23 1 200 is used to apply locking compound when installing the collar nut.
What special tool is used to press the input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of the case rear section?
Special Tool 23 1 050 is used to press input shaft, output shaft and layshaft out of case rear section.
What is the bolt length specification for the cylindrical pins?
Bolt (1) = 8 x 60 mm.
What gears are engaged when performing the ball bearing heating procedure?
Second and reverse gears are engaged during this procedure.
How should the grooved ball bearing be driven on further after the initial pressing operation?
The grooved ball bearing should be driven on further simultaneously with light hammer knocks.
What does the measurement point A represent in the installation procedure?
Measure distance (A) to determine thickness of spacer needed for proper play adjustment.
In what position should the oil plate be bolted down?
Bolt down oil plate (1) in vertical installed position.
Where can additional information about tightening torque be found?
Additional information about tightening torque can be found in the Specifications section.
What should be done with the circlip during installation according to the manual?
Always replace circlip during installation.
How should the nuts be tightened during installation according to the manual?
Tighten nuts with a standard 17 mm socket together with a torque wrench, following the specified tightening torque.
What type of knocks should be used when driving the bearing further onto the shaft?
Light hammer knocks should be used when driving the grooved ball bearing further onto the shaft.
What must the input shaft rest on when measuring axial play?
The input shaft must rest on the synchromesh ring when measuring axial play.
What is component number 4 in this transmission assembly?
Component number 4 is the dog.
What special tool is required to mount the transmission 23 0 090?
Special Tool 23 0 090 is mounted on Special Tool 00 1 490.
Where is the output shaft located in this transmission cross-section?
The output shaft is located in the lower portion of the transmission and is identified by callout number 7.
Which section should be referenced for removing the case front section?

What type of transmission is covered in section 23?
ZF - S5 - 16 Five Speed Manual Transmission with Overdrive
When was the modified synchronization introduced for BMW E30 transmissions?
Modified synchronization was introduced since 11.87.
How should the guide sleeve be positioned relative to the operating sleeve?
Insert guide sleeve in operating sleeve half the distance.
How should the transmission case be removed according to the procedure?
Remove transmission case from section 23 11 014.
What is the tightening torque specification for the case front section?
The tightening torque is specified with an asterisk reference to 'See Specifications' at the bottom of the page.
On which page can I find information about removing and installing the guide sleeve for clutch release?
Information about removing and installing the guide sleeve for clutch release can be found on page 23-5.
What reference is given for unscrewing the propeller shaft?
For unscrewing the propeller shaft, see section 23 00 022.
What type of compound should be used when installing the guide sleeve and bolts?
Install guide sleeve and bolts with a surface sealing compound.
What size pin should be driven in as a counterhold during assembly?
A 6 x 26 mm pin should be driven in as a counterhold.
What components are labeled as items 5, 6, and 7 in the diagram?
Item 5 is the end cap, item 6 is the spring, and item 7 is the lockpin.
How should sealing surfaces be prepared before applying sealant?
Sealing surfaces must be cleaned thoroughly and dried of oil before applying sealant.
What should be done with bolt (6) during installation?
Install bolt with a locking compound and apply the specified tightening torque.

Number 6 is the Input shaft.

4 rollers need to be held in position with grease during selector shaft installation.
What components are installed together in the final step shown?
The shaft with needle bearing and reverse gear are installed together in the final assembly step.
How do you engage 2nd and reverse gears during the procedure?
Engage 2nd and reverse gears by pushing 1st/2nd and 5th/reverse gear selector rods forward.
What must be done to the lockpin when installing the 3rd/4th gear selector rod?
Lockpin (11) must be secured in selector rod during installation.
What is the first step when removing the input and output shaft assembly?
Pull out input and output shaft assembly with layshaft and 1st/2nd gear selector rod in intermediate case.
What is specified for the 5.85 operating sleeves with asymmetric teeth?
Modified synchronization since 5.85 operating sleeves with asymmetric teeth use thrust pieces (1), springs (2) and balls (3) in weaker version.
How should the sealing lip of the radial oil seal be prepared before installation?
The sealing lip of the radial oil seal should be lubricated with oil before installation.

Before tightening the collar nut, you must hold the output flange with Special Tool 23 0 020 to prevent it from rotating.
What temperature should the rear case section be heated to for the grooved ball bearing installation?
The rear case section should be heated to about 80°C (176°F) with a hot air blower.
What part number identifies the diagram showing the thrust washer version assembly?
Part number 630 23 293 identifies the diagram showing the thrust washer version assembly.
What special tool is required for driving in the roller bearing?
Special Tool 23 2 220 is required for driving in the roller bearing.
How should the transmission guide sleeve be inserted into the bearing?
Insert guide sleeve of transmission in bearing carefully.
What additional components should be installed after driving on the grooved ball bearing?
After driving on the grooved ball bearing, install the circlip and reverse gear switch.
What components need to be installed together according to the assembly instructions?
Install all springs, pressure pieces and balls together as a complete set.
Where can specifications and supply source information be found?
Specifications can be found in the Specifications section, and the source of supply is HWB.
What is the procedure for removing the 3rd/4th gear selector fork?
Drive out pin (10) in 3rd/4th gear selector fork, then knock out 3rd/4th gear selector rod forward. When installing, replace the pin.
What must be aligned when installing the bearing shell during installation?
Install the bearing shell so that the slot in the bearing shell is aligned with the turning lock bead in the case.
What is the final step shown in the bottom image for seal installation?
Drive in the radial oil seal with Special Tool 23 1 240 after lubricating the sealing lip with oil.
What special requirement applies to DME sender faces during installation?
Faces of DME senders must be free of grease and dirt.
How should the layshaft be aligned when mounting the case front section?
Align layshaft through bore for oil drain plug so that roller bearing of layshaft slides into bearing bell.
Which special tools are required to drive out the ball bearing using tool 23 1 080?
Special Tools 23 1 080 and 00 5 500 are required to drive out the ball bearing.
What precaution should be taken when working with the selector arm in the spring positioning step?
Push down on the selector arm but don't knock it down.
What installation requirement is mentioned regarding the collar nut with bolt cement?
Install collar nut with bolt cement and apply the specified tightening torque.
What components need to be removed from the guide flange?
Remove guide flange, lift out circlip (1), and take off grooved washer (2).
Which selector rod is responsible for 5th/reverse gear operation?
The selector rod labeled as number 3 is responsible for 5th/reverse gear operation.
What type of bearings are used at positions 7, 16, 18, 26, and 32?

What should be done with the oil filler plug during the initial steps?
Unscrew oil filler plug (1).
Which special tool is required to hold the output flange during installation?
Special Tool 23 0 020 is required to hold the output flange during installation.
Which components are identified as guide sleeves in this assembly?
Components 13, 22, and 30 are identified as Guide sleeves.
Where should you look for the tightening torque specification?
The tightening torque specification can be found in the Specifications section, as indicated by the asterisk and note at the bottom of the page.
What should be disconnected when pulling off wires on the reverse gear switch?
Pull off wires on reverse gear switch. Unscrew clutch slave cylinder - pipe remains connected.
Which direction should the sliding sleeve be moved and what circlip is installed?
Move sliding sleeve in direction of 1st gear. Adjust guide sleeve to take up all play. Install circlip (10).

Press guide and operating sleeves as well as reverse gear off of output shaft, and remove needle bearing using pressing-off force.

Callout 1 indicates the locking sleeve to push back, and callout 2 indicates the cylindrical pin to drive out.

Always replace self-locking bolts, as they will be hard to unscrew after use.
What important warning is given about the propeller shaft during center mount installation?
Don't let the propeller shaft fall into joints. Suspend propeller shaft from car on pieces of wire.

Threads should be cleaned to remove old cement, then install bolts with Loctite No. 573 and tighten to specified torque.
What is the purpose of shim X and how do you determine its thickness?
Shim X is used for proper spacing. Determine its thickness by measuring distance (A).
What should always be replaced during installation?
Always replace snap ring.
What should be removed from the case rear section before installing roller bearings?
Remove all detent and locking balls in case rear section before installing roller bearings.
How should the lockplate be secured during installation?
The lockplate should be locked in the groove during installation.
What type of synchromesh rings should be used for repairs?
Only use molybdenum-coated synchromesh rings for repairs.

If a spacer is found between the circlip and case when removing the bearing, it must be installed again for measuring distance.

What component is identified by callout number 1?
Callout number 1 identifies the selector rod for 1st/2nd gear.
What special tool is used to pull the 5th gear wheel off of the layshaft?
Special Tool 23 0 080 is used to pull the 5th gear wheel off of the layshaft.
What type of synchromesh ring is used with the 3rd gear?
A brass synchromesh ring is used with the needle bearing and 3rd gear installation.
If there's a radial oil seal leak at the crankshaft on the clutch bell housing, what part should I replace?
Replace radial oil seal 11 14 611.
What should be done with the oil during the mounting procedure?
Drain oil.
What is the required axial play for the input shaft?
The axial play required is 1.1 to 1.3 mm (0.043 to 0.051 inches).
What important step must be taken with the knurled head bolts?
Hold knurled head bolts in recesses of guide sleeve with pliers.
What is shown in the second diagram at the bottom of the page?

What lubrication is required for the lockpin and locking lever?
Lubricate lockpin and locking lever with oil.

Transmissions are supplied with oil since 1.86. Consequently it is only necessary to check the oil level after installation of a transmission.
What does the diagram reference number 30 23 014 correspond to?
The first diagram showing the spring, release lever, and thrust bearing removal procedure.
How should the operating lever be positioned during installation?
The operating lever (5) should be installed with the selector switch facing up and toward the selector rail.
What components are installed during assembly for the needle bearing, reverse gear, and brass synchromesh ring?
Install needle bearing, reverse gear and brass synchromesh ring with molybdenum coat. Place guide sleeve and sliding sleeve on splines of output shaft.
What is the main topic of section 23 21 503?
Removing and installing input and output shaft assembly with front and rear transmission case sections removed.
What components are numbered 2, 3, and 4 in the synchronizer assembly diagram?
Component 2 is springs, component 3 is thrust parts, and component 4 is balls.

Note grooves on operating sleeves for correct installed position, as the groove orientation determines proper gear engagement direction.

Mount vent (1) prior to installation of the transmission (red label). Pull vent (1) and sleeve (2) off of the shift shaft. Lift out cap (3) and install vent (1).

The transmission housing with the radial oil seal location and guide sleeve that needs to be removed.

Press in balls so far that the guide sleeve can be pushed into the operating sleeve.

Five forward gears are visible, labeled as numbers 1 through 5 (first gear through fifth gear).
What is the part number for the guide sleeve that needs to be removed?

Insert the selector arm with Special Tool 23 1 250, then swing out the selector arm with roller over locking lever (4).
What special tool is required for the threaded ring installation?
Special Tool 26 1 040 is required after finishing the threaded ring installation.
Where can I find the procedure for replacing bearings of all transmission shafts?
Page 23-321, reference number 23 21 703
What alternative method is provided if the output flange is too difficult to remove?
If too difficult, pull off the output flange with Special Tool 33 1 150.
What must be checked regarding the operating lever during installation?
Check installed position of operating lever (1).
What transmission model is covered in section 23?
GETRAG 265/6 Five Speed Manual Transmission with Overdrive

Adjust play between snap ring and guide sleeve to 0...0.09 mm (0 to 0.0035").
How do you fix synchromesh rings or sliding sleeve wear that causes grabbing?
Check synchronization, replace damaged parts 23 23 503.
What needs to be unscrewed when working on the backup light switch?
Unscrew backup light switch. Drive back cylindrical pins. Unscrew bolts.
When was the synchronization modified for this transmission?
Modified synchronization since 5.85.

It is important that Special Tool 23 1 006 is inserted so that its flat side faces the input shaft.

Item 9 is a bolt that should be unscrewed, and the lock in the socket of the bolt should be removed.
What page number covers the procedure for transmission removal and installation?
Page 23-302 covers transmission removal and installation.

After pressing on the guide sleeve, install spacer and circlip.

Remove the locking lever (4), shim (5), and bearing holder (6).
Which component provides reverse gear functionality in this transmission?
Component number 49 is the Reverse gear.
What should be sealed between the case and bolt?
Seal between case and bolt.
What size pin should be driven in while counterholding the selector rod?

Screw on nuts to avoid damaging the threads.

The lockpin (6) must move easily and face down.

Take off synchromesh ring, pull off reverse gear and needle bearing.

The shouldered ends of thrust pieces face the operating sleeve.

Make shift break.

Remove reverse gear shaft, reverse gear, needle bearing and thrust washer.

Adjust play to 0 to 0.09 mm (0 to 0.0035 inches).

Check the condition of bearing inner race (2) on output shaft, replacing if necessary.

Remove all detent and locking balls in case rear section.

Important! Rollers on selector shaft.

When pressing on parts, make sure that tabs on synchromesh ring are aligned with openings in guide sleeve.

Bend propeller shaft down and pull it off of the centering pin.

The diagram shows the transfer spring (1), release lever (2), and release (3).

Transmission 260/5.

Component number 48 is a Needle bearing.

Callout 4 is the thrust washer, 5 is the 5th gear, 6 is the brass synchromesh ring, and 7 is the needle bearing.

Output shaft next to collar.

Cross member on body.

What should you check regarding brake pad thickness during installation?

Always fine grind both sides of both brake discs on one axle. Even if only one brake disc needs replacement, always replace both brake discs of one axle.

Replace brake pads.

This symptom is caused by dispersion in the sensor wire.

Turn off ignition and remove rear wheel 36 10 300.

Unplug the brake pad wear indicator on the left side, then pull off the caliper toward the rear and suspend it with a piece of wire.

Use the Service Tester to check pin 16 on the ABS wire harness plug for ground contact.

When cycle time is less than specified value, it means the wheel turns too fast.

The BMW 325 iX (all wheel drive) is the first standard production car to have permanent all wheel drive with constantly switched central and rear axle locks and also a continuously effective ABS.

The ABS test on a brake test dynamometer (test steps 8, 9 and 10) may not be performed on BMW 325 iX cars.

Unscrew caliper mounting bolts (1).

Adjust secondary cup flush with long sleeve pipe and push complete assembly sleeves into cylinder bore, then push in long sleeve pipe carefully up to point of resistance.

The parking brake needs to be adjusted when the parking brake lever can be pulled up by more than 8 teeth.

Remove and install, repair or replace calipers, or overhaul or replace master cylinder.

The basis of a braking action is the friction between the tires and road surface.

The ABS system 2B was introduced gradually since 8/87.

Pull off plug (1), then remove shear-off screws (only drilling out is approved).

Add or replace brake fluid and bleed brakes.

Always fine grind both sides of both brake discs on one axle.

First engage left side of plug and then press right side into clamp.

A brake pressure tester with dual gauges for performing high and low pressure brake tests.

Brake pads worn at angle, which can be caused by brake disc wear angular or brake disc not aligned with caliper.

Less than 1 k-ohm.

Up to a pressure of 25 bar (355 psi), both high pressure meters should display the same value.

Chapter 34 covers the Brakes section.

Disconnect parking brake cable. Remove rear brake shoes. Replace brake shoes by reversing.

Replace locking bolt. Counterhold on guide pin.
On which page would I find information about replacing the brake booster?
Brake booster - replace information is located on page 34-16.

The possible causes are: a) Caliper recesses dirty, caps damaged, b) Brake disc not aligned with caliper, c) Corrosion of pistons in calipers or wheel cylinders.

Turn off ignition for single tests, control unit not connected.
How do you correct brakes that pull to one side due to dirty calipers?
Remove, clean and install calipers.

Brake fluid is hygroscopic and consequently takes on moisture in the air through the vent hole in brake fluid tank.
What part number is used for replacing all brake lines?
Part number 34 32 361 is used for replacing all brake lines.

When a wheel is locked with 100% slip, the frictional force will normally be lower than when a wheel is rolling.

Adjust basic clearance by operating brake pedal. A click will be heard on the rear wheel brakes until reaching the basic clearance.

Line 1 connects to the rear brake pressure regulator, and Line 2 connects to the rear brake master cylinder.

A syringe used exclusively with brake fluid should be used when drawing off brake fluid.

When the control lamp comes on immediately after starting the engine, the possible causes are hydraulic control unit operating voltage or power supply issues, or the acceleration sender has ground contact.

Chamber A serves right and left front brakes, while Chamber B serves right and left rear brakes.

Front brake calipers - remove and install procedures can be found on page 34-4.

Use the removed brake line as a template for bending.

The secondary cup (12) should be coated with silicone grease before installation.

Turn on ignition, run engine, and ensure battery is charged.

Check whether all connecting, compensating and feeding bores are clean.

Check return spring, replacing it if necessary, and adjust parking brake 34 10 014.

Loosen wire straps in multiple locations during the procedure.

Connect bleeder hose with bottle on bleeder screw, unscrew bleeder screw, and tighten bleeder screw when escaping brake fluid is without air bubbles.

Replace the clamp if necessary during installation.

You should: a) Replace wheel bearings, b) Check caliper installation, c) Check brake discs for runout, replacing if necessary, d) Measure brake disc thickness and grind or replace discs.

A represents the ABS operating range.

Air in the brake system, insufficient brake fluid in the brake fluid tank, or overheated brake fluid with vapor lock due to excessive water content in brake fluid or excessive brake loads.

Measure difference in thickness within braking surface at about 8 points with a micrometer.

The ABS detects the frictional conditions between the tires and road surface prevailing at the moment. It automatically adjusts to each change in road surface/tire relation and makes use of the highest coefficient of friction, without that the vehicle slips or skids because of wheel lock.
What job position category does this hydraulic unit pressure drop test belong to?
This test belongs to Group 34 job position category.

Compress locking clamp, disconnect parking brake cable on brake back-plate and pull out. During installation, make sure clamp fits correctly.

Check arrangement of wheel with gage, hold opposite wheel on rear axle, and replace speed sensor if necessary.

Replace control unit and repeat test step if in test steps 08, 09 and 10 valves do not switch or pump does not run.

Callout number 1 indicates the plug connection.

What does section 34.50.000 cover?
Section 34.50.000 covers checking ABS.

Perform a visual inspection for line and wire damage, check connection to vehicle ground for insulation resistance, then disconnect speed sensor plugs and check for reading greater than 999 k-ohms to replace pertinent speed sensor.

Molykote Longterm 2
What correction is needed for brake system leaks causing excessive pedal travel?
Check brake system for leaks.

Apply light pressure on push rod piston (10), lift out circlip (14) and unscrew stop screw (18). Release push rod piston (10) slowly and pull out.

Check wire 29 from multiple pin plug (control unit) to hydraulic unit plug for break and voltage drop.

Test Step 08 is for testing the ABS return delivery pump.

Pull up the parking brake lever by 5 teeth and adjust the adjusting nuts enough that left and right rear wheels can just be turned and both uniformly.

If the battery had been removed, the battery terminals must be tightened on the end poles perfectly after reinstallation of the battery.

Component 375 is the Acceleration transmitter according to the legend.

Let the push rod piston (10) come back carefully and push on the stop washer (11).

The causes are brake booster malfunctions with engine vacuum insufficient, or one brake circuit failed due to leaks or damage.
What is component 370 in the ABS system?
Component 370 is the Electronic relay.
What is the first step in removing rear wheel brake shoes?
Remove rear wheel and unscrew bolt.

Measured value reading greater than 58 ohms indicates break in wire to motor relay (from ignition switch wire 28, wires in hydraulic control unit).

Dirty caliper recesses, damaged protective caps, corrosion in calipers, or compensation bore in master cylinder clogged.

Line 3 connects to left front brake caliper, Line 4 connects to right front brake caliper, and Line 5 connects to front brake master cylinder.

Check brake system for leaks.

Press out clip (3) and pull off caliper toward rear.

Remove and install parking brake and spreader locks; check cables, replacing if necessary.

Turn wheels so that each tapped bore is approximately 30° behind the perpendicular on top.

Disconnect bottom return spring at front. Pull brake shoes out of wheel brake cylinder. Disconnect top return spring at front. Remove front brake shoes with automatic slack control.

Each started test step must be finished completely without a break!

Always replace both brake discs of one axle, even if only one brake disc has to be replaced.

Pull indicator lamp with bulb holder out of instrument cluster.

The mercury switches are installed in longitudinal direction of the car at an angle to the horizontal.

Knock out intermediate piston by knocking housing on a piece of wood lightly.

Replace wire harness. If wire power flow is okay, replace hydraulic unit.

Only the pressure building-up and pressure holding phases (2 A) can be checked in 325 iX cars because of the changed activation times in the control unit.

What is the maximum wattage rating for component 371?
Component 371 has a maximum wattage rating of 3W (max. 3W).

Testing the ABS requires the conventional brake system to be okay: bled properly, brake line connections tight, brake pads okay, master and wheel cylinders okay.

Replace wheel bearings.
