Which mounting bolts need to be unscrewed to pull off the tank?
Mounting bolts 4 and 5 need to be unscrewed to pull off the tank.
How many times should you operate the brake pedal during the function test?
Operate the brake pedal 10 times with the engine stopped.
What is the brake light switch adjustment specification?
Adjust brake light switch with nut (1) and lock nut (2) so that with the brake pedal released the contact button will be visible by distance A = 5 to 6 mm (0.197 to 0.236 in).
What is the important rule about replacing brake discs on one axle?
Always replace both brake discs of one axle, even if only one disc has to be replaced.
What conventional brake system requirements must be met for ABS testing?
Testing the ABS requires the conventional brake system to be okay: bled properly, brake line connections tight, brake pads okay, and watch uniformity of wheels on one axle.
What preliminary steps are required before testing the hydraulic unit?
Turn on ignition, run engine, and ensure battery is charged (check).
What components are shown in callout numbers 1, 2, 4, and 5 in the diagrams?
Callout 1 shows caliper mounting bolts, callout 2 shows the bolt to be unscrewed, callout 4 shows springs, and callout 5 shows the circlip for the pad wear indicator.
What are the initial conditions required before testing the solenoid pressure build-up drop hold?
Turn on ignition, run engine, and ensure battery is charged and checked.
What is the procedure for disconnecting the multiple pin plug from the ABS control unit?
Push back clamp (1) and pull out multiple pin plug (2) to the right, and then disengage it to the left.
What are the job position numbers for replacing the hydraulic unit?
Job position 34 51 520 is referenced for replacing the hydraulic unit.
Why might it be necessary to repeat this test step?
It might be necessary to repeat this test step to reach the nominal values due to the high switching-on power and short switching phase.
What cleaning method is specified for cylinder bores and parts?
Clean cylinder bores and parts with alcohol and dry with compressed air.
What is the bleeding sequence for wheel brakes?
Repeat bleeding on rear left, front right and front left.
What section number covers removing and installing the wheel brake cylinder?
Removing and installing the wheel brake cylinder is covered under section 34 21 600.
What are the four main components that the ABS system consists of?
The ABS consists of a control unit, hydraulic unit, speed sensors and a wire harness.
What is the part number for replacing the relay on the hydraulic unit for ABS?
The part number is 61 31 570.
What is the resistance value when the mercury switches provide closed contact in horizontal position?
The series connected mercury switches provide closed contact with resistance less than 1 k-ohm in horizontal position.
What must be removed to access the rear pulse sensor for replacement?
Remove rear seat cushion 52 20 010, disconnect pulse sensor plug, pull out rubber grommet and wires, then remove pulse sensor.
What is the basic adjustment distance A on the piston rod?
The basic adjustment distance A on piston rod is 125 mm (4.921").
How do you remove the check valve from the brake booster system?
Loosen clamps and take off the check valve. During installation, ensure the arrow or black side faces the intake manifold.
Can the front ABS pulse wheel be replaced by itself?
No, the front pulse wheel can only be replaced together with the bearing assembly.
What wires should I check for the front right valve?
Measure resistance direct on hydraulic unit between wires 3 and 4. Check wire 3b from hydraulic unit plug to control unit plug for breaks or short circuit.
If there's a stabilization voltage drop between wires 12 and 10, what should be checked?
Check function of electronic relay and replace control unit. Also refer to test step 05 test line 2.
Which test step should I also refer to when testing speed sensors?
Also refer to test step 03 when testing speed sensors, and bridge connections 30a and 86 on electronic relay plug.
What is the boiling point range for brake fluid?
The boiling point ranges from +240°C (464°F) to +160°C (320°F).
Which relays can be pulled out during the ABS hydraulic unit relay replacement procedure?
You can pull out either the motor relay (2) or the valve relay (3).
What should you do with the adjusting nut to move out the parking brake shoes and prevent the brake disc from turning?
Turn adjusting nut (1) with a screwdriver to move out the parking brake shoes and prevent the brake disc from turning.
Why might only the pressure building-up and pressure holding phases be checkable in 325 iX cars?

Only the pressure building-up and pressure holding phases (2 A) can be checked in 325 iX cars because of the changed activation times in the control unit. Irregular values will be displayed on adapter B in switch position (5 A).
What does component 1 represent in this ABS layout drawing?
Component 1 is the Electronic control unit.
What should you check if the hydraulic unit fails the pressure test?
Check lines to and from hydraulic unit for leaks. Replace hydraulic unit.
What is the reference number for the ABS relay replacement procedure?
The reference number is 30 34 119.
What is the first step in the brake force regulator removal procedure?
The first step is to draw off brake fluid in the tank with a syringe used exclusively with brake fluids.
What important feature does the multiple pin plug have for correct connection?
The multiple pin plug has a tab on the left side, for which the control unit must have an opening.
What does callout number 2 indicate in the ABS relay replacement procedure?
Callout number 2 indicates the motor relay that needs to be pulled out.
What should be done if there's a pump motor fault according to the troubleshooting guide?
Replace hydraulic unit if there's a pump motor fault.
What important safety instruction is given about brake hose installation?
Never twist brake hose when installing.
What orientation requirement must be followed when installing the check valve?
The arrow or black side must face the intake manifold when installing the check valve.
What does a safety lamp reading greater than 80 ohms indicate?
A reading greater than 80 ohms indicates an ABS indicator lamp fault or poor contact. Check or replace the lamp and check connections on lamp and terminal 15.
What page number contains information about bleeding the brakes?
Page 34-2 contains information about bleeding the brakes.
What are the main steps for removing the hydraulic unit assembly for ABS?
Disconnect battery ground lead, remove air cleaner, remove headlight cover, disconnect various brake lines, unscrew bolts, and pull off multiple pin plug while disconnecting ground wire.
What is the tightening torque specification for the brake booster installation?
The tightening torque is marked with an asterisk (*) indicating it should be referenced in the specifications section.
What should be checked when installing guide bolts?
Check condition of guide bolts and threads, replacing guide bolts if necessary, and apply tightening torque as specified.
What are the example pressure values given for Pressure I at the inlet and outlet?
Inlet pressure (front axle pressure): 40 bar (569 psi), Outlet pressure (rear axle pressure): 31.8 bar (452 psi).
What must be done if only one brake disc requires replacement?
Even if only one brake disc has to be replaced, always replace both brake discs of one axle.
What components are tested in this Group 34 test step?
The components tested are the solenoid left pressure build-up/drop/hold and right pressure build-up/drop/hold for the front wheels control unit/simulation.
What happens if the motor relay only switches at intervals without the pump motor running during test cycle?
The voltage will briefly drop excessively due to the high switching on power at the feed wires from the battery. Repeat test with engine running.
What page number is shown at the top of this index page?
Page number 56 is shown at the top of this index page.
What type of lines connect the hydraulic unit to the wheels?
The hydraulic unit is connected to the wheels by brake lines, shown as both solid and dashed lines in the diagram.
What are the three pressure phases that the brake hydraulic unit can adapt to?

Pressure build-up, pressure holding and pressure drop. These three pressure phases adapt themselves to the sequences and length to the requirements of the desired control characteristic and power flow between the road surface and tyre.
How should the brake shoes be spread apart during removal?
Spread brake shoes apart at bottom and lift off from above.
What specific diagnostic tool is referenced for testing ABS issues?
The Service Tester is the diagnostic tool referenced for testing ABS wire harness connections and acceleration sender issues.
What is the torque specification for tightening the stop screw during intermediate piston installation?
The stop screw (18) should be tightened with a torque of 5 to 8 Nm (3.7 to 5.9 ft. lbs.).
Where should the instrument panel trim be removed from?
Remove instrument panel trim at bottom left.
On which page can I find the ABS wiring diagram specifically for 325 iX models?
The ABS wiring diagram specifically for 325 iX models can be found on page 34-34c.
What should happen to the indicator lamp when the parking brake is released?
The indicator lamp should go out when the parking brake is released with the ignition on.
When might you need to remove caliper 34 21 220?
If necessary, remove caliper 34 21 220 when checking rear brake disc for runout and difference in thickness with rear wheel removed.
What should you do before removing the front ABS pulse sensor?
Turn off ignition and unscrew socket head bolt.
What are the terminal numbers shown for the hydraulic control unit connections?
The hydraulic control unit (361) shows terminals 30, 31, 15, and 87.
What reference is provided for additional brake disc information?
See also SI Group 34 for additional brake disc information.
What component is numbered 5 in the bottom diagram and what should be done with it?
Component 5 refers to dowel sleeves, which should be checked and replaced with dowel sleeves from repair kit if necessary.
What should you do if measured values deviate from specified values?
If measured values deviate from specified values, replace the brake force regulator.
What are the two possible causes when the ABS lamp comes on 15-20 seconds after moving off?
The two possible causes are a break in acceleration sender current path or sensor fault (break in wire).
Which ABS wire harness plug pin should be checked for ground contact issues?
Pin 16 on the ABS wire harness plug should be checked for ground contact.
How many threads should you loosen the adjusting nut by after initial adjustment?
Then loosen adjusting nut by 3 or 4 threads.
What component is shown in image 730 34 152?
The image shows the brake disc grinding setup for rear brake discs.
What should I check if the brake pedal travel is excessive even though the brakes have been bled and adjusted?
Check for a damaged primary cup in the master cylinder, separating cups on floating piston of tandem brake master cylinder causing leak, or leak in the brake system.
How should the parking brake cable be removed from the swinging arm?
Disconnect the parking brake cable on the swinging arm and pull the parking brake cable out of the protective tube.
What should I do if the hydraulic unit pressure drop test fails?
Replace hydraulic unit with part number 34 51 520.
What is the correction for a clogged brake fluid tank vent hole?
Clean brake fluid tank.
How many times should you operate the brake pedal firmly during the brake force regulator test?
Operate the brake pedal firmly at least 5 times.
What specific wires are being tested for voltage in test step 07?
Wires 1 and 10 are being tested for voltage between them in test step 07.
What reference is provided for tightening torque specifications?
The tightening torque specifications are referenced with an asterisk that directs to 'See Specifications'.
What is the maximum testing time for cars with four driven wheels on a brake test dynamometer?
Cars with four driven wheels (325 iX) must not be tested on a brake test dynamometer longer than 60 seconds or faster than 7.5 km/h (4.5 mph).
What's the correction for angular brake pad wear?

Replace wheel bearings, check caliper installation, remove and install/repair/replace calipers or wheel cylinders, grind or replace brake discs, replace brake pads, replace spring, or replace guide bolts.
How should part A be removed from the spreader assembly?
Pull off part A toward rear after pressing out pin B and pulling out part C.
What pressure range should be used for the low pressure test?
Release pedal prop so that test pressure in brake system is 2 to 5 bar (28 to 71 psi).
What job position numbers are associated with valve and motor relay testing?
Job positions 61 31 570, 61 11 530, and 34 51 520 are associated with valve relay coil resistance and motor relay coil resistance testing.
What must be done after installing the brake force regulator?
After installation, apply the tightening torque and bleed brakes according to procedure 34 00 046.
What restriction applies when performing this test step on 325 iX cars?

This test step may not be performed on a dynamometer for 325 iX cars, since the total loading time for the central lock in the transfer box must not exceed 60 seconds at a wheel speed of max. 7.5 km/h (4.5 mph).
What happens when the control unit detects a defect in the wire harness or electrical part of the equipment?

If the control unit detects a defect in the wire harness or electrical part of the equipment, the monitoring circuit will switch off the ABS and guarantees normal use of the brake system. An ABS indicator lamp reports this condition to the driver.
What should you replace if the overvoltage protector fails?
Replace electronic relay (watch above mentioned points!). Note that there is no overvoltage protection relay since 1989 models.
What is the nominal resistance value when checking the switch with wire and plug?
Less than 1 k-ohm.
What should you do to remove the rear brake disc after removing the rear wheel?
Pull off caliper toward rear and suspend with a piece of wire. Keep brake line connected, unscrew bolt and take off brake disc.
What resistance reading indicates a fault in the speed sensor wire harness?
If the DF reading is lower than the specified value, there is a fault in the wire harness. For proper operation, readings should be greater than 999 k-ohms.
What are the two main issues diagnosed in the dynamic speed sensor test?
Cycle time problems (wheel turning too fast or too slow) and pulse issues (wheel rotation not uniform enough).
What is the final step described for the long sleeve pipe removal?
Hold long sleeve pipe and pull back short sleeve section, then remove complete assembly sleeve.
What must be done after installing a new acceleration pick-up?
Adjust acceleration pick-up.
How many brake rotors/discs are shown in this routing layout diagram?
Four brake rotors are shown - one at each wheel position.
What type of safety precaution is emphasized regarding the syringe used for brake fluid?
The manual emphasizes that the syringe must be used exclusively with brake fluids, indicating the importance of avoiding contamination.
What should I do if the ABS control lamp comes on about 15 to 20 seconds after moving off at road speeds greater than 3 km/h (2 mph)?

Check for a break in acceleration sender current path or sensor fault (break in wire). Test pin 16 on ABS wire harness plug or connections 2 and 3 on acceleration sender, and check plug connections in particular using the Service Tester.
What is the first step in removing the brake master cylinder?
The first step is to draw off brake fluid in the tank with a syringe used exclusively with brake fluids, then pull off the plug and pull off clutch hydraulic hose 1.
What should be applied to the sliding surfaces and pins during spreader installation?
Give sliding surfaces and pins a thin coat of Molykote G paste.
What safety precaution must be taken before pulling off a plug and measuring resistance in test step 05?
Turn off ignition before pulling off a plug and measuring resistance.
When should the ABS indicator lamp come on and go out during normal operation?
The ABS indicator lamp comes on after turning on the ignition and should go out when the engine has started, if the ABS is okay.
What terminal numbers are shown on the connector labeled 30 31 31b 30a 86?
The terminal numbers shown on that connector are 30, 31, 31b, 30a, and 86.
What correction is needed for corroded calipers causing excessive brake heat?
Remove and install, repair or replace calipers.
If brake discs have excessive thickness difference within the braking surface, what's the fix?
Measure brake disc thickness; grind or replace discs.
What should you do if necessary when taking measurements during this test?
If necessary, take mean value from three measurements.
What should you operate several times to adjust basic clearance automatically?
Operate brake pedal several times. Basic clearance will be adjusted automatically.
What ABS system is shown in this wiring diagram?
ABS System 325 iX, which was introduced gradually since 8/87.
How does the ABS control brake pressure to maintain optimal traction?
The ABS controls the brake pressure in the wheel brake cylinder so that the slip remains in the shaded area, because here the highest frictional force is available.
What is the hydraulic unit labeled as in this diagram?
The hydraulic unit is labeled as component 2.
What should you visually inspect on the pulse wheel during installation?
It is necessary to visually inspect the pulse wheel for dirt or damage.
What should I do if there's high switching on power during the test?
Due to high switching on power, possibly repeat test step with engine running. Refer to test steps 05, 06 and 07.
What safety precaution must be taken before removing or installing the ABS control unit?
Always turn off ignition before removing or installing control unit.
What does a resistance reading less than 50 ohms indicate for valve relay?
Measured value reading less than 50 ohms indicates short circuit in wire to valve relay (wires 1 and 27, wires in hydraulic unit).
What should be checked if there is comfort impairment during ABS regulation?
Check throttle valve positioner, see 13 54 130, when comfort is impaired, e.g. shaking or stopping of engine during ABS regulation.
What special consideration applies to brake master cylinders with surface damage?
Tandem brake master cylinders with surface damage in the cylinder bore may not be reused.
What is the purpose of component 370 in this ABS wiring diagram?
Component 370 is the Electronic relay according to the legend.
Where can brake lines be obtained?
Brake lines are only available from Parts in straight version and correct length with connecting nipples.
What should you adjust after setting the basic clearance?
After setting basic clearance, adjust parking brake using procedure 34 10 014.
What are the valve components (d, e, f) in the hydraulic control unit?
Valve - front left (d), Valve - front right (e), Valve - rear left (f)
What resistance reading indicates a break in wire to valve relay?
Measured value reading greater than 100 ohms indicates break in wire to valve relay (from ignition switch wire 27, wires in hydraulic unit).
What must rest on the protective tube during cable installation?
The cable holder must rest on the protective tube during installation.
What should I check if the ABS control lamp stays on 15 to 20 seconds after starting the engine with the car stopped and engine running at idle speed?
Check for a break in the 'idle speed boost' current path, specifically looking for a break in connection between ABS wire harness plug pin 3 and solenoid ground.
What are the component numbers for the signal sensors shown on the right side of the diagram?
The signal sensor component numbers are 362 (front left), 364 (front right), 366 (rear left), and 368 (rear right).
What happens if the first circuit fails in the tandem brake master cylinder?
If the first circuit fails, piston 1 will be pressed against spring cap 7 in pressureless chamber A and the second brake circuit will function normally via chamber B.
What should you do to prevent brake fluid from damaging painted car parts?
Keep brake fluid off of painted car parts as the paint finish would be damaged.
Where is the hydraulic unit located and what system was it added to?
The hydraulic unit is located in the engine compartment and was added to the conventional brake system.
What is the primary duty of the acceleration pick-up in the BMW 325 iX?
The acceleration pick-up provides information on road condition (higher or lower traction) so that all three systems (AWD, axle locks, and ABS) can be effective simultaneously.
What temperature condition should the brakes be in before testing?
The brakes should have operating temperature, i.e. brake discs/drums should be warm and dry by way of braking the car several times.
What callout number indicates the brake disc in the removal procedure?
Callout number 2 indicates the brake disc that needs to be removed.
What job position code covers speed sensor replacement?
61 12 510 / 520 covers the speed sensor replacement procedure.
What should be used to remove the seal carefully during caliper overhaul?
Remove seal carefully with a plastic needle.
What happens when the brake pedal is operated in the tandem brake master cylinder?
Operating the brake pedal will move pistons 1 and 4 forward, causing primary cups 2 and 5 to slide over compensation bores 3 and 6, creating equal pressure in chambers A and B.
What causes the control lamp to come on after exceeding approximately 12 km/h (7.5 mph)?
The cause is return delivery pump motor electronics failure.
What should be done with bolts 7 and 8 during removal?
Unscrew bolts 7 and 8, then pull off multiple pin plug and disconnect ground wire.
What should I check if the solenoid left pressure build-up/drop/hold fails nominal values?

Turn on ignition, run engine, battery charged (check). Due to high switching on power, possibly repeat test with engine running. Replace control unit and repeat test step. If in test steps 08, 09 and 10 valves do not switch or pump does not run: replace hydraulic unit.
What callout number indicates connection 16 in the bottom diagram?
Callout number 16 indicates the connection point for resistance measurement.
What section number covers removing and installing parking brake shoes?
Section 34 41 200 covers removing and installing parking brake shoes.
What equipment is shown for grinding brake discs?
A brake disc grinding machine is shown, which is used to fine grind both sides of brake discs.
What is the procedure number for replacing the brake booster?
The procedure number for replacing the brake booster is 34 33 000.
What component is indicated by callout number 7 in the brake booster replacement procedure?
Callout number 7 indicates the rubber ring between the tandem brake master cylinder and brake booster.
How do I correct dispersion in sensor wire issues?
Check the routing of wires for ABS sensors.
What system is being tested in test step 03?
Dynamic speed sensor test for speed sensors (DF) including front left, front right, rear left, and rear right sensors.
What precaution must be taken when welding with an electric welder?
Remove plugs from the electronic control unit and turn off ignition when welding with an electric welder.
What is specifically not approved during the overhaul process?
Machining of cylinder bores and pistons is not approved.
What angle should you turn the return springs when pushing them in?
Push in return springs and turn 90°.
Where is the parking brake cable disconnected?
Disconnect parking brake cable on semi-trailing arm.
What job position code is associated with valve relay troubleshooting?
Job position code 61 31 570 is associated with valve relay troubleshooting.
What important note applies to ABS overvoltage protection since 1989?
There is no overvoltage protection relay since 1989 models except for four wheel drive; it is now integrated in the ABS control unit (Control Unit No. 0265 103 041).
What is the part number shown at the bottom left of the page?
The part number shown is 30 34 125.
What section covers removing and installing rear disc brakes?
Section 34 21 300 covers removing and installing rear disc brakes, and the parking brake shoes procedure involves disconnecting the bottom return spring with brake spring pliers.
What is the final step in the bleeding procedure?
Hold brake pedal in down position, shut bleeder valves, and release brake pedal.
What precautions are needed when testing the ABS system?
Testing the ABS requires the conventional brake system to be okay: bled properly, brake line connections tight, brake pads okay, and watch uniformity of wheels on one axle.
What should be checked between the tandem brake master cylinder and brake booster during installation?
Check the rubber ring (7) between the tandem brake master cylinder and brake booster, and replace if necessary.
What should be disconnected when removing the rear brake caliper?
Disconnect brake line after drawing off brake fluid.
What job position classification applies to this hydraulic unit test?
This test falls under Group 34 job position classification.
What should you do if the switching point is now within tolerances after installing the shim?

If the switching point is now within tolerances, remove the special tool and install acceleration pick-up with shim and shear-off screws, then tighten shear-off screws and lock by shearing off the heads.
What tool is needed for measuring brake disc thickness variations?
Use a micrometer to measure difference in thickness within braking surface.
What should you check when reusing the pad wear indicator circlip?
Check circlip (5) when reusing. Replace pad wear indicators with ground off plastic part.
What are the three phases of the brake breaking-in procedure after replacing brake discs?
Phase 1: 5 full stop braking actions from 50 km/h (30 mph). Phase 2: Let brakes cool down. Phase 3: 5 additional braking actions from 50 km/h (30 mph).
Which component is identified as the hydraulic control unit?
Component 361
What important safety precaution is mentioned regarding the dust cover on brake pistons?
Be careful not to damage dust cover on brake piston when assembling. Check dust cover. Check installed position of springs (4).
What is the reference number for the ABS indicator lamp replacement procedure?
The reference number is 30 34 122.
What must be done to adjust the parking brake after disc replacement?
Adjust parking brake 34 10 014.
What should I check first when troubleshooting the front left speed sensor?
Check the front left plug connection through visual inspection, then disconnect the front left plug and verify the DF reading is greater than 999 k-ohms.
What electronic component should be removed as plug number 3?
Pull off electronic relay (3).
Can the distance between the pulse sensor and pulse wheel be adjusted?
No, the distance between pulse sensor and pulse wheel is given by design and cannot be adjusted.
What component needs to be pulled off on the right side during brake pad removal?
Pull off brake pad wear indicator plug on the right side.
Where can you find the brake test dynamometer reference for 325 iX cars?
Refer to brake test dynamometer in 34 00 009.
How should the intermediate piston be secured during installation?
Hold intermediate piston against stop firmly and screw in screw (18) with a new aluminum ring (16).
How many pulse sensors are shown in this ABS layout?
There are four pulse sensors shown, all labeled as component 3, positioned at each wheel location.
What tools are needed to diagnose erroneous ABS indicator lamp operation?
The causes for erroneous indication can be found with the help of a BMW service tester and a brake test dynamometer.
What component do you need to lift and unscrew the bolt for during parking brake lever removal?
Lift out rear ashtray and unscrew bolt.
What special tool is required for adjusting the acceleration pick-up for ABS?
Special Tool 34 5 150 is required for adjusting the acceleration pick-up.
What should you check if the front left/right or rear left/right circuits are not working properly?

Due to high switching on power, possibly repeat test step with engine running. Refer to test steps 05, 06 and 07. Testing the ABS requires the conventional brake system to be okay: bled properly, brake line connections tight, brake pads okay, master and wheel cylinders okay. Watch uniformity of wheels on one axle. Observe relation between wheel - reading.
What should you check before bleeding the brakes?
Check gasket (arrow), connect bleeder on brake fluid tank, and check operating instructions supplied with bleeder.
What is the torque specification for the caliper mounting bolts when installing front brake discs?
The tightening torque is specified for caliper mounting bolts, but the specific value is referenced to the Specifications section.
What are the possible causes of brakes squealing or rattling?

Wrong type of pads, dirty caliper recesses, spring force insufficient, brake disc not aligned with caliper, brake disc runout, excessive thickness difference within braking surface, brake drums out-of-true, knocking brake drums, dirt and dust in brake drums, liner wear excessive or one-sided, rust edges on brake discs, pad loose, or wheel bearing play excessive.
What should you check if the brake booster is malfunctioning?
Check power brake system - check engine (valves, cylinder head, gasket, etc.).
What is the complete page range reference for ABS troubleshooting in the manual?
The complete page range reference for ABS troubleshooting is 34-35.
What does component 360 represent in this ABS wiring diagram?
Component 360 is the Electronic control unit according to the legend.
What section should be referenced for additional service information?
See Service Information of Group 34.
What diagnostic procedure is recommended for valve relay diode testing since 1988 models?
Diode test between wires 7 and 4 (M 09) - replace hydraulic unit. Diode now in valve relay since 1988 models / replace valve relay. Measure on valve relay between pins 30 and L1.
How do you fix insufficient parking brake effect caused by oil-splattered brake shoes?
Replace brake liners and eliminate cause.
What specific ABS component must be checked when testing brake dynamometer roller speed?
The precise roller speed of a brake test dynamometer must be checked with a '3' series car fitted with ABS, using ABS test step 03 dynamic/speed sensor and switch on the dynamometer.
What part number is specified for the wedge used in shimming?
The wedge, Part No. 34 51 1 156 827, is equal to 4.9 to 5.3 mm (0.193 to 0.209'').
What section should you refer to for bleeding brakes after caliper installation?
Bleed brakes - see 34 00 046/047.
Where should you check the ground connections for wires 10, 20, and 34?
Check ground connection below instrument panel on left side and check flow of multiple pin plug on wire harness (control unit) to ground connection.
What adjustment procedure is referenced for parking brake installation?
Adjust parking brake 34 10 014 is referenced for both installation after removing the parking brake lever and for installation after replacing brake shoes.
Where should you refer for replacing the wheel hub assembly?
See Replacing Wheel Hub - 31 21 180.
What visual inspection should be performed if there are cycle time issues?
Check for excessive clearance between speed sensor and pulse wheel, verify speed sensor is not loose or dirty, and check installation.
Which component is identified as KL61 in the wiring diagram?
KL61 is identified as Term. 61 (charge ind. lamp) according to the legend.
How is ABS function checked according to the manual?
Function is checked with a BMW service test unit. The tester is connected on the wire harness and control unit with a special plug.
What bleeding procedure should be performed after brake hose installation?
Bleed brakes using procedure 34 00 046.
Where is the main brake component/master cylinder assembly located in this layout?
The main brake component assembly is located in the center-left area of the diagram, appearing to be mounted on what looks like the firewall or brake booster area.
How do you disconnect the consols after lifting the rear ashtray?
Disconnect consols by pushing back and remove.
What should be used to protect the piston when pressing it out?
Place a liner (hard wood, hard felt or similar material) in caliper recess to protect the piston.
What should you apply to the cylinder bore before installation?
Give cylinder bore a very thin coat of ATE brake cylinder paste.
Which brake lines belong to the 1st brake circuit?
Brake lines 2 (front left) and 3 (front right) belong to the 1st brake circuit.
What is required when replacing the ABS control unit regarding the code number?
Only use a control unit with the correct code number.
What job position numbers are referenced for the left pressure solenoid troubleshooting?
Job positions 34 52 510 and 34 51 520 are referenced for the left pressure solenoid troubleshooting.
What should be done if pressure drops considerably during the low pressure test?
If pressure drops considerably, inspect all rubber parts. Bleed brake calipers and wheel brake cylinders after finishing test.
What happens to the fuse box during this procedure?
Remove fuse box and push wire harness into passenger compartment.
What maintenance should be performed on the push rod threads if applicable?
If applicable, clean and give threads of push rod a light coat of grease.
What sound indicates you have reached the basic clearance when adjusting?
A click will be heard on the rear wheel brakes until reaching the basic clearance.
What's the correction for excessive brake pedal travel?
Overhaul or replace the brake master cylinder, or check the brake system for leaks.
What are the possible causes if the brakes pull to one side?

The causes include: tire inflation pressure incorrect, uneven tire tread wear, oil on pads/liners, pad/liner type not as specified, caliper recesses dirty, guide bolts dirty or damaged, rear wheel alignment maladjusted, corrosion in calipers or wheel cylinders, shock absorbers without action, pad of one caliper worn, or pad glazed.
If the motor relay operating contact has a voltage drop, what wires should be checked for flow?

Check flow in following wires: from term. B + to plug hydraulic unit wire 12, from multiple pin plug (control unit) wire 14 to hydraulic unit plug, from wire 9 in hydraulic unit to motor relay term. 30 and positive terminal on pump motor.
Which components represent the rear wheel signal senders?
Component 366 (signal sender rear left) and component 368 (signal sender rear right)
What percentage of braking deceleration is necessary to open the contact?
Braking deceleration of 35 to 45% is necessary to open the contact due to the glass tube inclination.
What must engage when working with the automatic slack control arrangement?
Thermo clip must engage (arrow). Note bends of return springs.
What component numbers are associated with the connection boxes labeled 363, 365, 367, and 369?
Components 363, 365, 367, and 369 are labeled as signal sensor connections (left front, left rear, right rear, and right front respectively).
When should you replace a pedal with an injection molded bearing sleeve?
Replace the pedal in case of wear, or when pedal movement is difficult.
How do you disconnect the return spring on a clutch pedal version?
For the version with return spring on clutch pedal, disconnect the return spring on the body.
What reference number is shown for the pedal layout drawing?
The pedal layout drawing reference number is 28 35 001.
What preliminary step is required before removing the accelerator pedal lever?
Remove dashboard trim panel at bottom left - see Group 51.
Which dashboard component needs to be removed before accessing the brake pedal?
Remove the dashboard trim panel at bottom left, and refer to Group 51 for this procedure.
What is the key requirement when adjusting the clutch pedal eccentric bolt?
Turn the eccentric bolt until dot on the eccentric bolt is opposite the clutch master cylinder.
What is specifically prohibited regarding the eccentric bolt positioning?
Intermediate positioning of the eccentric bolt is not permitted!
What lubrication step is required during installation of press fit bearing sleeves?
Lubricate spacer with grease during installation.
What callout letter shows the stop light switch adjustment location?
Callout letter B shows the stop light switch adjustment location.
What lubrication is required during installation of the accelerator pedal lever?
Lubricate bearing surfaces with grease.
How do you remove the cable from the engine compartment wall?
Compress locking hooks and pull cable out of the engine compartment wall.
What should be checked when installing the brake pedal assembly in models with over-center helper spring?
Check for correct installed position in models with an over-center helper spring. Also refer to the pedal assembly drawing.
On which page can I find information about pedal base removal and installation?
Pedal base removal and installation information is on page 35-3.
What is the procedure number for removing and installing the brake pedal?
The procedure number is 35 21 000 for removing and installing brake pedal.
How should the eccentric be removed and what preparation is needed for installation?
Unscrew nut and pull out eccentric. For installation, lubricate setscrew with grease before installing and apply specified tightening torque.
What is the production diameter specification for drilling or reaming the bearing sleeve?
What component replacement procedure is found on page 35-10 related to the EH transmission?
Kickdown switch replacement for EH transmission is found on page 35-10.
What are the first three steps for automatic transmission accelerator cable adjustment?
Steps 1-3 are the same as for manual transmission.
What page number is shown at the top of the page?
The page number is 35-2.
What is the primary focus of this diagram?
The primary focus is showing the control distances and clearance measurements for pedal side clearance, with dimensional markers indicating specific measurement points.
What reference numbers are associated with the pedal assembly diagrams?
What type of clutch pedal configuration is shown in one of the versions?
Version with Return Spring on Clutch Pedal is shown, where you disconnect return spring on body.
What does callout number 2 show in the brake linkage diagram?
Callout number 2 shows the shaft that needs to be pulled out after pressing off the clamp.
Where can information about checking the pressure point for automatic transmission be found?
Check the pressure point for automatic transmission - see 24 00 004.
What lubricant should be used when installing the eccentric bolt?
Install eccentric bolt with Molykote Longterm 2. Tightening torque*.
What dimensional callout is shown on the clutch pedal diagram?
The clutch pedal diagram shows a dimensional callout labeled as B.
How much play should there be on the full throttle stop of the throttle valve with the accelerator pedal plate in full throttle position?
There should still be 0.5 mm (0.020") play on the full throttle stop of the throttle valve.
Where should you disconnect the brake pedal return spring?
Disconnect the brake pedal return spring on the pedal itself.
What diagram number corresponds to the pedal lever cable connection?
What procedure is described for removing bolts?
Unscrew bolts, with installation requiring tightening torque as specified.
Which page contains information about clutch pedal removal and installation?
Clutch pedal removal and installation is covered on page 35-6.
What accelerator pedal procedures are covered on page 35-8?
Page 35-8 covers accelerator pedal removal and installation, as well as accelerator lever removal and installation.
What adjustment procedure is mentioned for the clutch pedal installation?
Adjust clutch pedal to distance (B) with the eccentric and apply specified tightening torque.
What should always be replaced when removing the accelerator pedal?
Replace a removed accelerator pedal with a new part in general. Clips on the old part could be damaged, so that the accelerator pedal can slide out of the plate.
What is the adjusting increment when unscrewing the adjusting screw for throttle cable adjustment?
Unscrewing the adjusting screw one and one half turns equals 0.5 mm (0.020") play.
What does the asterisk notation indicate regarding specifications?
The asterisk notation indicates to see Specifications for additional details.
What do callout numbers 1 and 2 indicate in the brake pedal removal diagram?
Callout 1 indicates the clamp on brake linkage to press off, and callout 2 indicates the shaft to pull out.
What adjustment is required for the stop light switch during installation?
Adjust stop light switch to distance (B).
What type of nut should be used during installation?
Replace self-locking nut. Tightening torque*.
What dimensional markers are labeled on the pedal diagram?
The dimensional markers labeled are H*, J*, F*, K*, and G*.
What important limitation must be observed regarding movement in the brake master cylinder?
Movement must be limited in the brake master cylinder and may not be accomplished with, for example, the stop light switch (distance B).
What should you do if pedal movement becomes difficult on a pedal with injection molded bearing sleeve?
Drill or ream out the bearing sleeve to a production diameter of 14.2 ± 0.1 mm, then lubricate the bearing surface with grease.
What is the title of this section?
CONTROL DISTANCES FOR PEDAL SIDE CLEARANCE
What are the image reference numbers shown for the brake pedal removal procedures?
The image reference numbers shown are 30 35 035, 30 35 011, 30 35 019, and 30 35 019.
What dimensional callouts are shown on the brake pedal diagram?
The brake pedal diagram shows dimensional callouts labeled as A and B.
What instruction is given for handling the nipple off the cable?
Take nipple off of cable.
What lubricant should be applied during installation of brake linkage components?
Lubricate bearing surfaces with grease during installation.
What distance should the brake pedal be adjusted to on the brake master cylinder push rod?
Adjust brake pedal to distance (A) on the brake master cylinder push rod.
What should be disconnected from the accelerator lever during removal?
Disconnect accelerator lever spring on pedal.
What should be checked at control distance C* for automatic transmission full throttle stop adjustment?
Check control distance C* of the full throttle stop.
Where should you disconnect the cable during accelerator cable replacement?
Disconnect cable on pedal lever.
What is the part number for the clutch pedal assembly shown in the upper diagram?
The part number for the clutch pedal assembly is 30 35 028.
What section number covers the pedals in this BMW E30 M3 service manual?
Section 35 covers the pedals.
What is the part number shown for the replacing kickdown switch?
35 41 480 REPLACING KICKDOWN SWITCH (EH TRANSMISSION).
What is the procedure for removing the brake pedal shaft?
Unscrew the nut, pull out the shaft, and then take off the pedal.
Where can you find information about removing the dashboard trim panel?
See Group 51 for dashboard trim panel removal procedures.
What is the procedure number for replacing the accelerator cable?
35 41 421 REPLACING ACCELERATOR CABLE
What must be reached when adjusting the distance B?
Distance B must be reached. Turn the eccentric bolt 180° if distance B is not reached with the previously described adjustment.
What component is indicated by callout number 1 in the press fit bearing sleeve diagram?
The bearing sleeves that need to be pressed out for brake and clutch pedals.
What are the two BMW part numbers for replacing pedal bearing sleeves?
35 21 011 for replacing brake pedal bearing sleeve and 35 31 011 for replacing clutch pedal bearing sleeve.
What should be done during installation of the kickdown switch?
Adjust locknuts to distance C*. Make final adjustments after installation. Tightening torque*.
What part number is shown for the stop light switch component?
The stop light switch component shows part number 30 35 018.
What special consideration applies to stop light switches on 1987 and later models?
For stop light switches since 1987 models, adjust according to Group 61 and check function of stop lights.
How should the full throttle stop be adjusted for automatic transmission in kickdown position?
Adjust full throttle stop so there is still 0.5 mm (0.020") play on full throttle stop of the throttle valve in kickdown position (pedal pressed beyond full throttle stop).
What component is shown in diagram 30 35 460?
The diagram shows the stop light switch component.
What could happen if damaged clips are not replaced on the accelerator pedal?
The accelerator pedal can slide out of the plate, which could lead to an accident.
What callout letter indicates the brake master cylinder push rod adjustment point in the diagram?
Callout letter A indicates the brake master cylinder push rod adjustment point.
What should be disconnected before removing the dashboard trim panel?
Disconnect battery ground lead before removing dashboard trim panel at bottom left.
Which pedal assembly shows the most detailed spring mechanism?
The clutch pedal assembly shows the most detailed spring mechanism, specifically featuring an over-center helper spring with detailed internal components.
What plugs need to be removed from the steering column area?
Pull off plug on stop light switch and pull off central electric plug on steering column.
What special note applies to 1987 models regarding the stop light switch?
Beginning with 1987 models, pull off plug of stop light switch - see Group 61.
What diagram number corresponds to the locking hooks illustration?
What are the part numbers for the brake and accelerator pedal assemblies?
The brake pedal assembly part number is 30 35 001 and the accelerator pedal assembly part number is 20 35 022.
What are the final steps for pedal removal?
Unscrew nut. Pull out shaft and take off pedal.
How should you remove press fit bearing sleeves from brake and clutch pedals?
Press out bearing sleeves (1) for brake and clutch pedals.
Where is the base unscrewed from during disassembly?
Unscrew base on engine compartment wall.
What should you check after installing the accelerator pedal clips?
Always check that clips engage correctly.
How do you remove the accelerator pedal lever retainer?
Pull off retainer (1). Slide shaft to the left.
What type of nuts should be used during brake pedal installation?
Replace with self-locking nuts and apply the specified tightening torque.
What functional check is required after adjusting the stop light switch on 1987 and later models?
Check function of stop lights after adjustment.
How should the brake pedal be prepared during installation?
Lubricate brake pedal with grease in area of the stop light switch.
What are the three main pedal assemblies shown in these layout drawings?
The three main pedal assemblies shown are the clutch pedal, brake pedal, and accelerator pedal.
What must be removed before accessing the accelerator cable according to the manual?
Remove dashboard trim panel at bottom left - see Group 51.
What reference number is associated with the lower component shown?
The lower component is associated with reference number 30 35 468.
How are the control distances measured in this diagram?
The control distances are measured using dimensional markers H*, J*, F*, K*, and G* which show various clearance measurements around the pedal assembly.
What must be removed first before working on the clutch pedal according to section 35 31 000?
Remove dashboard trim panel at bottom left - see Group 51.
What lubrication is required during brake pedal installation?
Lubricate brake pedal with grease in area of the stop light switch.
What components are shown in the upper portion of the diagram?
The upper portion shows what appears to be pedal mounting hardware and connection points, including cylindrical components and mounting brackets.
What specific component is labeled on the clutch pedal assembly?
The clutch pedal assembly shows an over-center helper spring component.
What reference is provided for checking the kickdown switch on EH transmission?
Check - see BMW Test Plan in Group 24. Pull off flat male plug (1). Unscrew nuts (2). Unscrew switch.
What is the section number and title for removing and installing the pedal base assembly?
Section 35 11 000 REMOVING AND INSTALLING PEDAL BASE ASSEMBLY.
What component should be used to lock the full throttle stop adjustment?
Lock with the M 8 nut.
What procedure is covered on pages 35-5 for the brake pedal?
Brake pedal remove and install procedure is covered on page 35-5.
How do you identify press fit bearing sleeves during inspection?
Bearing sleeves protrude into the guide pipe on the left and right sides by only approximately 17 mm (0.669 inches).
What should you do with the operating nipple during the procedure?
Press operating nipple (1) out of the throttle valve lever. Disconnect rubber pad on holder (2).
What is the first step in removing the eccentric according to the procedure shown?
Unscrew nut - pull out eccentric (1).
What components are shown in the wheel balancing setup diagram?
The diagram shows the car positioned on the balancing equipment with leads connected for the test sender, and the balancing machine positioned next to the vehicle.
At what speed is wheel balancing performed?
Balancing is performed with engine power in fourth gear at 100 km/h (60 mph).
What special precaution applies to TD tires during removal?

TD tires require somewhat greater pressing-off force because of the tight fit of the bead toe, and the TD bead toe could spring out of the Denloc groove suddenly, causing the pressing-off horn to jump inward.
What should be adjusted on the finish balancer before starting?
Adjust the correct sensitivity on the finish balancer to the supplied operating instruction prior to balancing.
What should you check on the wheel bolt threads before installation?
Check wheel bolt threads and tapers for wear, replacing wheel bolts if necessary.
What should you check while running the mounting machine forward during upper bead installation?
Run the mounting machine forward (clockwise) a short distance while checking that the lower tire bead remains in the well.
What is the important warning given about handling the tire bead during mounting?
Don't pinch or damage the bead.
What must be done before electronic finish balancing on the 325 iX?
Always first balance all wheels stationary prior to electronic (finish) balancing.
Which direction should the narrow rim shoulder always face?
Narrow rim shoulder always faces up.
What should you do after releasing the lock and tilting back the mounting pillar?
Unclamp and clean the rim, replace the valve, coat the rim flange and tire beads with mounting paste, then clamp the rim on the mounting machine.
What is shown in the lower left photograph?
Balance wheel to operating instructions of pertinent balancing machine.
What type of balancing machine center should be used?
Use suitable center of pertinent balancing machine.
What cross-reference is mentioned for additional balancing information?
Also refer to Service Information of Group 36, and Service Information 36 0 483 (196) must be eliminated prior to finish balancing.
What type of balancing machine should be used for wheel balancing?
Use a suitable center of pertinent balancing machine.
How is the maximum runout measurement obtained during the procedure?
Turn wheel by hand and measure max. tire radial runout or max. tire lateral runout depending on the measurement being performed.
What is the torque specification for tightening wheel rim bolts crosswise?
1,000 kg/cm (according to the tightening torque specifications shown).
What final step is required after mounting and inflating the tire?
Screw in the valve insert and correct the tire inflation pressure.
What additional check should be performed if necessary during wheel balancing?
If necessary, check wheel and tire for radial and lateral runout - see 36 10 209.
What should you do to mark the wheel position before removing it?
Mark the position of the wheel to the wheel hub before removing, in order to avoid clamping errors.
What should be done before pressing off the tire bead to avoid damage?
It will be necessary to loosen the tire on the inside and outside by applying the pressing-off horn on the bead periphery at several points before pressing off the bead.
Where should Special Tool 36 1 000 be applied when checking radial runout?
Apply Special Tool 36 1 000 on the road contact surface of the tire.
What should you avoid when measuring lateral runout?
Don't measure on tire specifications. The tool must be perpendicular to the tire's side surface.
How should the BMW 325 iX be positioned for finish balancing when using measuring supports?
Position car on four finish balancing measuring supports. When only two measuring supports are used, two further identical jacks with lateral movement must be used on the other axle.
Where should the special tool be positioned when measuring lateral runout?
Apply Special Tool 36 1 000 on the side surface of the tire.
What should you do after 1,000 km if new wheel rims are mounted for the first time?
If new wheel rims are mounted for the first time, recheck the tightening torque after 1,000 km (600 miles).
What should be checked on the tire before balancing?
Check tire inflation pressure, condition of tire (damage, cuts, flat spots caused by not using car with hot tires for a long time).
What are the three numbered components shown in the balancing machine center diagram?
1 is Basic flange, 2 is Center, and 3 is Type flange.
What is the maximum acceptable finish balance value for a wheel?
If a value of more than 15 grams is displayed for finish balancing of a wheel, the possible causes must be eliminated and the finish balanced wheels rechecked.
What should be done if a wheel displays more than 15 grams imbalance during finish balancing?
The possible causes (e.g. inaccurate stationary balancing, centering, etc.) must be eliminated prior to finish balancing and before rechecking the finished wheel.
What is the critical positioning requirement for the special tool during runout measurement?
The special tool must be perpendicular to the tire's road contact surface (for radial) or perpendicular to the tire's side surface (for lateral).
What should you do first after mounting but before inflating the tire?
First release the clamps and then inflate the tire (without valve insert).
What is the maximum inflation pressure allowed if tire beads seat on rim flange correctly?
If tire beads seat on rim flange correctly, increase the inflation pressure to max. 4.0 bar (57 psi) to have the tire settle.
What three types of wheel bolts are shown in the diagram?
a) Wheel bolt - galvanized, b) Wheel bolt - black chrome plated, c) Wheel bolt - black chrome plated and lockable (optional extra).
Can sensitivity settings be transferred between different wheel positions?
Since the sensitivity degree for balancing a wheel can not be transferred to a different wheel position or different car, it must be determined separately for each wheel.
What type of wheels can the shown wheel bolts be used for?
Wheel bolts can be used for either steel or aluminum wheel rims since 9.82.
What type of tire irons should be used for aluminum rims?
Use coated or shrink-fit hose covered tire irons for aluminum rims.
How should the upper tire bead be positioned during the mounting process?
Press the upper tire bead underneath the mounting finger. The tire bead should seat in rollers next to the mounting finger.
Where can specifications for wheel runout limits be found?
See Specifications (as noted at the bottom of the page).
What is the maximum spring pressure allowed when inflating tires during mounting?
The maximum spring pressure is 3.3 bar (47 psi).
What type of supply is required for tire mounting according to the footnote?
Tire mounting paste is required, with HWB listed as the source of supply.
What must be avoided when lowering the hoist arms during balancing?
Never touch the body during balancing procedures to avoid resonance oscillation.
Where should measurements be taken when checking rim well runout?
Measure on both sides of rim well.
Which wheels should be balanced first during the balancing procedure?
Balance the wheels on the front axle first.
What must be aligned during tire mounting to ensure proper installation?
The green dot on the tire must be aligned with the punch mark in the rim flange.
How should the hoist arms be positioned during the balancing procedure?
Lower the arms of the hoist until they have just barely cleared, but never touch the body during balancing procedures (resonance oscillation).
What special tool is required for measuring tire radial and lateral runout?
Special Tool 36 1 000 is required for measuring tire runout.
How far to the right of the mounting head should the valve be positioned during tire mounting?
The valve should be positioned 10 cm (4") to the right of the mounting head.
What should be done with the bottom bead after the upper bead is pulled off the rim?
Now also lift the bottom bead over the mounting finger with the tire iron, if the upper bead is pulled off of the rim.
What critical warning is given about TD tires and rim compatibility?
TD tires may only be mounted on TD rims. Installing TD tires on wrong types of rims could cause tire damage, which could lead to tire blowouts while driving.
What type of surface is required for wheel balancing?
Balancing must be carried out on firm underground (concrete floor without basement).
In which direction should the mounting machine run back initially?
Let mounting machine run back a short distance (counterclockwise) so that the tire bead can slide fully on to the mounting finger.
What pressure should you initially inflate the tire to in steps?
Increase the pressure in steps to 3.3 bar (47 psi) spring pressure.
What is the first step mentioned for removing a wheel?
Loosen wheel bolts as the first step in the wheel removal process.
What preparation steps must be completed before checking wheel rim runout?
Remove wheel (see 36 10 300), take tire off of wheel rim, remove old balance weights, and remove dirt on rim well and rim flange.
What reference section should be consulted for additional 325 iX balancing information?
See 36 10 508 and also refer to Service Information 36 0 483 (196).
What reference should be consulted for additional workshop equipment information?
Also refer to Workshop Equipment Planning Documents.
What should be adjusted on the mounting head during setup?
Adjust mounting head, whereby it must be pressed on the rim edge fully and turn down the lever for the clamp; normally the distance of the mounting head will set in automatically.
What is the maximum acceptable finish balancing value before investigating other causes?
If a value of more than 15 grams is displayed for finish balancing of a wheel, possible causes must be eliminated prior to finish balancing and before rechecking the finished wheel.
Where should the chalk mark be positioned relative to the valve?
The chalk mark should be made on the outside of the tire being balanced, opposite the valve.
Where should the workshop jack be applied on the front axle final drive?
Apply a workshop jack underneath the front axle final drive in the middle and with light pressure, in order to suppress the oscillation of the front axle final drive.
What should be done with the valve and valve insert when removing a tubeless tire?
The valve and valve insert must be replaced each time a tubeless tire is removed and installed.
How long should the chalk mark be made on the tire?
Paste adhesive tape or make a chalk mark, both 3 to 4 cm (1.18" to 1.57") long, on the outside of the tire being balanced, opposite the valve.
What is the first step after removing the wheel for runout checking?
Mount wheel rim on balancing machine.
What are the three components labeled in the balancing machine diagram?
1 - Basic flange, 2 - Center, 3 - Type flange.
When should the machine be stopped during the mounting process?
Stop the machine and let it run back slightly, if the bead clamps.
How should the dial gage be positioned when checking rim flange runout?
Apply dial gage tip on rim flange, turn wheel by hand and measure max. lateral runout. The dial gage must be perpendicular to the rim flange.
How should aluminum wheel rims be prepared for balance weight installation?
Press the side of the tire away from the rim flange slightly at an appropriate point with a tire clamp and insert a holder.
Where should the tire bead jump over the hump of the rim shoulder during mounting?
Let the tire bead jump over the hump of the rim shoulder first, coming from the rim well.
Which page contains information about tire mounting with modern mounting machines?
Page 36-10
What should be removed from the wheel before balancing it dynamically?
Remove old balance weights, stones in treads and large pieces of dirt.
What precaution is mentioned regarding the exhaust extraction hose?
The exhaust extraction hose may not touch the tail panel.
What must not touch during the balancing procedure?
The exhaust extraction hose must not touch the tail panel.
What additional reference should be consulted for wheel balancing procedures?
Also refer to Service Information of Group 36.
What workshop equipment reference should be consulted for proper support placement?
See Service Information or Workshop Equipment Planning Documents.
Where should pertinent information be provided for the driver regarding new wheel rims?
Provide pertinent information on a label or tag in view of the driver regarding the retightening requirement for new wheel rims.
How should the tire beads be positioned when they fit too tight during mounting?
If tire beads fit too tight, first only loosen tire from flange at several points with the pressing-off horn prior to the actual pressing-off.
What critical positioning requirement applies to both flange and rim well measurements?
The dial gage must be perpendicular to the rim flange when checking flange runout, and perpendicular to the rim well when checking rim well runout.
What inspection should be performed on the wheel rim before mounting a tire?
Clean the wheel rim thoroughly and inspect the rim for damage before mounting the tire.
What is the recommended distance from the mounting head to the rim edge?
The valve should be about 10 cm (4") to the right of the mounting head.
What is the important safety note about mounting the wheel on the balancing machine?
To avoid clamping errors, the wheel must be mounted on the balancing machine in the same manner (e.g. valve facing down) as mounted afterwards on the car.
What equipment is needed for this wheel rim checking procedure?
A suitable center of pertinent balancing machine and a dial gage.
What is the purpose of applying light pressure with the workshop jack on the final drives?
The light pressure is applied in order to suppress the oscillation of the front axle final drive and rear axle final drive.
What is the procedure number for checking wheel rim for radial and lateral runout?
The procedure number is 36 10 715.
How should wheel bolt threads be prepared before installation?
Give wheel bolt threads a light coat of grease, however the taper must remain free of grease.
Where can additional service information for wheel balancing be found?
Refer to Service Information of Group 36.
How must the wheel be oriented when mounting it on the balancing machine?
The wheel must be mounted on the balancing machine in the same manner as mounted on the car with valve facing down, in order to avoid transmitted tension.
What is the maximum settle pressure specified for tire mounting?
The maximum settle pressure is 4.0 bar (57 psi).
What are the two components shown in the arrangement of balance weights for cast aluminum rims?
1 - Spring holder, 2 - Balance weight.
What engine conditions are required during the balancing procedure?
The engine must run smoothly without hesitation, doors, engine hood and trunk lid must be closed and the driver must sit in the car as still as possible.
What important check must be performed on the transmission end joint for the 325 iX?
Check the deflection angle of the transmission end joint.
What equipment is required for connecting the balancing machine?
Connect leads for test sender. Balance wheels to operating instructions supplied with pertinent balancing machine.
What should be done for rims 5 1/2 inches and larger?
From 5 1/2" Rims On: Apply the measuring support without an additional fork on control arm (2). Lift car with the measuring support.
What section reference is given for removing the wheel before checking for lateral and radial runout?
See section 36 10 300 for wheel removal procedures.
What should be done to prepare the rim before mounting the tire?
Pull off balance weights on rim and clean rim to remove large pieces of dirt, then coat tire beads with mounting paste.
What condition must the car be in after jacking up for wheel balancing?
The car must be level after jacking up and all wheels must turn easily.
How should you position the tire bead relative to the mounting finger?
The tire bead should seat in the roller next to the mounting finger, and you should press the tire underneath the mounting finger by hand.
How should the machine be operated to complete tire separation?
Let machine run back a short distance again and then forward (clockwise) briefly, until there is complete separation of the tire from the rim.
Where should measuring supports be positioned on the rear axle?
Apply measuring supports underneath the rear axle on each trailing arm as close as possible to the wheel, using suitable holding forks or additional forks.
What notation indicates maximum imbalance specifications?
Max. imbalance per wheel and side (with asterisk notation indicating to see Specifications and Workshop Equipment Planning Documents).
What should be checked when the mounting machine runs forward briefly?
Always check whether the bottom bead is fully in the well and the tire is given enough time to move.
At what speed should wheel balancing be performed on the BMW E30?
Balancing is performed with engine power in fourth gear at about 100 km/h (50 mph).
How should you operate the mounting machine when seating the lower tire bead?
Let the mounting machine run forward (clockwise) a short distance. The lower tire bead will drop into the well.
What should always be done before electronic balancing of wheels?
Always first balance the wheels stationary precisely prior to electronic (finish) balancing.
What reference should be consulted for additional balancing machine information?
Refer to Workshop Equipment Planning Documents.
What should be done to the wheels after testing is complete?
Brake the wheels carefully after testing. Repeat test after installation of balance weights on the displayed positions.
What type of support should be used on the trailing arm?
Use an unsprung support on the trailing arm of the running wheel (be careful of brake pipes and hoses), in order to suppress the oscillation from the final drive.
What should you do if the tire bead does not slide onto the rim edge properly during inflation?

Do not increase the pressure. Instead, the tire must be deflated and the tire bead pressed off, then coat the tire bead and rim flange with mounting paste again and inflate to 3.3 bar (47 psi) pressure.
How should the car be secured during wheel balancing procedures?
Secure the car with a steel cable attached to the rear towing eye. The cable must not be tight to avoid wrong measuring values.
What special safety consideration applies to the BMW 325 iX model?
This car has four driven wheels so that all four wheels must be able to turn freely and the car must be jacked up safely for finish balancing.
What product should be used to clean the wheel hub centering collar and bearing surface?
Clean the wheel hub centering collar and bearing surface of a disc wheel to remove dirt and old grease and coat the center with Plastilube prior to mounting a wheel.
Where should the jack be positioned for rear wheel balancing?
Apply jack at middle of car on the rear axle carrier and lift the car.
How is the balance weight positioned on aluminum rims?
Remove the tire clamp and push a balance weight underneath the holder until it engages.
What important limitation is mentioned about the convertible body repair section?
This section only describes special repairs for convertibles. Repairs which are identical or practically identical with those for sedans and/or four wheel drive models are not described here.
When should you grind down the joint on the entrance?
You should grind down the joint on entrance, tinning if necessary.
What type of coating should be applied to the wheel house opening?
Apply a coat of spot welding paint on the wheel house opening.
How should the wheel house be attached through the provided holes?
Plug spot weld wheel house through provided holes.
What is the sequence requirement for the door replacement jobs?
The jobs must be performed in the given sequence, and installation is in reverse sequence.
What types of repairs should always be performed according to the manual?
Always perform repairs, which concern the suspension points of the engine, transmission, axles or running gear, on a straightening bench with the attachments belonging to the car type.
What should be applied to the wheel opening surface and fuel tank filler neck?
A coat of body sealing compound should be applied on the wheel opening surface and fuel tank filler neck.
Where should the base plate be placed according to the procedure?
Apply fixture and place base plate on surface for the chassis number.
What is the sheet metal thickness specified for the side reinforcements?
The sheet metal thickness is 1.8 mm (0.071").
What area should be cut around the wheel opening according to the first image?
Cut off side panel around the wheel opening.
What arrows are visible in the bottom diagram and what do they indicate?
There are curved arrows pointing to the welding area, indicating the direction or location for inserting and gas welding the wheel house outside section.
What image reference number shows the step for uncovering points of connection?
What is the first step shown for repairing a door pillar?
Plug spot weld the door pillar.
What is the function of component 'b' in the SRS system?
Contact ring - guarantees power supply to the ignition pill.
What preparation is required for new parts before installation?
Grind mating surfaces on new parts. Coat mating surfaces needed for spot welding with zinc dust paint.
What figure number corresponds to the wheel house welding procedure?
Figure 30 41 270 shows the spot welding of cross panel on wheel houses and side panels.
What is the procedure title for section 41 14 132?
REPLACING RIGHT REAR WHEEL HOUSE OUTSIDE SECTION AND SIDE PANEL (PARTIAL REPLACEMENT UP TO WINDOW LINE).
What type of welding is primarily used for attaching the wheel house outside section?
Spot welding is used for attaching the wheel house outside section.
How is the tail panel attached to the side panel?
Weld tail panel on side panel and spot weld tail panel on side panel.
What type of welds need to be drilled out during this repair procedure?
Spot welds need to be drilled out.
What is the first step shown in the welding spot removal process?
Uncover and drill off welding spots.
What type of welding is recommended for the bracket attachment?
Spot weld and/or inert gas weld bracket.
What should be done after cutting through the rear cover?
After cutting through the rear cover, drill off welding spots as indicated in the following steps.
How should the mating surfaces on the new cross member be prepared?
Grind mating surfaces on new cross member and coat with zinc dust paint.
What steps are required after drilling out spot welds on the cover?
After drilling out spot welds, lift off the cover.
What surface preparation is required for the mating surfaces after removing scrap metal?
Remove scrap metal, straighten and grind mating surfaces. Coat mating surfaces required for spot welding with zinc dust paint.
Where can I find information about replacing the side member cover on a 4-door car?
Information about replacing the side member cover on 4-door cars can be found on page 41-111, referenced under procedure 41 11 101.
What should you do first when starting the repair of damaged glass fiber reinforced plastic parts?
Cut out the damaged area until firm, non-fibrous laminate is visible.
