Check wires from transmitters to check control term. KW and WW with power flow.
What component is being serviced in this procedure?
The service indicator's printed circuit is being serviced and replaced.
What function does the violet/white wire serve?
The violet/white wire (pin 23 '5ASi') serves the ignition key in 'R' function.
What component is visible in the circular opening of the first image?
A printed circuit board with LEDs and light bulbs.
What should I do if the term. 31 ground connection is not okay?
Check ground wire, replacing if necessary.
What is the first step when removing and installing the tachometer?
Remove and install instrument carrier assembly 62 21 000, then unscrew screws.
What is the correct test procedure for checking tail lights operation?
For tail lights operation, connect the voltmeter positive lead to pins 11 or 12 and negative lead to pin 9, which should show battery voltage (UB) when tail lights are on.
What is the expected result when testing LEDs and light bulbs on '3' Series Cars?
All LEDs and both light bulbs must come on.
What should I do if the transmitter wire plug connection is not okay?
Repair or replace transmitter.
What is the acceptable resistance value for coolant/washing fluid level sensors?
0 ohm is the acceptable resistance value when testing with an ohmmeter.
How do I test power flow in wires from transmitter to check control?
Check power flow in wires from transmitter to check control static oil term. and dyn. oil terminal.
What setting is required for the fuel gage test?
Selector switch (3) set to tank.
What car series does this speedometer testing procedure apply to?
'5', '6' and '7' Series Cars
How should the turn knob be operated during speedometer testing?
Turn knob (7) clockwise slowly; speedometer needle passes through the display range.
What caution must be observed when mounting the connection plate for 3 Series cars?
Be careful not to bend the spring contacts when mounting the connection plate.
What happens to the inspection symbol lamp during the reset sequence?
The inspection symbol lamp comes on when the green LEDs have gone out again, along with the yellow lamp.
How do you fix a coding plug issue with the fuel consumption indicator?
Check/replace coding plug.
Which page contains information about replacing light bulbs in the instrument carrier?
Page 62-6 contains information about replacing light bulbs in the instrument carrier.
What BMW part number should be used if installing a special low beam relay?
BMW Part No. 61 31 1 366 058.
What is the difference between the connection method for '3' Series versus '5', '6' and '7' Series Cars?
'3' Series Cars require connecting the printed circuit board directly, while '5', '6' and '7' Series Cars require connecting the plug of the printed circuit board.
Which pins are designated as not used in this connector?
Pins 10, 14, and 19 are designated as not used.
What reference sections are mentioned for tachometer and economy control checking?
Check as described in sections 1.2.2 or 1.2.3 for tachometer and economy control testing.
Which buttons are used to reset the SI system?
Button 8: OIL SERVICE reset and Button 9: INSPECTION reset.
What happens when you perform a brief reset (8) on the oil service display?
Brief reset (8) will cancel the display. All five green LEDs come on.
What is the function of component number 8 in the check control system?
Component number 8 is the Coolant level sensor.
What resistance reading should you expect in the bulb tester from term. 31 to term. KKL with lights turned on?
4.7 ohms resistance in bulb tester from term. 31 to term. KKL with lights turned on. If resistance is not okay, replace bulb tester.
What test value should I get when checking the stop lights with brakes applied?
When brakes are applied and stop lights are okay, you should get UB (battery voltage) when testing pin 25 (+) with a voltmeter to pin 9 (-).
What should happen to both the LEDs and light bulbs during the test on '3' Series Cars?
Both the LEDs and light bulbs must come on.
Which terminal connects fuse F 6 to the ignition lock?
Term. 15 connects fuse F 6 to the ignition lock.
What is the purpose of the simulator shown in the manual?
The simulator is used for checking instrument clusters, allowing technicians to test various functions and displays of the instrument cluster assembly.
What voltage system is specified for powering the simulator?
The simulator requires a 12 V battery system, with connections to B+ (positive) and B- (negative) terminals.
What should be done with the instruments and carrier after removing the bolts?
Take instruments with carrier out of housing.
What resistance reading should you get when testing the bulb tester?
Resistance should be 4.7 ohms in bulb tester from terminal 31 to terminal 54 KL with stop light switch operated.
What should you check if power supply from fuse F 23 is okay but the lights still don't work?
Check the light switch. Test for voltage on outlet to term. 58 K. If there is no voltage, replace the light switch.
When testing pin 4 '15' Terminal '15', what condition must be met?
The ignition must be turned on when testing pin 4 '15' Terminal '15' with green/white wire.
What terminal should you check for ground on the bulb tester?
Term. 31 (ground) on bulb tester. If there is no ground connection, make ground connection.
How many main steps are shown in the speedometer removal procedure?
Three main steps: unscrew screws, take instruments with carrier out of housing, and unscrew bolt.
What appears when resetting the OIL SERVICE?
"OIL SERVICE" sign and yellow (possibly red) LED on.
What procedure should be followed for '5', '6' and '7' Series Cars?
Connect plug of printed circuit board.
What indicates that the SI can be simulated with car engine starting?
Car engine starting can be simulated with starting button (6), and the green LEDs for SI go out.
What are the connection terminals for frequency measurement?
Yellow connection terminal FREQ in + in yellow jack; black connection terminal FREQ in - on B - of battery.
How do you remove the printed circuit from its housing?
Pull the printed circuit out of the housing as shown in the diagram.
What happens if the speedometer display range is smaller than 280 km/h?

If the display range of a speedometer is smaller, it could happen that after reaching the final display value and increasing the frequency with knob (7) the needle would fall back to an undefined display value.
What should be checked if there is no voltage of yellow wire 56b to check control connection 21 at test point number 3?
Check wire, supply power or replace central electric board.
What is the final step in both engine oil and coolant testing procedures?
Check plug connections on check control and replace check control if necessary.
What color are the LEDs that illuminate after an oil service reset?
Green LEDs illuminate after an oil service reset.
Where can I find troubleshooting information for the service indicator?
Troubleshooting for the service indicator can be found on page 62-51.
What happens to the fuel consumption display during coasting with fuel shutoff?
The display will be close to zero in the coasting phase with coasting shutoff, i.e. no fuel injection.
What is the correction for an excessive EC display?
Replace tachometer with economy control or check coding plug table.
What should I do if there's no power supply to the light switch?
Supply electric power and replace the fuse.
What are the final components to check if ground wires to stop lights are not okay?
Make ground connections and replace light bulbs.
How long should the starting button be pressed and held during the service indicator test?
Press and hold starting button (6) at least two seconds before releasing.
At what RPM do the green LEDs go out on the SI - 2nd Generation?
The green LEDs go out when reaching a speed of approx. 600 rpm.
When does needle deflection take place during the gage tests?
Needle deflection takes place only in last third of turning range for knob (7).
Which pin should I use to test the low beams circuit with a voltmeter?
Use pin 21 (+) with a voltmeter, measuring to pin 9 (-) for the low beams circuit.
How do you adjust the EC needle position?
Turn knob (7) against left stop; needle of EC points to 0 (for L/100 km) or ∞ (for MPG). Turn knob (7) clockwise slowly; the EC needle moves through the display range.
What diagram reference number is shown for the screw removal step?
The diagram reference number is 30 62 012.
How do I test the central warning lamp in the instrument cluster?
Check wire from check control term ZH to pin 9 of blue instrument cluster plug. With turn signal on, a ground signal of 1 Hz can be measured on pin 9 of blue instrument cluster plug.
How do I test the bulb tester outlet?
Check voltage on bulb tester outlet terminals 58 L 1 and 58 R 1. If there's no voltage, replace the bulb tester.
What needs to be removed and installed according to procedure 62 21 000?
The instrument carrier assembly needs to be removed and installed according to procedure 62 21 000.
Which pin designation is only available on E 28 and pin 5 for E 24/E 23 models?
Pin 3 'OH' (Japan) Overheat is only available on E 28 and on pin 5 for E 24/E 23 models.
What type of wire connections are used for the Second Generation Service Indicator?
Connect blue and white plugs of wire harness on the instrument cluster.
Does it matter what state the oil service indicator was in before performing the reset?
No, it does not matter - all five green LEDs will come on regardless of whether one green LED was still on or only the yellow oil service sign was showing.
What wire color is used for pin 1 'R' Terminal 'R'?
The wire color for pin 1 'R' Terminal 'R' is violet/gray.
What should you do if the green LEDs are still on at the beginning of the tachometer test?
If the green LEDs are still on at the beginning of the test, cancel them when the speed exceeds approx. 500 rpm.
What are the tachometer settings for different engine types?
6 cylinder engines = 6 cyl, 4 cylinder engines = 4 cyl, diesel engines = Diesel.
What is the first step when troubleshooting low beam headlights?
Check both headlights. If they are okay, proceed to check the ground connection on light switch. If not okay, make ground connection.
What wire colors are used for the right tail lights connection?
The right tail lights (pin 11 '58R') use gray/white wire colors.
What is the section number for tachometer removal and installation?
Section 62 13 000 covers tachometer removal and installation.
What special note is mentioned for the tachometer and economy control testing?
The note specifies to use the correct coding plug for '3' Series Cars.
What does diagram 30 62 012 show in the tachometer procedure?
The instrument cluster with arrows indicating screw locations to be removed.
What components are labeled as 1 and 2 in the instrument cluster connection diagrams?
In the connection diagrams, (1) refers to the connection plate and (2) refers to the clamps used to secure the wire harness connection.
What is special about BMW 524 td cars regarding oil services?
BMW 524 td cars have two oil services after each inspection.
What is the final check if headlight ground connections and light bulbs are not okay?
Make ground connections and replace light bulbs.
What is the main topic covered in this section of the manual?
Instruments
What should you check if the wires from bulb tester to stop lights are not okay?
Supply electric power and check wires and plugs.
What diagram reference numbers show the individual gauge removal steps?
The temperature gauge removal is shown in diagram 30 62 016, and the fuel gauge removal is shown in diagram 30 62 017.
What must be removed and installed first when replacing either the temperature gauge or fuel gauge?
The instrument carrier assembly must be removed and installed first, using procedure 62 21 000.
When do the yellow and inspection symbol lamps come on during the service indicator reset process?
The yellow and inspection symbol lamps will come on when the green LEDs have gone out again.
Where can the set frequency be measured on the test equipment?
The set frequency can be measured on the yellow jack with a BMW service test unit (multimeter 14) - see operating instructions of BMW service test unit.
What button can be used to adjust the SI?
The SI can be adjusted with button (10).
What is the first check when tail lights are not working?
Check for power supply from terminal 30 via fuses F 22 and F 23, each 7.5 amps, to light switch terminals 58 LE and 58 RE.
Which BMW series are covered in the second test procedure shown?
'5', '6' and '7' Series Cars.
What callout numbers identify the lead connections on the simulator?
Connect lead (1) and power supply lead (2) on the simulator.
Where can the set frequency be measured using a BMW Service Tester?
The set frequency can be measured on the yellow jack with a BMW Service Tester (multimeter 14) - see operating instructions of BMW Service Tester.
How is the time of resetting indicated on the SI system?
The time of resetting is indicated by a lamp in the pertinent button.
What wire colors identify the oil level static connection?
The oil level static connection (pin 16 'ÖL stat.') uses blue/violet wire colors.
What does the abbreviation KAL stand for in the wiring diagram?
KAL stands for License plate light outlet left.
Which BMW models are specified for the clock removal and installation procedure?
BMW 320i and 323i models.
What is the final step if all other checks pass but the license plate lights still have issues?
Check plug connections on check control and replace check control if necessary.
What does a 0 ohm reading indicate for the low beam and bulb tester circuit?
A 0 ohm reading between pin 22 and pin 9 (-) indicates that the low beams and bulb tester are okay.
What wire color identifies the oxygen sensor connection for USA models?
The oxygen sensor for USA models uses blue/white wire color on pin 5 'OX'.
What does diagram 30 62 024 show for the clock procedure?
The clock with arrows indicating the plug and screw locations for removal.
What terminals should I check for voltage from the light switch to the check control?
Check voltage from light switch to check control at terminals 58 R and 58 L.
What fuse should be checked and replaced if the stop lights aren't working?
Replace the 8 ampere fuse (F 12).
What component connection method is shown with arrows in both diagnostic images?
The arrows point to the connection points for the printed circuit board or its plug.
Which BMW series use the tachometer and economy control testing setup?
'3' Series Cars use the tachometer and economy control testing setup, while '5', '6' and '7' Series Cars have a separate configuration.
What instruments can be connected for tachometer testing?
You can connect a tachometer, with or without Economy Control (EC), or a clock with EC on adapter (1).

Turn on the simulator with switch (1). The red control lamp will come on when battery voltage is adequate (≥ 11.5 V), indicating the simulator is ready for use.
What component is identified as number 10 in the check control system?
Component number 10 is the Central warning lamp in instrument cluster.
What frequency signal can be measured on pin 9 of the blue instrument cluster plug when testing the central warning lamp?
A ground signal of 1 Hz can be measured on pin 9 of the blue instrument cluster plug with the turn signal on.
Where can you find information about disassembling the instrument carrier?
Information about disassembling the instrument carrier can be found in Group 62.
What function does the brown/blue wire serve in this connector?
The brown/blue wire (pin 18 'KW') serves the coolant level and transmitter function.
How do you test the temperature gauge on the SI tester?

Set selector switch (3) to temperature, turn knob (7) against left stop so the needle of temperature gage is in blue range, then turn knob (7) clockwise slowly so the needle of temperature gage passes through the display range.
How do you connect the power supply to the simulator?
Connect the red terminal (3) to B+ and the black terminal (4) to B- of a 12 V battery.

Plug connection plate (1) of 3 series wire harness on instrument cluster and secure with clamps (2). Connect blue and white plugs of wire harness on the instrument cluster.
Which pins are specific to USA models for air bag testing?
Pins 6 'AB' (USA) Air bag (+) and 7 'AB' (USA) Air bag (-) are specific to USA models.
What should I check if the term. 30 electric power supply is not okay?
Check wire to fuse F 5, check fuse F 5 replacing with 8 ampere fuse if necessary, and check power rail in central electric board for fuse F 5.
What action should be taken if plug connections on transmitters are not okay for coolant system?
Repair or replace transmitters.

Pull off plug on clock, unscrew screws, and remove clock.

Repair ground wire and replace transmitters.
What is the procedure code for removing and installing the temperature gauge?
The procedure code is 62 11 090.
How many separate screw removal steps are shown in the tachometer removal procedure?
Two separate screw removal steps are shown - one at the beginning and one before removing the tachometer itself.

Disconnect black wire of term. 1 on instrument cluster plug, pull out wire in wire harness and wrap it around the wire harness.
What does callout number 1 indicate in the speedometer testing setup?
Callout number 1 indicates the adapter used for connecting the speedometer.
What voltage reading should you expect when testing the ground terminal?
Pin 9 (-) should read UB voltage when measured against pin 15 (+) with a voltmeter.
Which page would I find information about replacing the temperature gauge?
Page 62-2 contains information about temperature gage removal and installation or replacement.
What will the EC display show when the car is idling with the engine running?
EC will always display infinite fuel consumption when idling (car stopped - engine running).
What specific steps are required for the bolt and light duct in the final diagram?
Unscrew bolt (1) and remove light duct (2).

The red control lamp will not come on with a battery voltage of < 11.5 V; the simulator is not ready for use.
What should you do if the yellow/black wire from bulb tester in central electric board connection "K" to plug connection check control connection 22 shows 0 ohm?
Check contact of plug connection. Replace check control.
What does KAR represent in the component legend?
KAR represents License plate light outlet right.
What is the expected test value when measuring pin 20 with an ohmmeter?
The expected test value is 1 k-ohm when measuring between pin 20 and pin 9 (-).
What is the first step in troubleshooting stop light problems?
Check both stop lights to see if they are working or not.
What are the acceptable resistance values for the transmitter in oil pan testing?
0 ohm static and 1 k-ohm dynamic are okay values.
What action should be taken if the left and right low beam fuse is not okay?
Replace fuse.
What diagram reference number shows the bolt unscrewing procedure?
Diagram reference number 30 62 012 shows the bolt unscrewing procedure.

The coolant level sensor (pin 18 'KW') should show approximately 0 ohm when tested with an ohmmeter between the pin and pin 9.
What section number covers the removal and installation of the speedometer?
Section 62 12 000 covers speedometer removal and installation.
What is the purpose of checking the power rail in the central electric board for fuse F 5?
Checking the power rail in the central electric board for fuse F 5 is part of the diagnostic procedure when the term. 30 electric power supply is not okay.
What wire color is used for the oil level dynamic signal?
White wire is used for the oil level dynamic signal.
What callout number indicates the selector switch on the SI tester?
Callout number 3 indicates the selector switch.

KKL is the Indicator lamp outlet for license plate lights, while K is the Indicator lamp outlet for low beams.

All three fuses (F 5, F 6, and F 8) should be replaced with 8 ampere fuses if necessary.

First all five green LEDs come on after the reset, then they go out, and finally the yellow and inspection symbol lamps come on.

Lead (1) and power supply lead (2) are connected to the simulator.
What callout number represents the knob used for needle deflection tests?
Callout number 7 represents the knob used for turning to create needle deflection during gage tests.
What is the first step shown for speedometer removal?
Unscrew screws.

The green LED (4) indicates the 100 meter pulse required for the service indicator (SI) and economy control (EC).
What should the resistance reading be for the washing fluid level sensor?
The washing fluid level sensor (pin 17 'W') should read approximately 0 ohm when tested with an ohmmeter.
How can the distance counter be reset?
Distance counter can be reset with a second reset (9).
What is the ground reference pin for the check control system?
Pin 9 '31' Terminal '31' with brown wire color serves as the ground reference.
How should the power connections be made to the simulator?
Connect lead (1) and power supply lead (2) on the simulator. Connect red terminal (3) on B + and black terminal (4) on B - of a 12 V battery.
What diagnostic reference numbers are shown in the images?
30 62 092 for the first image and 30 62 053 for the second image.
What color plugs from the wire harness should be connected to the instrument cluster?
Connect blue and white plugs of wire harness on instrument cluster.
What wire colors are mentioned for the low beam headlight wires from fuse outlet to headlights?
Yellow/white and yellow/blue wires from fuse outlet for left and right low beam headlight wires.
What is component number 13 used for according to the legend?
Component number 13 is the Ignition switch (parking lights).
What safety system warning is shown in the upper portion of the wiring diagram?
The AIR BAG safety system warning is shown in the upper portion of the wiring diagram.
Which circuits share the same 4.7 ohms resistance specification?
Both the stop light indicator (pin 24) and license plate light indicator (pin 26) circuits share the same 4.7 ohms resistance specification.
What diagram shows the instruments being removed with the carrier?
Diagram reference number 30 62 013 shows the instruments being removed with the carrier.
What connection exists between fuse F 8 and fuse F 11?
There is a bridge connection between fuse F 8 and fuse F 11 that should be checked when troubleshooting term. R electric power supply.

Check wire to fuse F 8, check fuse F 8 replacing with 8 ampere fuse if necessary, check bridge between fuse F 8 and fuse F 11, and check wire from fuse F 11 to ignition lock term. R.
What causes the display needle to wander when the car is idling?
Disturbance from term. 1.

Test the license plate light indicator by measuring resistance with an ohmmeter between pin 26 and pin 9 (-), expecting 4.7 ohms.

Engage the temperature gauge in lock during installation.
What is the first check to perform when the license plate lights are not working?
Check for power supply from term. 30 via fuse F 23. If there is no power supply, supply electric power and replace the fuse.
Which generation of SI is this procedure NOT applicable to?
This procedure is not applicable to 2nd Generation SI.
What terminal should be checked for ground connection on the light switch?
Terminal 31 should be checked for ground connection on the light switch.
What should you do after unscrewing the screws in the tachometer removal procedure?
Take instruments with carrier out of housing.
What components are visible in the exploded view diagram?
The speedometer, various gauges, instrument cluster housing, and associated components are shown in the exploded view.
What should you do after connecting the simulator leads and power supply?
Turn on the simulator with switch (1).
How do you test the fasten seat belts function for USA models?

If there's no display at all on the fuel consumption indicator, what should you check first?

"TIME SYMBOL" and one or more green LEDs on.
What is the expected outcome when testing '5', '6' and '7' Series Cars SI signs?
All LEDs and both signs must light up.

All five green LEDs will come on after making an oil service reset, regardless of whether one green LED was still on or only the yellow oil service sign was showing.
How many pages does the simulator for testing instrument clusters content span?
20 pages (from page 62 to 81)
How do you test the voltage at the stop light switch inlet?
Check voltage in wire from stop light switch inlet to check control terminal 54 Si7.
What procedure should be done before removing the speedometer according to this page?
Remove and install instrument carrier assembly 62 21 000.
What happens to the LEDs when the simulator is switched off and on again?
LEDs are turned on again each time the simulator is switched off and on again afterwards.
Which BMW series cars use the speedometer connection shown in the first diagram?

How do you check the speedometer according to the procedure?
Connect the speedometer on adapter (1) and check as described in section 1.2.1.
What causes an excessive EC display reading?
Wrong temperature on quartz or coding plug wrong.
What is the expected voltage reading for pin 3 'OH' (Japan) Overheat terminal when testing with a multimeter?
Pin 3 (-) should read UB voltage when measured against pin 4 (+) with a voltmeter.

Pin 2 should be connected with pin 9 (-) and the central warning lamp should be on continuously.

Check terminal 30 (Positive), terminal 15 (Positive), terminal 85 (Ground), and terminal 87 (Positive).
What selector switch setting should be used for speedometer testing?
Set selector switch (3) to km/h or mph, and turn knob (7) against left stop; speedometer needle points to 0.

How many green LEDs are mentioned in the service indicator resetting procedure?
Five green LEDs are mentioned in the service indicator resetting procedure.

Ground from light switch terminal 56 connects to low beam relay terminal 85 in yellow wire.

The simulator is designed for speedometers with a display range of 280 km/h.

Gray/red wire from light switch 58 K to bulb tester term. KL.
What is indicated by the arrows in the first removal step diagram?

An oil service reset.

What is the second step in removing the headlight assembly after removing the radiator grill?

Remove connector (1) between heater (3) and rear area heater duct (2) on left and right sides.

Section 52 20 000 should be referenced for removing the rear seat cushion and backrest.

Pull covers (1) or switches (2) out of control panel, then pull plugs (3) off of switches (2).
What is the procedure section number for removing and installing the compressor?
64 52 020 - REMOVING AND INSTALLING COMPRESSOR
How do you adjust the operating motor after disconnecting it?
Adjust by disconnecting on the operating motor and turning the operating rod in the ball head.
What is the first step for removing the blower switch on cars without radio?
Lift off radio opening mask, then pull off control knob.

All other valves of the discharging and charging station should be closed, except the charging valve.

Component (1) is the clamp, component (2) is the cable, and component (3) is the lever.

Callout number 2 indicates Temperature controlled fresh air.

The bolts that need to be unscrewed and the water valve with pipe lines that need to be removed.

Replace compressor oil. Unscrew bolt (1). Let oil run out of compressor. Add oil - volume and oil grade per specifications.

Always look for a leak underneath a possible leak point, since refrigerant is heavier than air.
What should be done with open connections immediately after disconnecting lines?
Insert plugs in open connections immediately.

Remove radio opening mask or radio, pull opening covers (1) or switches (2) out of control panel, and pull off plugs (3) on switches (2).

Discharge pressure in air conditioner with help of a valve core remover.
What should be done with the seals during installation?
Replace seals.
What installation note is provided for the water valve?
Installation: Replace seal.
Where is the manual transmission shifter located in relation to the dashboard controls?
The manual transmission shifter is located in the center console area, positioned below and to the right of the central dashboard controls.
What diagram reference numbers are shown for the various steps?
The diagram reference numbers shown are 30 64 192, 30 64 151, 30 64 201, 30 64 202, 30 64 203, and 30 64 215.
What happens to refrigerants at high temperatures or when exposed to open flame?
Refrigerants decompose at high temperatures or when exposed to an open flame. The decomposed products are injurious to health.
What should you do with the air conditioner before removing the compressor on BMW 318 i?
Discharge pressure in air conditioner with help of a valve core remover.
What section of the service manual is this diagram from?
This diagram is from section 64-2, which is part of the Heating and Air Conditioning section.
What is the part number for the cable for footwell ventilation procedures?
The part number for the cable for footwell ventilation is 64 11 071.
What must be removed before connecting the charging hoses?
Remove the protective cap before connecting the blue charging hose to the low pressure side and the red charging hose to the high pressure side of the air conditioner.
What safety equipment should be used when working with refrigerants?
Turn on available air extraction systems and conform with operating instructions supplied with pertinent charging equipment.
What should be done immediately after disconnecting the refrigerant lines?
Insert plugs in open connections immediately after disconnecting lines (3 and 4).
What is the procedure code for removing and installing or replacing the rear window ventilator?
The procedure code is 64 23 000.
What is the function of the freezing prevention switch?
Freezing prevention switch (9) switches the compressor to prevent the formation of ice on the evaporator, as ice formation would reduce the cross section opening size and impair cooling efficiency.
What action is required to remove the glove box after loosening the nuts?
Loosen nuts and remove glove box.
What two procedures should be performed after bleeding the cooling system?
Bleed cooling system and check coolant.
What are the testing conditions required before checking the air conditioner?

The car must be parked in shade (indoors), air conditioner discharged and charged, correct type and amount of oil in the compressor, engine running at 2,000 rpm with air conditioner switched on, and doors shut.
How should the high pressure hose be connected?
The high pressure hose should be connected in the same manner as the low pressure hose.
What component should be disconnected according to the left middle diagram?
Disconnect plug (1) for solenoid of pulley.
What are the rear area heater ducts numbered in the diagram?
Rear area heater ducts (5 and 6).
What engine RPM should be used when testing the air conditioner system?
The engine should be running at 2,000 rpm when testing the air conditioner system.
What is component number 1 in this heating and air conditioning system diagram?
Component number 1 is the blower motor.
What important positioning requirement is mentioned for the pulling hook?
Pulling hook must always rest on tip of tooth.
What are the numbered components (1), (2), and (3) shown in the control panel diagram?
Component (1) are covers, component (2) are switches, and component (3) are plugs.
What action is required with the wire plugs during removal?
Pull off both wire plugs.
What can be seen in the instrument cluster area of this dashboard diagram?
The instrument cluster area shows multiple circular gauges, including what appears to be a speedometer, tachometer, and other monitoring gauges typical of the E30 dashboard layout.
How do you remove the cable from the sliding control mechanism?
Lift out clamp (1) and disconnect cable (2) on lever (3) and remove.
What happens to the refrigerant when the compressor increases its pressure?
The compressor increases the pressure of gaseous refrigerant (Freon), which automatically causes the refrigerant temperature to also rise.
What should be noted about the type and amount of refrigerant?
Type and amount of refrigerant should be noted, and this information can be found on the label in the engine compartment.
Where is the temperature control wheel located in this assembly?
The temperature control wheel is component number 13, located in the lower portion of the assembly.
What is the first step shown for removing the A/C drier?
Unscrew screws and take off trim.
What immediate action is required after disconnecting lines 1 and 2 in the middle right diagram?
Insert plugs (3) in open connections immediately and counterhold on block valve (4) with wrench.
What tool is needed to counterhold the expansion valve?
A wrench is needed to counterhold the expansion valve during pipe disconnection.
On which page can I find information about removing and installing the expansion valve?
Information about removing and installing the expansion valve can be found on page 64-500.
What part number is shown for the valve core assembly?
In the cable removal procedure, what must be done with clamp (1) and cable (2)?
Pull out clamp (1), then disconnect cable (2) on lever (3) and remove.
What are the first two steps for removing the water valve?
Unscrew bolts, then take off water valve with pipe lines.
What should be done with the shutoff valve after finishing discharging?
Close shutoff valve (6) and mark the red indicator (A) with the displayed value.
Is moisture condensation on the evaporator a sign of system leakage?
No, moisture in the fresh air condenses on the evaporator and is discharged outside of car via lines on the transmission tunnel. This water is normal and not a sign of leakage.
What should you do with the pipe lines when removing the water valve?
Take off the water valve with the pipe lines attached.
What should you do with the coolant before starting the procedure?
Drain coolant.
What should be done after installing the air conditioning system?
Discharge, charge and check air conditioner for leaks after installation.
What step is performed after removing the bolts and laying the cover aside?
Open retaining straps (1) and swing aside.
How can you identify refrigerant-resistant valve cores?
The refrigerant-resistant valve cores can be recognized on the transparent seal (1).
What is the final step for securing the cable during installation?
Secure cable with clamp (4) after positioning the sleeve in the opening.
What happens to the refrigerant in the evaporator that produces cooling?
The liquid refrigerant expands in evaporator (8) and is turned into gas. This change of state produces strong cooling off of the refrigerant and evaporator.
What is the procedure code for replacing the cable for footwell ventilation?
The procedure code is 64 11 071.
What charging valve should be closed and which switch operated after finishing the charging procedure?
Close charging valve (25) and operate the heater with switch (13) after finishing the charging procedure.
What do you need to unscrew to remove molded parts?
Unscrew screws. Take off molded parts.
What is the installation torque specification mentioned for the expansion valve?
Tightening torque* with a note to replace seals during installation.
What are the three different charging hoses shown in the diagram and what are their colors?
The three charging hoses are: number 14 (blue) for low pressure, number 15 (red) for high pressure, and number 16 (white).
What is the reference number for the procedure about removing and installing the expansion valve?
The reference number is 64 51 050.
How should the water valve behave when supplied with battery voltage?
Water valve should be closed when supplied with battery voltage.
What equipment should be switched off after completing the discharge procedure?
Switch off the vacuum pump after completing the discharge procedure.
What is the procedure number for removing and installing the water valve for heater?
The procedure number is 64 11 271.
What are the first steps before beginning the fresh air flap cable replacement?
Disconnect battery ground lead, remove and install instrument panel trim on left side 51 45 130, remove and install tray 51 16 200, open glove box, and disconnect pins (1) of both retaining straps.
What components are indicated by numbers 1, 2, and 3 in the upper right image showing the clamp removal?
Number 1 indicates the clamp to lift out, number 2 shows the cable to disconnect, and number 3 points to the lever.
What are components 10, 11, and 12 in the main components list?
Component 10 is High pressure - gas, component 11 is High pressure - liquid, and component 12 is Low pressure - liquid.
What should be done after completing the A/C drier installation?
Discharge, charge and check air conditioner for leaks after completing installation.
What should be replaced during condenser installation according to the text?
Replace gasket.
What must you do to access the control panel after removing the radio mask?
Unscrew screws and pull out the control panel slightly.
What does the diagram numbered 30 64 220 show?
It shows the blower switch component that needs to be removed, with instructions to pull off the plug on the blower switch.
What note is provided about the condenser cooling fins?
Straighten bent cooling fins on condenser with help of special comb (1).
What components are connected with the refrigerant cylinder and charging hose?
Connect the refrigerant cylinder (2) and charging hose (16) with charging valve (1). Charging valve (1) remains connected until the charging cylinder has been filled.
What are the steps to disconnect the cable at the bottom of the control panel?
Lift out clamp (1), then disconnect cable (2) on lever (3).
What is the procedure section number for removing and installing the A/C drier?
64 53 010 REMOVING AND INSTALLING A/C DRIER.
What pressure should be applied to the valve core to fill the charging cylinder?
Apply pressure on the valve core to 141 psi pressure to allow refrigerant to escape from the charging cylinder.
What components need to be removed to take off the valve turner with valve core?
Unscrew coupling nut (3) and take off valve turner (2) with valve core (4).
What are the fresh air flaps identified as in this diagram?
The fresh air flaps are identified as component number 3.
What is the final installation requirement for the cable sleeve?
Cable sleeve (1) must be flush with stop (2).
What does callout number 6 reference in this heating system diagram?
Callout number 6 references the water valve.
What should you do if refrigerant gets on your skin?
Refrigerant on the skin will cause frostbite. Wash off pertinent parts of body with cold water thoroughly.
In the installation steps, what must be done with the slide control and air flap?
Connect cable (1) on slide control (2), push slide control and air flap against stop, then turn sleeve (3) until it can be placed in the opening.
How many plugs need to be disconnected from the switch?
Two plugs (numbered 1 and 2) need to be pulled off.
What test procedure is referenced for checking the coding plug when the driving range function is wrong?
See point 1.
If the frequency meter does not display frequency, what should be checked?
Check the speed transmitter for speedometer, see Group 62 in Repair Manual, and check wires, repairing if necessary.
What is the image reference number for the final installation step?
The final installation step showing wire harness routing is referenced as 30 65 304.
At what percentage below the set road speed does the cruise control system stop operating?
The system stops when the actual road speed drops below the set road speed by about 15%.
What procedure is shown for the cover removal in the center right image?
Unscrew screws and lay cover aside to access the internal components.
What should you do if the resistance value between ground and wire 23 is not okay?
Correct ground connection according to wiring diagram.
What is the specified distance between the run out antenna and raised trunk lid?
The distance (A) should be 18 mm (0.709").
Which BMW model requires attaching a holder for the cable?
Only BMW 325 e requires attaching holder (1) for cable.
What could cause the temperature display to show a considerable difference between position R and 15?
Possible causes include a defective fuel level transmitter or its wires, or a defective temperature sensor or its wires.
How do you remove the telescope and plastic cable according to the manual?
This requires firm pulling, especially if, for example, a bent telescope cannot be run out fully.
What is the procedure reference number for installing the retractable antenna at rear left?
What components are shown in the antenna installation order diagram numbered 1 through 7?
1 = Nut, 2 = Adapter, 3 = Insulator, 4 = Side panel rear right, 5 = Seal, 6 = Brass ring, 7 = Antenna.
How can the distance between the antenna and trunk lid be corrected if it's not within specification?
Distance (A) can be corrected by adjusting the antenna on the mounting bracket.
What component is labeled as (1) in the bottom right diagram?
Component (1) refers to the temperature sensor plug connection that needs to be disconnected.

The circuit diagram shows the radio connector layout with the connection points, including the highlighted position (1) for the "SA" connection.
What is shown in diagram 30 65 314?
The diagram shows connecting plug (1) tied back on extra wire harness with plug (2) tied back in car for automatic transmission cars.
Which meter designation is used for voltage testing in this diagnostic procedure?
Voltmeter (M 01).
Which connection numbers are used for the clutch switching test?
Connection (1) for ground and connection (6) for B + (12 V).
What should be done before starting the automatic antenna installation?
Disconnect battery ground wire, remove jack, and take off side trim panel.
What are the four distance measurements for marking hole locations on the left front wheel house?
Distance 1 = 68 mm (2.677"), Distance 2 = 104 mm (4.094"), Distance 3 = 50 mm (1.968"), Distance 4 = 62 mm (2.441").
What should you do with the hexagon after adjusting the cable gap?
Counterhold on hexagon (2) while making the adjustment.
How do you remove individual wires from the central plug?
Push on pertinent wire window with a screwdriver and pull wire (2) out of plug receptacle.
What diameter should the tapped hole be drilled out to?
The tapped hole (1) should be drilled out to 5.5 mm (0.216") diameter.
What connections are made for the operating motor wire harness?
Connect plug (1) of operating motor wire harness with plug (2) of extra wire harness (see wire harness sketch), then install trim panel.
What is the procedure number for this automatic antenna installation?
65 22 005 Installing Automatic Antenna.
What do the ignition lock positions 0, R, 15, and 50 indicate for on-board computer functions?

Position 0: No display background lighting, not possible to operate buttons. Position R: Display board illuminated, operation possible, code function free. Position 15: Same as R, however also distance/time/consumption functions, code function locked. Position 50: Same as 15, but in this case the starting interlock must only function 6 seconds after taking away the term. 50 signal.
What is the complete sequence for plug-in antenna installation?
Insert sealing grommet (1), mount antenna with holder (3) and bolts (4), then mount ground wire with bolt (2).
What must be done to access the on-board computer after removing the cover?
Unscrew screws and take out the on-board computer.
What specific procedure applies only to BMW 318i models?
Guide cable through holder (1) and insert rubber grommet (2) in holder. Lift out nipple bearing (3), connect cable in nipple bearing, and clip on nipple bearing again.
How many cassette slots are visible in the lower diagram?
Three cassette slots are visible in the lower diagram showing the cassette storage area.
What is the corrective action if plugs and wires are not okay?
Repair or replace plugs and wires if they are not okay.
What should the ohmmeter reading be when testing the clutch switch with the clutch pedal operated?
The ohmmeter should display 0 ohm when the clutch pedal is operated.
What should you do if PPPP appears in the display?
Replace coding plug, disconnect power supply, reconnect, perform coding test. If on BC II, replace BC II and check coding and compensate reserve volume according to the specified procedure.
What additional component must be mounted along with the selector switch?
Also mount ground lead (2) when installing the selector switch.
What is shown in diagram 28 65 186 for wire removal?
Diagram 28 65 186 shows how to push on pertinent wire window with a screwdriver and pull wire (2) out of plug receptacle, with callout 1 indicating the plug receptacle.
Where can I find information about removing and installing the on-board computer?
Information about on-board computer removal and installation can be found on pages 65-360, with the procedure number 65 81 030.
Where is the air temperature sensor located on BMW E30 models before 9/85?
The temperature sensor is located in the air inlet opening of the front spoiler.

The parking brake lever cover (1) is being installed.

The right photograph shows the run out antenna and its distance measurement (A) from the raised trunk lid.
What is the part number reference shown at the bottom of the antenna diagram?
The part number reference shown at the bottom of the antenna diagram is 30 65 335.
How can I check the consumption signal using diagnostic equipment?
Use scope test or BMW digital tester II with ms-test, possibly compare with signal of cyl. 1 or 2.
What is the final step if both motor tests pass successfully?
Replace control unit.
How do you remove the bracket and switch plug shown in the lower right diagram?
Remove bracket (1) and pull plug off of switch (2) to disconnect the electrical connection.
What causes the horn relay not to activate?
The relay box for horn activation could be defective, there could be defective wires, or BC II could be defective.
What electrical connection must be made during speaker installation?
The plug must be connected during installation (and disconnected during removal).
What should be done to prevent rust after drilling?
Remove burrs on trunk floor plate as there is danger of producing rust.

Remove the sliding belt holder as part of the process when lifting off the cap and detaching the B pillar trim.
What should I do if the clutch switch test shows incorrect values?
Replace clutch switch.

Test for power supply missing between pin 10 (= B-) and pin 6 (= B+). Specification: U ≥ 10 V. Check wires to and from instrument cluster; plug connections.
How do you disconnect the temperature sensor from its electrical connection?
Pull plug out of holder and disconnect. The front spoiler removal is noted as not necessary for temperature sensor removal.
What should be audible when the clutch is switching on during the test?
The clutch must be heard to switch on.
What reference point should I check for starter interlocking relay issues between pin 6 and pin 11?
See point 10, but between pin 6 and pin 11.
What hardware is used to mount the operating motor on the holder?
Mount the operating motor on holder with nuts and spring washers.

With simulation of 256 Hz, ignition on engine not running, on BC II button SPEED and button SET-RES. Displayed value see coding plug table.
How should the cassette boxes be inserted into the holder?
Slide cassette boxes (1) into holder (2).
How do you remove the plug cartridge from its housing?
Pull plug cartridge (1) out of housing (2).

Measure resistance between pin 14 and pin 10, BC II not connected, ignition lock in position 0; specification: between 80 and 120 ohms.
What are the possible causes for none or wrong CONSUMPTION display?
Wrong coding plug in BC II, defect in input signal, or BC II defective.
What is the difference in door beam treatment between two door and four door cars?
For two door cars, you only pry cover strips out of clamps on the left door beam. For four door cars, you pry cover strips out of clamps on both left front and rear door beams.
What is the drill bit diameter required for the antenna installation hole?
22 mm (0.866") dia. hole.
Where should I look for information about testing the speed signal?
See point 6.
What should you replace if the operating motor fails to run during the second test?
Replace the operating motor.
What are the possible causes when the gong is not working?
The causes could be a defect in the gong signal transmitter/wires or BC II defective.
What section and page number is this from?
This is page 65-94 from the service manual.
What specific instruction is given for models since 9/85?
Remove trim panel.
What is the recommended method for marking the hole position before drilling?
Punch mark point of intersection and drill a 22 mm (0.866") dia. hole.

Unscrew screws 1 and 2.

Push the white push buttons to unlock the cassette holders, which will allow the cassettes to slide out.

Connection from instrument cluster to BC II and wires to instrument cluster.

Don't tighten nut (1) completely at this point.
What are the two main steps shown in the bottom photographs for speaker removal?
The steps are: unscrew screws and disconnect plug.

The splash guard (1) needs to be taken off first.
How should the backrest be engaged during installation?
Engage backrest in (upper) holder.
What should be done with all plugs when lifting the instrument carrier out?
Pull off all plugs when lifting the instrument carrier out of the instrument panel.
What are the three important steps for working with a 26 pin central plug?
The three important steps are: 1) Pull back holding clip, 2) Pull off central plug, and 3) Pull out slide control.
In what sequence should the antenna wire connection be made relative to other installation steps?
The antenna wire should be plugged in before re-installing all removed parts.
What safety precaution is specified before beginning the cruise control installation?
Disconnect battery ground lead before beginning the installation procedure.
Where should the wire harness be routed between the trim panel and side panel?
The wire harness should be routed between the trim panel and side panel as shown in the installation procedure.
How do you call the type of coding plug in ignition lock position 15?

The type of coding plug can be called in ignition lock position 15 by pressing buttons 1 and 100 simultaneously. If calling is not possible, check power supply between pins 10 (= B -) and 7 (= term. 15).
What does connection number 1 represent in the wire harness sketch?
Connection number 1 is the connection for the control unit.
What is the instruction for the threaded sleeve during installation?
Screw in threaded sleeve tight and run telescope out and in several times.

With engine running there must be consumption signal on pin 17 and pin 10 (= B—). Check signal from L-Jetronic control unit pin 12 or wire 11 from 2BE control unit with BMW service test unit.
How should the control unit be installed into the holder?
Slide control unit (1) into holder (2) as shown in the diagram.
What are the image reference numbers shown for the different procedural steps?
The image reference numbers are 30 65 113, 30 65 114, 30 65 115, 30 51 466, and 30 51 465.
If I find a BC II defect during testing, what should I do?
Replace BC II (see point 1).
What color is the special equipment connection wire?
The special equipment connection wire is red.
What preliminary steps must be performed before installing the cruise control?
Disconnect battery ground lead, remove steering wheel 32 33 000, remove instrument panel trim at bottom left - 51 45 180, and remove lower steering column casing section - 32 31 020.
Where are the rear speakers located in this sound system layout?
The rear speakers are labeled as number 3 'Speakers - rear' and are positioned in the rear deck area behind the passenger compartment.
What is the first step shown for accessing the steering column casing?
Cut out the marked opening in the steering column casing, then install the steering column casing.
After removing the glove box pins, what is the next step to access internal components?
Unscrew screws and pull down the cover.

What is the procedure code for removing and installing or replacing the on-board computer?
The procedure code is 65 81 030.
Where can you find additional reference information mentioned at the bottom of this diagnostic flowchart?
See Specifications.
Which connections should be tested with voltmeter M 01 in the second voltage test?

The voltmeter should display approximately operating voltage.

If cover strip clamps remain in the door beam, pull them out with pliers and insert new clamps from the installation kit in the cover strip.
What happens if cable adjustment is not okay during the cruise control testing?
Adjust the cable, or if replacement is needed, replace the cable according to section 65 71 040 in the Repair Manual.
What should you do after unscrewing the left and right bolts on the backrest?
Pull up and remove backrest.

Re-install all removed parts.
Where can I find instructions for removing and installing the front radio speaker?
Instructions for removing and installing the front radio speaker can be found on pages 65-91, under procedure code 65 12 000.

Measure resistance between pin 16 and pin 10 (= B−) with BC II not connected and compare with actual temperature.
What page range covers cruise control testing instructions?

What components are shown in the clutch switch mounting diagram for manual transmission vehicles?

What installation instruction is provided for reassembly?
Install parts in correct order.

Replace the temperature sensor according to the specifications for the correct value.

Turn ignition lock to position R or 15, connect pin 10 and pin 2 - gong must gong.

Callout 1 represents the plug cartridge and callout 2 represents the housing it needs to be pulled out of.

Component 1 is the cassette box, component 2 is the holder, component 3 is the guide, and component 4 is the opening of the holder.
What happens when the cruise control is switched to the Up - Down OFF position?
Cruise control switched off. Stored value is cancelled only after turning off the ignition.
Under what ignition key condition will the radio not turn on?
The radio cannot be turned on when the ignition key is turned to position "0".
What is the part number reference shown at the bottom of the page?
The part number reference shown at the bottom is 30 65 333.
What does the diagram with part number 30 65 105 show?
The diagram shows the roof view of the car with callout numbers indicating antenna wire connection points and wire harness routing between trim panel and side panel.

Pull off both plugs on clutch switch, connect ohmmeter (M 06) on clutch switch, operate clutch pedal, and verify ohmmeter displays 0 ohm.

Adjust gap (A) to 1... 2 mm (0.040... 0.080") on knurled nut (1).

Before 9/85, the sensor was accessed through the air inlet opening of the front spoiler, while since 9/85, access requires removing front spoiler screws from the wheel houses.

Zinc dust paint should be used to coat the edges of the hole.

What should you check before connecting the operating motor cable?

What tool is needed to pry the cover strip out of clamps on the left door beam for two door cars?

Replace the operating motor.

The antenna will run in when switching off the radio.

Pull off covers and unscrew bolts on left and right sides.

The operating motor must be heard to run and the motor should be running.

Install holder (1) with rubber grommet (2).

Ignition lock in R or 15. Pin 10 (= B-) connected briefly with pin 4 several times: Information in display must change each time.
What does connection point 1 represent according to the note?

What procedure number is used for air temperature sensor removal and installation?

The ignition must be turned on before checking voltage with the voltmeter.

Detach the carpet along the door beam, and if clips for the cover strip remain in the door beam, pull them out with pliers.

Adjust the clutch switch with nuts so that 4 to 5 mm (0.157 to 0.197 inches) of contact button is visible when the clutch pedal is released.

If clips for cover strips remain in the door beam, pull them out with pliers and insert new clips from the installation kit in the cover strip.
What are the possible causes when the starter interlocking relay fails to activate?
Defect in relay box, activation of interlock defective, or wires/BC II.
What should you do first when starting the telescope replacement procedure?
Turn on radio to run out telescope as far as possible. Unscrew threaded sleeve.
What part numbers are visible in the photographs?

Callout 1 indicates the wire strap that needs to be cut off.
How should the new telescope be inserted into the antenna adapter?
Slide straightened, pointed plastic end of new telescope into antenna adapter until resistance is felt on the contact roller.
In what order should the rear speaker components be installed?
The correct installed order is: 1 Self-tapping screw, 2 Speaker mask, 3 Speaker, 4 Washer, 5 Self-tapping nut, 6 Hatrack.

The procedure code is 65 12 020.

Unscrew mounting nuts for cover (1) and lift out cover.

Don't tighten nut (1) completely at this point.

On which page can I find instructions for removing and installing the front seat belt?

What alignment instruction is given for the belt reversing holder during installation?
Align belt reversing holder parallel to C pillar.
What should be referenced for tightening torque specifications throughout this procedure?
See Specifications (indicated with * throughout the instructions)
What resistance values should I measure on the belt lock plug when checking the switch?
Belt lock engaged should measure approximately ∞Ω, and belt lock not engaged should measure approximately 0Ω.
What should be done if the lock trim is missing or damaged?
Replace the seat belt, if the lock trim is missing or damaged.
Are straightening attempts on the seat and seat rail approved?
Straightening attempts on the seat and seat rail are not approved.
What is the recommended distance to drive before final screw tightening?
Approximately 100 km (60 miles).
What is the purpose of the second activation system controlled by inertia mass (2)?
The second activation system is provided for additional safety and is controlled by inertia mass (2). This system is also okay if the reel locks when pulling out the belt suddenly.

Trim is being lifted out.
If the fully pulled out belt strap has pinches, melt spots, cuts, creases, tears or fringing, what is the required action?
Replace the complete automatic seat belt.

Unscrew bolt and remove automatic reel.
What procedure is required for installation after removing the automatic reel and reverser?
Installation requires tightening torque as specified.
What is the first step shown in the removal sequence?
Unscrew the bolt (after removing rear seat components on convertibles).
What indicates that the return spring could be weak or broken?
If the last section is not winding up, the return spring (3) could be weak or broken, or there might be excessive friction in the belt guides.
What component is labeled as item 16 in the seat belt assembly?
Item 16 indicates the belt insert component in the plastic sleeve of the belt opening.
How should the insert be positioned when fastening a seat belt?
To fasten a seat belt the insert must be inserted in the lock lightly and heard to engage with a click. The insert must be ejected out of the lock by spring pressure when pressing the 'PRESS' button.
When must an automatic seat belt be replaced according to the mounting tab condition?
An automatic seat belt must be replaced if mounting tab (6) is bent or the belt reversing holder is deformed in any way.
What should I do if the mounting tab on the belt reversing holder is deformed?
Replace the complete automatic seat belt.
What spray should be used on seat belts and what is its purpose?
Spray a seat belt with universal spray, HWB No. 8 122 947 005, to improve retraction of belt in reel (reduces friction, especially on the belt reversing holder).
What component should be lifted out if applicable when removing the complete rear seat?
Lift out plate if applicable.
In the belt stopper mechanism, what do callout numbers 1 and 2 indicate?
In the belt stopper mechanism, (1) indicates an eccentrically mounted friction roller and (2) indicates the connector that the friction roller moves against to lock the belt.
What is the procedure to remove the slide mechanism?
Drive out pin (1) and take off slide.
What solution should be used to clean seat belt straps?
Use a luke warm soap solution or commercial fine laundry detergent to clean seat belt straps. Seat belt straps may never be cleaned chemically or dyed.
What cutting instruction is given for the B pillar trim preparation?
Cut out B pillar trim for bore B, with dimension C being approximately 50 mm (2 inches).
If the front tongue of the reclining mechanism or seat rails are deformed in seat-integrated seat belts, what is the remedy?
Replace damaged parts and the complete automatic seat belt.
How do you open the sun roof during wind deflector installation?
Open sun roof. Press in holders between beaded edge and panel on left and right sides with a screwdriver.
What should you do with the stirrup during disassembly?
Unscrew screw and take off stirrup.
Where can the belt reversing holder be mounted and what determines the mounting location?
The belt reversing holder can be mounted at point A or B, depending on the size of the person. Cut out B pillar trim for bore B, which is approximately 50 mm (2").
How many independent activation systems does the automatic reel have for locking the belt?
The automatic reel has three independent activation systems for locking the belt.
When should the seat belt be replaced based on traces of wear?
The seat belt has to be replaced, if traces of wear are found in the plastic sleeve of the belt opening above the belt insert (16).
What should I check if the seat belt can be pulled out without hesitation?
Check if the seat belt winds up on its own (only help for last section). If not, loosen reel and tighten reel, or replace the seat belt if the return spring is broken.
What are the first steps to remove the front seat belt according to the procedure?
First remove front seat 52 10 000, then pull off cap and unscrew lower strap (1). If applicable, pull off plug and check switch - see test list for seat belts.

In the case of a seat-integrated seat belt, the stop of the lower strap could be deformed on the seat rail in a collision.

Pull B pillar trim out of clamps; if necessary unscrew bolts and pull out of upper holder.

The belt should wind up on the reel automatically almost completely when taken off. It might be necessary to guide the last section of the belt to the door beam.

The centering pin (1) engages in the bore during installation.

Flat head screws are used in the installation.

Part number 54 12 490 covers the wind deflector installation.

Since 1985 Models, Washers (2 and 4) are omitted from the installed order.
What procedure is shown for the B pillar trim installation?
Press out cover and insert belt through B pillar trim.
What should I do if the belt strap has serious dirt and spots that cannot be removed?
The seat belt must be replaced if dirt and spots cannot be removed with a commercial fine laundry detergent.
What procedure is shown for the automatic reel?
Unscrew bolt and remove automatic reel, then install with tightening torque according to specifications.

Since 1986 Models: Lift off cover.
Can the automatic reel be serviced or opened?
The automatic reel does not require servicing and must not be opened.

The belt stopper is the third system and is provided to prevent the film winding effect occurring when the reel is locked and with strong deceleration.
When should the lower strap be replaced?
The lower strap must also be replaced when replacing a seat belt.
When does the diagnostic flowchart indicate that the automatic seat belt is okay?
When there is no warning signal with the driver's door closed, seat belt fastened and ignition turned on.

The front belt reversing holder must swing after installation.

Mount belt lock for center seat belt on the right side.

Replace the automatic seat belt.

Pull off cap and unscrew bolt. Lift out cover (1) and pull it off of the belt strap.

Seat belt straps may never be cleaned chemically or dyed.

Align wind deflector parallel to roof opening and tighten left and right screws uniformly.

Check if there is a warning signal with the driver's door closed, seat belt fastened (click heard) and ignition turned on.
What are the possible causes if the seat belt doesn't wind up on its own?

Check position of reversing holder for correct installed position, excessive friction in belt guides (replace seat belt and guides), loose reel (tighten reel), spray belt straps with HWB 81 229 407 005 spray, or return spring broken (replace seat belt).
If the seat belt reel locks when pulling out the belt suddenly, what action should be taken?
Replace the automatic seat belt.
What component change occurred for models since 1985?
Since 1985 models, both washers (2 and 4) have been omitted from the installed order.

A seat belt that has been worn in an accident must be destroyed immediately after removal to make it impossible to use it again.
